songs.title: Kepada-Mu, ya Tuhan Hua
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Kepada-Mu, ya Tuhan Hua syukur dinyanyian petang.
L: T'rang matahari masuk jua, Engkaulah yang tetap terang.
L: Sehari hari an betapa besar karunia sayang-Mu,
L: yang melampaui sayang bapa. Ya Tuhan, Pokok hidupku.
L: 2
L: Ketika malam pun kutaruh, kepada-Mu percayaku.
L: B'ri esok dengan suka baru, 'ku hidup akan hormat-Mu.
L: Dan kalau tiada esok nanti Kaut'rima rohku apalah,
L: sehingga dapat 'ku berhenti dan ketemu sejahtera.
L: 3
L: 'Ku tahu siang malam siapa Pelindungku dan harapku.
L: 'Ngkau batu-karangku, ya Bapa, sandaran yang tetap teguh.
L: Dan pada malam kesudahan perjalanan kehidupan,
L: kar'na segala hari, Tuhan, kub'ri syukur dan pujian.

songs.title: Kepada Tuhan jua
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Kepada Tuhan jua serahkan jalanmu,
L: kuatirmu semua dan pokok mengeluh.
L: Pengurus jalan zaman dan arah dunia
L: b'ri juga jalan aman kepada anak-Nya.
L: 2
L: Bersandar pada Tuhan, berdoa beriman;
L: tiada pengeluhan memb'ri pertolongan.
L: Tentu pernah kaulihat ajaib mujizat-Nya,
L: yang menyatakan hikmat dengan anugerah.
L: 3
L: Nasibku, Allah Bapa, dipimpin kasih-Mu.
L: 'Ku tidak tahu apa yang jadi untungku.
L: Dan maksud yang sedia tentu Kausampaikan;
L: tak mungkin sia-sia yang t'lah Kaurancangkan.
L: 4
L: Meski kuasa jahat semua menempuh,
L: neraka tidak kuat melawan maksud-Mu.
L: Kemuliaan Tuhan sekali nanti t'rang;
L: tentulah kesungguhan dan kasih-Mu menang.
L: 5
L: Kepada-Ny serahkan beban pengurusan.
L: oleh-Nya dikerjakan, engkau keheranan.
L: Yang kini menyebabkan 'ngkau mengeluh-ngesah,
L: kelak diselesaikan oleh kuasa-Nya.
L: 6
L: Buangkanlah gelisah, cemasmu dan keluh;
L: tentulah 'ngkau tak bisa mengurus jalanmu.
L: Engkaukah dipertuan dan tahu semuanya?
L: Yang Mahakuasa Tuhan, yang hikmat-Nya baka.
L: 7
L: Tentulah kadang-kadang tak tampak tangan-Nya
L: dan rupanya teradang terang anugerah,
L: seolah-olah Tuhan melupakan engkau,
L: tak mendengar seruan dan kasihan-Nya jauh.
L: 8
L: Imanmu harus tahan di tengah malam pun
L: dan sampai kesudahan 'ngkau harus bertekun.
L: Dib'ri-Nya 'ngkau melihat: tak usah 'ngkau cemas,
L: beban berat diangkat dan engkau terlepas.
L: 9
L: Jikalau 'ngkau setia dengan iman teguh,
L: pahalamu sedia di tangan Tuhanmu.
L: Sesudah perjuangan dikaruniakan-Nya
L: mahkota kemenangan di rumah-Nya baka.
L: 10
L: Dengarkanlah seruan dan b'ri kekuatan,
L: sertai kami, Tuhan, di saat kematian,
L: sehingga maut menjadi keuntungan baka,
L: gapura t'rang abadi terbuka pintunya.

songs.title: Kepala yang Berdarah
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.

songs.title: O Holy Night
songs.author: Adolphe Adam Chappeau de Roquemaure John S. Dwight
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Fall on your knees!
L: Oh hear the angel voices!
L: Oh night divine!
L: Oh night when Christ was born,
L: Oh night divine!
L: Oh night, oh night divine!

[Bait 1]
L: O holy night!
L: The stars are brightly shining;
L: It is the night
L: Of the dear Savior's birth.
L: Long lay the world
L: In sin and error pining;
L: Till He appeared
L: And the soul felt its worth.
L: A thrill of hope,
L: The weary world rejoices;
L: For yonder breaks,
L: A new and glorious morn.
L: Fall on your knees,

[Bait 2]
L: Led by the light
L: Of faith serenely beaming,
L: With glowing hearts
L: By His cradle we stand.
L: So led by light
L: Of a star sweetly gleaming,
L: Here came the wise men
L: From orient land.
L: The King of kings
L: Lay thus in lowly manger,
L: In all our trials
L: Born to be our Friend;
L: He knows our need
L: To our weakness is no stranger.
L: Behold your King
L: Before Him lowly bend;
L: Behold your King
L: Before Him lowly bend!

[Bait 3]
L: Truly He taught us
L: To love one another,
L: His law is love
L: And His gospel is peace;
L: Chains shall He break
L: For the slave is our brother,
L: And in His name
L: All oppression shall cease.
L: Sweet hymns of joy
L: In grateful chorus raise we,
L: Let all within us
L: Praise His holy name.
L: Christ is the Lord
L: O praise His name forever.
L: His power and glory evermore proclaim;
L: His power and glory evermore proclaim.

songs.title: Pengakuan Iman Gki
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bagian 1]
L: Aku percaya kepada Allah Bapa Pencipta langit dan bumi, Pemelihara segala yang diciptakan dan yang menyediakan kehidupan kekal di dalam kerajaan-Nya.

[Bagian 2]
L: Aku percaya kepada Yesus Kristus, yang menebus dan menyelamatkan manusia dari dosa dalam kematian dan kebangkitan-Nya. Dialah Tuhan dan Kepala Gereja yang memerintah Gereja Kristen Injili di Tanah Papua, dengan Firman dan Roh-Nya.

[Bagian 3]
L: Aku percaya kepada Roh Kudus, yang membarui, memelihara, dan menuntun umat- Nya dalam kebenaran sampai kegenapan Kerajaan Allah dalam kedatangan kembali Yesus Kristus.

[Bagian 4]
L: Aku mengaku, bahwa Alkitab adalah Firman Allah dan satu-satunya kesaksian tentang Penyataan Allah.

[Bagian 5]
L: Aku mengaku bahwa Gereja Kristen Injili di Tanah Papua adalah Tubuh Kristus yang kudus dan am, yang mempersatukan umat manusia menjadi satu persekutuan sorgawi di bumi.

[Bagian 6]
L: Aku mengaku mengasihi Allah dan sesama manusia dengan segenap hati, jiwa, dan akal budi.

[Bagian 7]
L: Aku mengaku hidup kudus dan setia memberitakan Injil Kerajaan Allah di Tanah Papua dan dunia.

[Bagian 8]
L: Aku mengaku mengusahakan dan memelihara Tanah Papua sebagai alam ciptaan Allah bagi kesejahteraan, keadilan, dan kebahagiaan umat manusia.

songs.title: Pengakuan Iman Nicea – Konstantinople
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
{key: Am}
[Bagian 1]
L: Aku percaya kepada satu Allah Bapa yang mahakuasa, pencipta langit dan bumi, dan segala yang kelihatan dan yang tidak kelihatan.

[Bagian 2]
L: Dan kepada satu Tuhan Yesus Kristus, satu-satunya Anak Allah yang diperanakkan, diperanakkan dari Bapa sebelum alam semesta, Allah dari Allah, terang dari terang, Allah yang sejati dari Allah yang sejati, diperanakkan, bukan dicipta, sehakekat dengan sang Bapa, oleh siapa segala sesuatu dicipta; yang untuk kita manusia dan untuk keselamatan kita telah turun dari sorga, dan diinkarnasikan oleh Roh Kudus dari anak dara Maria, dan dijadikan manusia; Ia telah disalibkan, juga bagi kita, di bawah pemerintahan Pontius Pilatus. Ia menderita dan dikuburkan; dan pada hari ketiga Ia bangkit kembali, sesuai dengan kitab suci, dan naik ke sorga; dan duduk di sebelah kanan Bapa. dan Ia akan datang kembali dengan kemuliaan untuk menghakimi orang yang hidup dan yang mati; yang kerajaanNya takkan berakhir.

[Bagian 3]
L: Dan aku percaya kepada Roh Kudus, Tuhan dan pemberi kehidupan, yang keluar dari Bapa dan Anak, yang bersama-sama dengan Bapa dan Anak disembah dan dimuliakan, yang telah berfirman dengan perantaraan para nabi.

[Bagian 4]
L: Dan aku percaya satu gereja yang am dan rasuli, aku mengakui satu baptisan untuk pengampunan dosa, dan aku menantikan kebangkitan orang mati, dan kehidupan di dunia yang akan datang.

[Bagian 5]
C: Amin.

L: 'Kumulai bagaimanakah mengabarkan anugerah?
L: 2

L: genap-genap kebaikan-Mu, bahagia keampunan?

L: 3
L: Saudara yang di dunia sesat dan mengembara jauh,
L: kembali! Lihat tangan-Nya yang hendak memeluk engkau,

L: 3
L: Tak usah takut hatiku di lembah maut gelap;
L: kudengar saja tongkat-Nya, penghiburan tetap.
L: 4
L: Kaupanggil ke perjamuan; sedia mejaku;
L: kepalaku Kauurapi dan cawanku penuh.

L: 'Ku disertai rahmat-Nya seumur hidupku

L: 2

L: Tentu, tentu, tentu, kelak dihapuskan.

L: Buat kasih setiaMu di dalam hidupku

L: 4

L: Di situlah suaraku,
L: kekal memuji rahmat-Mu!

songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.

L: Kehendak hatiku lemah,
L: supaya tambah kuatnya
L: b'ri Roh-Mu kepadaku.

songs.title: T'rus dari Sorga Datang-Ku
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: T'rus dari sorga datang-Ku.
L: Kukabarkan kepadamu
L: selamat dan kesukaan yang
L: untuk kaum sekalian!
L: 2
L: Seorang Putra lahirlah,
L: seorang p'rawan bunda-Nya.
L: Meski kecil, lemah-lembut,
L: bagi-Nya kita bertelut.
L: 3
L: Yaitu Kristus, Penebus,
L: Yang Tuhan kita yang kudus,
L: yang melepaskan dunia
L: serta menghapus dosanya.
L: 4
L: Selamat yang dijanji Hu
L: dibawa-Nya kepadamu,
L: supaya kamu masuklah
L: ke rumah Bapa yang baka.
L: 5
L: Dan ini tanda bagimu:
L: 'kan kamu dapat Tuhanku
L: sebagai anak yang rendah
L: berbaring di palungan-Nya.
L: 6
L: Kuasa dan mulia-Nya
L: semua ditanggalkan-Nya:
L: kain lampin saja pakaian
L: Mukhalis kaum sekalian
L: 7
L: Hai, turut angkat suaramu:
L: Kemuliaan bagi Hu
L: yang mahatinggi tempat-Nya.
L: Di bumi pun sejahtera!

songs.title: Tahanlah dan Berjuang T'rus
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Tahanlah dan berjuang
L: t'rus dalam perjuangan kudus.
L: Kristuslah pokok kuatmu
L: dan kemenangan mu tentu.
L: 2
L: Maju tetap dan capailah
L: harta kehidupan baka.
L: Upah perjuangan berat
L: itu mahkota alhayat.
L: 3
L: Jangan sesat di dunia,
L: ikutlah t'rang anugerah.
L: Jalan benar yang kautempuh
L: itulah Kristus, Tuhanmu.
L: 4
L: Jangan kuatir, Ialah
L: membimbing dengan tangan-Nya.
L: Kristus pemimpin yang teguh,
L: tenagamu dan hidupmu.
L: 5
L: Janganlah takut p'rang berat;
L: senjata-Nya tetap dekat.
L: Nanti kau masuk di neg'ri
L: tempat kau dimahkotai.

songs.title: Tak Kita Menyerahkan

songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Tak kita menyerahkan kepada musuh-Nya,
L: pelita yang bersinar di dalam dunia.
L: Tak boleh firman Allah yang sungguh dan teguh,
L: Alkitab yang mulia diambil seteru.
L: 2
L: Penyokong orang tua dan orang yang lemah,
L: pemimpin orang muda dan sukacitanya.
L: Senjata perjuangan di p'rang penggodaan
L: dan bantal perhentian di jam kematian.
L: 3
L: Yang dapat memecahkan segala hati k'ras,
L: yang mencurahkan hidup di hati yang lemas,
L: yang menyembuhkan luka, mujarab obatnya,
L: yaitu firman Allah, penuh anugerah.
L: 4
L: Di hati kami, Tuhan Kautulis sabda-Mu,
L: supaya kami juga setia dan teguh.
L: Kendati gunung goyah, binasa dunia,
L: kekallah firman Allah, selama-lamanya.

L: set'lah Kautanggung sengsara di salib,

songs.title: Terang Matahari
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Terang matahari telah menyinari segala neg'ri
L: dan gunung dan padang dan sawah dan ladang, senang berseri.
L: 2
L: Bersuka sekali kulihat kembali terang merekah,
L: dan Bapa di sorga, yang Bapaku juga, hendak kusembah.
L: 3
L: Syukur bagi Dia, Gembala Setia, yang jaga tetap.
L: Dan waktu semua karunia-Nya jua, terang dan gelap.
L: 4
L: Tenaga dan kuat, kerja yang kubuat, kepunyaan-Nya.
L: Yang t'lah memberkati, hendak kuhormati, berhati rendah.
L: 5
L: Sehari-harian besar pemberian kemurahan-Mu.
L: Ya Tuhan, kiranya kuingat reganya, dan tanggunganku.

songs.title: Terbit Sepucuk Taruk
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Terbit sepucuk taruk di tunggul suku Daud.
L: Bersinarlah t'rang baru di kegelapan maut.
L: T'lah jadi Penebus menurut sabda sungguh
L: perjanjian kudus.
L: 2
L: Ke pulau dan benua tersiarlah terang.
L: Kaum dunia semua bersuka dan senang.
L: Manusia menyembah dan nama Tuhan Yesus,
L: dimuliakannya.
L: 3
L: Ya Yesus, b'rilah damai kepada dunia.
L: Kiranya bimbang kami denga anugerah.
L: Dan pada akhirnya, b'ri kami dapat juga,
L: bahagia baka.

songs.title: Terbitlah dari Awan-awan
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Terbitlah dari awanawan yang menudungi dunia,
L: terang mulia yang mewawan keg'lapan dan kuasanya.
L: Bersuka, bangsasekalian, dan kami turut menyembah.
L: Lenyaplah malam kematian dan fajar hidup merekah!
L: 2
L: Seorang Anak sudah jadi, seorang Putra diberi.
L: yang kerajaan-Nya abadi, selamat diperbarui.
L: Ajaib, ilahi dan mulia dan Mahasuci nama-Nya.
L: Berkat dan ampun-Nya sedia, mujizat-Nya anugerah!
L: 3
L: T'lah datang Ia dengan damai, sejaht'ra kemerdekaan.
L: Bersukaria ramai-ramai, terangkatlah perbudakan!
L: Segala tombak harus patah, seluruh bumi pun teduh,
L: dibakar habislah senjata, sebab t'lah datang Rajamu.
L: 4
L: Ya Raja Damai, Engkau jua yang memberi sejahtera.
L: Beri manusia semua bersama-sama menyembah.
L: Karunia Bapa Mahakuasa b'ri alas takhta-Mu teguh,
L: supaya dunia senantiasa memuliakan nama-Mu

songs.title: Terbuka Pintu Gerbang Emas
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Terbuka pintu gerbang mas,
L: di sorga yang terang.
L: Malak menyambut Tuhannya,
L: Panglima yang menang,
L: Panglima yang menang.
L: 2
L: Yang merendahkan diri-Nya
L: di bumi yang cemar,
L: menjadi raja yang kekal,
L: tertinggi, terbesar,
L: tertinggi, terbesar.
L: 3
L: Dahulu dari murid-Mu,
L: 'Ngkau naik ke dalam t'rang.
L: Kausediakan tempatnya,
L: di rumah-Mu senang,
L: di rumah-Mu senang.
L: 4
L: Dan dari jauh bersinarlah
L: cahaya kasih-Mu,
L: selaku mercusuar yang
L: menunjuk jalanku,
L: menunjuk jalanku.

songs.title: Terpujilah Allah Israel
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Terpuji Allah Israel,
L: yang t'lah melawat kita
L: dan turut niat-Nya kekal
L: 'ngerjakan sukacita,
L: membawa penebusan-Nya
L: dan akan tanda kasih-Nya
L: bangunkan tanduk s'lamat
L: dirumah Daud, hamba-Nya
L: yang dari awal dunia
L: terjanji dinubuat.
L: 2
L: yaitu: kaum yang mengesah
L: mendapat kelepasan,
L: tak ada lagi musuhnya,

L: Bila nanti telah tiba waktuMu

[Bagian 4]
L: Kupercaya kuasaMu memulihkan hidupku

[Bagian 5]
L: Waktu Tuhan pasti yang terbaik

[Bagian 6]
L: Walau kadang tak mudah dimengerti

[Bagian 7]
L: Lewati cobaan kutetap percaya

[Bagian 8]
L: Waktu Tuhan pasti yang terbaik

songs.title: warta sepekan minggu 26
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bagian 1]
L: 1 Pada hari Selasa dan Jumat ada Mezbah Doa bersama dengan Bapak Gembala Pembina Rayon 12 Pekanbaru Pdt. Gede Widiada yang kita ikuti secara Live Streaming di Gereja GBI Miga dimulai pukul 19.00 wib s/d selesai. Kami mengundang seluruh pengerja  untuk kita bisa mengikutinya bersama.

[Bagian 2]
L: 2. Bagi bapak ibu yang tidak bisa hadir digereja, dapat mengikutinya secara live streaming melalui facebook GBI Gihon Multimedia. Mezbah Doa ini sangat membangun Iman kita dalam menghadapi keadaan hari-hari ini.

[Bagian 3]
L: 3. Pada hari kamis ada latihan musik pukul 19.30 wib bertempat digereja ini. Bagi bapak ibu saudara yang tidak tau tentang musik tapi memiliki kerinduan untuk  belajar musik dapat bergabung bersama dengan tim musik ditempat ini.

[Bagian 4]
L: 4. Pada hari jumat ada Doa Bersama Pengerja Bertempat Digereja ini Pukul 19.30 wib, selesai Mezbah Doa. Seluruh Pengerja Wajib Mengikutinya, Dan kami Juga Mengundang Seluruh Jemaat Untuk Datang Bergabung Dalam Doa bersama.

[Bagian 5]
L: 5. Pada hari Sabtu ada latihan ibadah raya yang dimulai pukul 19.30 wib digereja ini. Seluruh Tim PPW yang melayani pada ibadah raya diwajibkan untuk mengikutinya..

[Bagian 6]
L: 6. Minggu, 02 Agustus 2020
L: -  Ada Doa PIR Bersama Pelayan Pukul 05.00 wib, Bertempat  Di Gereja Ini. Dihimbau kepada Seluruh pelayan untuk  Mengikutinya.
L: -  Ibadah Raya Bertempat di Gereja Ini, Dimulai Pukul 10.00wib, Kami Mengundang Seluruh Jemaat Untuk Beribadah bersama dan Mengajak keluarga merasakan hadirat dan Lawatan Tuhan Di tempat ini.

[Bagian 7]
L: Warta tambahan :
L: 1. Bagi Bapak/ibu/saudara pernah di baptis atau pun pernah menyerahkan anak melalui gereja ini tetapi belum mendapatkan surat akta baptisan/penyerahan anak, dapat diurus kembali dengan mengisi formulir yang telah disediakan. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut dapat menghubungi bapak Pdp. Syukur Zega

[Bagian 8]
L: 2. Gereja membuka pendaftaran Bagi Bapak/ibu/saudara yang rindu untuk dibaptis selam sesuai dengan Amanat Agung Tuhan Yesus.  Untuk informasi pendaftaran dapat menghubungi sekretaris Gereja (Diana Zalukhu/Ibu I.Melki Zega)

[Bagian 9]
L: 3. Dalam rangka meningkatkan pelayanan gereja kepada seluruh jemaat Tuhan, gereja membutuhkan data jemaat yang valid, Jadi bagi bapak ibu saudara yang ingin status ke Jemaatannya terdaftar di GBI Miga, kami menghimbau untuk dapat mengisi Formulir KKJ (Kartu Keluarga Jemaat) yang dapat diambil melalui Sekretaris gereja Ibu Diana Zalukhu. Hal Ini sangat membantu Gereja dalam menerima setiap Pelayanan kepada Jemaat, Khususnya dalam pelaksanaan Sakramen Penyerahan Anak, Pernikahan,Penguburan dan Lain-lain.

[Bagian 10]
L: 4. Setelah ibadah ini selesai, ada evaluasi bersama seluruh pengerja. Kami menghimbau seluruh pengerja intuk menghadirinya.

songs.title: Ya Allah Abad dan Zaman
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Allah abad dan zaman,
L: baik dalam t'rang dan g'lap,
L: 'Kau bagi kami s'kalian
L: perlindungan tetap.
L: 2
L: Di dalam naung arasy-Mu
L: tempat keamanan.
L: Dan barangsiapa mengeluh
L: mendapat tolongan.
L: 3
L: Seb'lum menjadi dunia,
L: dipanggil firman-Mu,
L: Engkau, ya Allah, adalah
L: kekal kuasa-Mu.
L: 4
L: Kau pandang abad yang lenyap
L: dan zaman yang lepas,
L: sebagai bayang awan yang
L: ditiup angin d'ras.
L: 5
L: Manusia dihanyutkan
L: di arus dunia,
L: dan segera dilupakan
L: sebagai mimpinya.
L: 6
L: Ya Allah abad dan zaman,
L: b'ri t'rang-Mu dalam g'lap.
L: B'ri kami pun sekalian,
L: perlindungan tetap.

songs.title: Ya Allahku, Cahaya-Mu Terang Kudus Belaka
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Allahku, cahaya-Mu terang kudus belaka,
L: dan kamilah manusia berdosa bercelaka.
L: 2
L: Cahaya-Nya, terang cerah, b'ri bintang suram jua
L: dan apakah manusia di had'rat Tuhan Hua?
L: 3
L: Kemanakah manusia mencari s'lamat juga?
L: Kepada-Mu, kar'na Anak-Mu membuka jalan sorga.
L: 4
L: Ya amin, ya di Golgota ternyata pengasihan,
L: di sanalah anugerah menjamin keampunan.
L: 5
L: Ya Penebus, b'ri Roh Kudus mengganti roh yang mati
L: iman teguh dan kasihku bertambah dalam hati.

songs.title: Ya Anak Kecil, Ya Anak Lembut
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut,
L: di kandang-Mu 'ku bertelut.
L: 'Ngkau lahir, miskin dan rendah,
L: 'kan melepaskan dunia
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut.
L: 2
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut.
L: Yang tidak suka merebut
L: kuasa dan kekayaan,
L: Yang Roh-Mu Roh Pengasihan.
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut.
L: 3
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut,
L: rendah-Mu itu menjemput
L: manusia sekalian
L: ke dalam T'rang Kerajaan.
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Anak lembut.
L: 4
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Tuhan kudus,
L: ya Anak Allah, Penebus.
L: Telah terbuka hatiku,
L: 'Ngkau masuk dengan kasih-Mu.
L: Ya Anak kecil, ya Tuhan Kudus.

songs.title: Ya Bapa Kami Mahabaik
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Bapa kami Mahabaik, ke sorga doa kami naik:
L: Kiranya dalam dunia nama-Mu dikuduskanlah,
L: malaikat menyembah sujud, segala bangsa bertelut.
L: 2
L: Datangkanlah kerajaan yang sudah Kausediakan.
L: B'ri kehendak-Mu jadilah: di sorga dan di dunia,
L: Sehingga bumi pun penuh sejaht'ra kebenaran-Mu.
L: 3
L: Hari ini juga apalah, b'ri makanan secukupnya.
L: Kiranya angkatlah beban, kuatir dan ketakutan.
L: B'ri kami tunjuk kasih-Mu kepada lain yang mengeluh.
L: 4
L: Ampunkanlah kesalahan, seperti kami ampunkan.
L: Segala salah seteru; kiranya b'ri tolongan-Mu.
L: Kuasa jahat basmilah dan jauhkanlah godaannya.
L: 5
L: Engkaulah yang mempunyai Kerajaan yang berseri.
L: kuasa-Mu kekal teguh, baka kemuliaan-Mu.
L: Engkau yang patut disembah, tetap selama-lamanya.

songs.title: Ya Bapa, Tilik dalam Rahmat-Mu
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Bapa, tilik dalam rahmat-Mu, jemaat-Mu yang Kau
L: kumpulkan di sini. Menghadap kami dengan anak
L: ini, sebab percaya perjajian-Mu.
L: 2
L: Jemaat beroleh kesucianya.
L: di nama-Mu, ya Bapa yang di sorga, dan anak-Nya pun dikuduskan juga.
L: B'ri Kristus hidup dalam batinnya.
L: 3
L: Kiranya oleh Roh dan sabda-Mu
L: roh anak diterangi, diperkuat
L: dan hatinya hendaklah Kauperbuat
L: 'kan tempat diam kebenaran-Mu.
L: 4
L: Ditahbiskanlah ia bagi-Mu
L: dan namanya yang kini ditentukan
L: Kautulis dalam kitab kehidupan,
L: B'ri hidupnya menurut maksud-Mu.

songs.title: Ya, Datanglah, Immanuel! Merindu Kaum-Mu I
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya, datanglah, Immanuel! Merindu kaum-Mu Israel.
L: K'lam kabut 'nutup dunia, yang putus asa rupanya.
L: Bersukacita, Israel! Kan datanglah Immanuel!
L: 2
L: Dahulu t'lah Kauantarkan kaum Israel ke Kanaan.
L: Ya, turun dari sorga, Hu dan lawat pula umat-Mu.
L: Bersukacita, Israel! 'Kan datang Immanuel!
L: 3
L: Ya Putera perjanjian, kerjakanlah perdamaian;
L: b'ri kasih-Mu t'rang benderang, dan seg'nap dunia terang.
L: Bersukacita, Israel! 'Kan datanglah Immanuel!
L: 4
L: Ya datang, Tuhan Penebus, 'Ngkau Anak Bapa yang kuds,
L: sengsara naik ke puncaknya; Penolong kami, datanglah!
L: Bersukacita, Israel! 'Kan datanglah Immanuel!

songs.title: Ya Khalik Dunia
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Khalik dunia, firman-Mu yang telah
L: memanggil t'rang.
L: Jemaat-Mu berseru: b'ri dunia penuh
L: dengan cahaya-Mu; t'rang-Mu menang!
L: 2
L: Tak buta yang telah Kaubuka matanya,
L: rohnya terang.
L: Bumi pun mengeluh, buta kena semu;
L: b'ri matanya sembuh; t'rang-Mu menang!
L: 3
L: Dalam terang cerah Kasih-Mu yang baka,
L: hati senang.
L: Bapa, berfirmanlah di atas dunia,
L: di malam dosanya: "jadilah t'rang!"

songs.title: Ya Roh Penyuci, Turunlah
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Roh Penyuci, turunlah dan curahkan karunia,
L: supaya hati yang cemar menjadi suci dan benar.
L: 2
L: Penghibur, sumber air hayat, Pembagi kasih dan berkat,
L: b'ri kami beriman teguh dan tubuh kami rumah-Mu.
L: 3
L: Kiranya api yang kudus di dunia menyala t'rus
L: dan kesungguhan-Mu cerah. Ya Roh Penghibur, datanglah!

songs.title: Ya Tuhan, Bimbing Aku di Jalanku
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Tuhan, bimbing aku di jalanku.
L: B'ri tanganku kutaruh di tangan-Mu.
L: Karna anak-Mu sendiri tiada tahu
L: berjalan dan berdiri jik' Engkau jauh.
L: 2
L: Di tengah angin ribut dan ombak laut
L: b'ri jangan aku takut bahaya maut.
L: Kulihat bergemilang cahaya-Mu.
L: Berilah jangan hilang percayaku.
L: 3
L: Dan kalau tersembunyi kuasa-Mu
L: dan dalam gurun sunyi jalananku,
L: Tentu maksud-Mu nanti kulihatlah,
L: ketika'ku berhenti di t'rang baka.

songs.title: Ya Tuhan, Kami Puji Nama-Mu Besar
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Tuhan, kami puji nama-Mu besar.
L: Ya Bapa, makhluk-Mu menyanyi bergemar.

L: Hai, langit, bumi, laut bersoraklah semua.
L: Malaikat turutlah memuji Allah Hua.

L: Kemuliaan-Nya tetap senantiasa.
L: Kudus, kudus, kuduslah Tuhan Mahakuasa.

[Bait 2]
L: Rasul-Mu di tempat kemuliaan-Mu,
L: nabi dan syahid-Mu memuji Engkau, Hu.

L: Jemaat yang t'lah menang, jemaat diperjuangan
L: mengaku nama-Mu, sehati, berulangan.

L: Terpuji rahmat-Mu, di bawah dan di atas.
L: Ya Bapa yang kekal, kasih-Mu tak terbatas.

[Bait 3]
L: Ya Kristus yang di tangan kanan Bapa-Mu,
L: sehingga nanti sangkakala menderu

L: memanggil kami pun menghadap arasy Tuhan,
L: b'ri kami oleh-Mu benar di penghukuman;

L: segala dosa kami Engkau tanggung juga,
L: oleh-Mu kami lihat Bapa yang di sorga.

[Bait 4]
L: Rohu'lkudus, berilah hati beriman,
L: persekutuan-Mu dengan kesucian,

L: supaya kami janganlah percaya diri
L: dan janganlah sesat ke kanan dan ke kiri.

L: Ya Bapa, Anak, Roh, b'ri kami mengalami
L: serta-Mu nanti kepenuhan harap kami.

songs.title: Ya Tuhan, Murah-Mu Baka
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Tuhan, murah-Mu baka.
L: Di sorga dan di dunia
L: berlimpahlah anugerah
L: yang Kauberi.
L: 2
L: Ya Tuhan, kami tidak laik.
L: Terimalah syukur yang naik,
L: kar'na karunia yang baik,
L: yang kauberi.
L: 3
L: Kar'na segala tumbuhan,
L: dan berkat buah-buahan,
L: dan makanan dan minuman,
L: yang Kauberi.
L: 4
L: Kar'na kesukaan kerja,
L: dan rumah dengan berkatnya,
L: bahagia sejahtera,
L: yang Kauberi.
L: 5
L: Tidak terbalas kasihan,
L: yang memberi keampunan,
L: Anugerah kes'lamatan,
L: yang Kauberi.
L: 6
L: Dan Anak-Mu sendirilah.
L: yang menebus manusia
L: dengan salib dan mati-Nya
L: yang Kauberi.
L: 7
L: Terima hormat dan sembah,
L: terima hidup dan kerja
L: dengan sekalian benda,
L: yang Kauberi.

songs.title: Ya Tuhan, Pada-Mu Tak Ada Malam G'lap
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Tuhan, pada-Mu tak ada malam g'lap.
L: Di sana kabut dunia diganti t'rang tetap.
L: 2
L: Di dalam siang-Mu lenyap kedukaan
L: bekas air mata yang sedih hendak dihapuskan.
L: 3
L: Di kawan yang besar yang putih jubahnya
L: tak mungkin satu dosa pun cemarkan sukanya.
L: 4
L: Tak ada lagi maut di t'rang-Mu yang baka.
L: Yang bangun dalam rumah-Mu, baharu hidupnya.
L: 5
L: Penganjur yang kudus, Kaupimpin anak-Mu
L: di jalan duka, dosa, maut, kepada rumah-Mu!

songs.title: Ya Tuhan punyaMulah
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bagian 1]
L: Ya Tuhan punyaMulah
L: kebesaran dan kejayaan

[Bagian 2]
L: Ya Tuhan punyaMulah kehormatan dan kemasyuran
L: Dan keagungan

[Bagian 3]
L: Segala yang di langit dan yang di bumi
L: KepunyaanMu

[Bagian 4]
L: Hosana bagi sang Raja
L: Hosana di tempat yang mahatinggi

[Bagian 5]
L: Hosana, hosana, hosana bagi Dia

songs.title: Ya Yesus Kristus, T'rang Baka
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Yesus Kristus, T'rang Baka
L: yang menerangi dunia,
L: meskipun siang jadi g'lap
L: dan sinar bulan pun lenyap.
L: 2
L: B'ri kami pun, kecil besar
L: terlindung waktu tak sadar.
L: Dan jauhkanlah kesusahan
L: bahaya dan penggodaan.
L: 3
L: B'ri kami hati yang teduh,
L: sedia bagi datang-Mu,
L: dan yang penuh pengharapan,
L: Kauampunkan kesalahan.
L: 4
L: Di waktu perjuangan pun
L: b'ri kami dapat bertekun,
L: dan jangan biar seteru
L: merugikan jemaat-Mu.
L: 5
L: kiranya segenap jemaat,
L: meski salib menindih b'rat,
L: bersuka dalam suka-Mu.
L: Ber percayanya teguh.
L: 6
L: Besarlah susah dunia;
L: dengarkan juga doanya,
L: hiburkanlah yang meneluh,
L: yang sakit jadikan sembuh.
L: 7
L: Kasih-Mu, Bapa, tunjuklah,
L: ya Anak, b'ri anugerah,
L: ya Roh, b'ri kami s'kalian
L: kudus dan dipersatukan

songs.title: Ya Yesus, 'Ngkau Bersalah Bagaimana
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Ya Yesus, 'Ngkau bersalah bagaimana,
L: sehingga patut 'Ngkau kena bencana?
L: Siapakah yang menyebut tuduhan
L: melawan Tuhan?
L: 2
L: 'Ngkau disesah, diejek, diludahi,
L: dan tubuh-Mu yang suci dilukai,
L: mahkota duri menekan kepala
L: yang tak bersalah.
L: 3
L: Rahasia ini mengkinkah ketara,
L: mengapa Engkau yang kena sengsara?
L: Siapakah yang dapat menerangkan
L: 'Ngkau dipalangkan?
L: 4
L: Ajaib benar pengasihan Gembala
L: yang mati ganti domba yang bersalah!
L: Ya Tuhan, utang hamba-Mu semua
L: Kautanggung jua.
L: 5
L: 'Ngkau mengorbankan diri sampai mati;
L: kepada-Mu kupersembahkan hati.
L: Curahkan kasih-Mu yang tak terduga
L: di rohku juga!

songs.title: Yang Tuhan di Sorga Menjadi Rendah
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Yang Tuhan di sorga menjadi rendah,
L: manusia sungguh dan tak bercela,
L: Yang Mahakuasa, lemah dan lembut
L: berbaring di kandang, hai, mari sujud!
L: Hai, puji kasih-Nya dan turut sembah,
L: sebab dosa dunia diampunkan-Nya.
L: 2
L: Di sini Immanuel, Anak kudus;
L: t'lah turun ke bumi salam Penebus.
L: kuasa-Nya atas seg'nap dunia;
L: sejah'tra dan damai kerajaan-Nya.
L: 3
L: Mulialah sabda kudus dan baka,
L: di sini teranglah kesungguhan-Nya.
L: Ya, Anak di kandang, kejadian-Mu
L: menghukumkan dusta selamat semu.

songs.title: Yesus Hidup! Sungguhlah
songs.copyright: Dari database lagu jemaat (EasyWorship). Hak cipta milik pencipta masing-masing.
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Yesus hidup! Sungguhlah, kalah maut dandukacita!
L: Yesus hidup, suara-Nya nanti membangunkan kita.
L: Tuhan, kebangkitan-Mu Itu penghiburanku.
L: 2
L: Yesus hidup! Kuasa-Nya dihormati senantiasa.

L: Dari Bukit Sion kes'lamatan datang

songs.title: A Heart Like Thine
songs.author: Judson Van DeVenter
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Come to my soul, blessed Jesus.
L: Hear me, O Savior divine.
L: Open the fountain and cleanse me.
L: Give me a heart a heart like Thine.

[Bait 1]
L: Give me a love that knows no ill.
L: Give me the grace to do Thy will.
L: Pardon and cleanse this soul of mine.
L: Give me a heart like Thine.

[Bait 2]
L: Only a joy, a few brief years,
L: Only a dream, a vale of tears;
L: Vain is this world, I now resign.
L: Give me a heart like Thine.

[Bait 3]
L: Open mine eyes that I may see.
L: Show me the cross of Calvary.
L: There may I go and not repine.
L: Give me a heart like Thine.

[Bait 4]
L: Pillow my head upon Thy breast.
L: Shelter my soul and give me rest.
L: Fill me with love as I recline.
L: Give me a heart like Thine.

songs.title: A Mighty Fortress Is Our God

songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: A mighty fortress is our God,
L: A bulwark never failing,
L: A bulwark never failing,
L: Bulwark never failing,
L: A bulwark never failing,
L: A bulwark never failing,
L: A bulwark never failing.

[Bait 2]
L: Our helper He amid the,
L: Flood our helper He,
L: Our helper amid the flood,
L: Of mortal ills prevailing,
L: Mid mortal ills prevailing,

[Bait 3]
L: For still our ancient foe,
L: For still our ancient foe,
L: Doth seek for us woe,
L: Doth seek for us woe,
L: With craft and great might,
L: With craft and great might,

[Bait 4]
L: Armed with cruel hate,
L: And armed with cruel hate,
L: And armed with cruel hate,
L: On earth is none His equal,
L: On earth is none equal.

songs.title: A New Name In Glory
songs.author: C. Austin Miles
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: There's a new name
L: Written down in glory,
L: And it's mine.
L: O yes, it's mine!
L: And the white-robed
L: Angels sing the story,
L: "A sinner has come home."

L: For there's a new name
L: Written down in glory,
L: And it's mine,
L: O yes it's mine.
L: With my sins forgiven
L: I am bound for heaven,
L: Nevermore to roam.

[Bait 1]
L: I was once a sinner, but I came
L: Pardon to receive from my Lord.
L: This was freely given, and I found
L: That He always kept His word.

[Bait 2]
L: I was humbly kneeling at the Cross,
L: Fearing naught but God's angry frown,
L: When the heavens opened and I saw
L: That my name was written down.

[Bait 3]
L: In the Book 'tis written
L: "Saved by grace."
L: O the joy that came to my soul!
L: Now I am forgiven and I know,
L: By the blood I am made whole.

songs.title: A Robe Of White
songs.author: Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: For Jesus is my Savior
L: He paid my debt on Calv'ry's mountain;
L: I'm happy in His wondrous love
L: I'm drinking, yes,
L: I'm drinking at the fountain.

[Bait 1]
L: A robe of white, a crown of gold,
L: A harp, a home, a mansion fair;
L: A victor's palm and joy untold,
L: Are mine when I get there.

songs.title: Abide With Me
songs.author: Henry F. Lyte William H. Monk
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Abide with me!
L: Fast falls the eventide.
L: The darkness deepens;
L: Lord, with me abide!
L: When other helpers fail
L: And comforts flee,
L: Help of the helpless,
L: Oh abide with me!

[Bait 2]
L: Swift to its close ebbs out
L: Life's little day.
L: Earth's joys grow dim;
L: Its glories pass away.
L: Change and decay
L: In all around I see;
L: O Thou, who changest not,
L: Abide with me!

[Bait 3]
L: I need Thy presence
L: Every passing hour.
L: What but Thy grace
L: Can foil the tempter's power?
L: Who, like Thyself,
L: My guide and stay can be?
L: Through cloud and sunshine,
L: Lord, abide with me.

[Bait 4]
L: I fear no foe,
L: With Thee at hand to bless;
L: Ills have no weight,
L: And tears no bitterness.
L: Where is death's sting?
L: Where, grave, thy victory?
L: I triumph still,
L: If Thou abide with me.

[Bait 5]
L: Hold Thou Thy cross
L: Before my closing eyes;
L: Shine through the gloom
L: And point me to the skies.
L: Heaven's morning breaks,
L: And earth's vain shadows flee!
L: In life, in death,
L: O Lord, abide with me!

songs.title: Alas And Did My Savior Bleed
songs.author: Hugh Wilson Isaac Watts
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Alas, and did my Savior bleed
L: And did my Sovereign die?
L: Would He devote that sacred head,
L: For such a worm as I.

[Bait 2]
L: Was it for crimes that I have done,
L: He suffered on the tree?
L: Amazing pity, grace unknown,
L: And love beyond degree!

[Bait 3]
L: Well might the sun in darkness hide
L: And shut His glories in;
L: When Christ the mighty Maker died
L: For man, the creature's sin.

[Bait 4]
L: Thus might I hide my blushing face
L: While His dear cross appears;
L: Dissolve my heart in thankfulness
L: And melt mine eyes to tears.

[Bait 5]
L: But drops of grief can ne'er repay,
L: The debt of love I owe;
L: Here, Lord, I give myself away,
L: 'Tis all that I can do.

songs.title: All Creatures Of Our God And King

songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: All creatures of our God and King,
L: Lift up your voice and with us sing,
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Thou burning sun with golden beam,
L: Thou silver moon with softer gleam,
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 2]
L: Thou rushing wind that art so strong,
L: Ye clouds that sail in heaven along,
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: Thou rising morn, in praise rejoice;
L: Ye lights of evening, find a voice!
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 3]
L: Thou flowing water, pure and clear,
L: Make music for thy Lord to hear.
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Thou fire so masterful and bright,
L: Thou givest man both warmth and light!
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 4]
L: And all ye men of tender heart,
L: Forgiving others take your part.
L: O sing ye! Alleluia!
L: Ye who long pain and sorrow bear,
L: Praise God and on Him cast your care!
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 5]
L: Let all things their Creator bless,
L: And worship Him in humbleness.
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: Praise, praise the Father, praise the Son,
L: And praise the Spirit, Three in One!
L: O praise Him! O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 6]
L: Earth ever fertile day by day,
L: Bring forth Your blessings on our way,
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: All fruit and crops that richly grow,
L: All trees and flowers God's glory show.
L: O praise Him! O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 7]
L: People and nations take your part,
L: Love and forgive with all your heart,
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: All who long pain and sorrow bear,
L: Trust God and cast on Him your care.
L: O praise Him! O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 8]
L: Death once the ancient enemy,
L: Hear now our Easter melody,
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: You are the pathway home to God,
L: Our door to life through Christ our Lord.
L: O praise Him! O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 9]
L: Praise God from whom all blessings flow;
L: Praise Him all creatures here below;
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: Praise Him above ye heavenly hosts,
L: Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 10]
L: Dear mother earth, who day by day
L: Unfoldest blessings on our way,
L: O praise Him! Alleluia!
L: The flowers and fruits that in Thee grow,
L: Let them His glory also show;
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

[Bait 11]
L: And thou, most kind and gentle death,
L: Waiting to hush our latest breath,
L: O praise Him, Alleluia!
L: Thou leadest home the child of God,
L: And Christ our Lord the way hath trod;
L: O praise Him, O praise Him!
L: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

songs.title: All Hail The Power Of Jesus Name
songs.author: Edward Perronet James Ellor John (adapted) Rippon
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: And crown Him crown Him,
L: Crown Him crown Him,
L: And crown Him Lord of all.

[Bait 1]
L: All hail the pow'r of Jesus' name,
L: Let angels prostrate fall,
L: Let angels prostrate fall,
L: Bring forth the royal diadem.

[Bait 2]
L: Ye chosen seed of Israel's race,
L: Ye ransomed from the fall,
L: Ye ransomed from the fall,
L: Hail Him who saves you by His grace.

[Bait 3]
L: Let every kindred ev'ry tribe,
L: On this terrestrial ball,
L: On this terrestrial ball,
L: To Him all majesty ascribe.

[Bait 4]
L: O that with yonder sacred throng,
L: We at His feet may fall,
L: We at His feet may fall,
L: We'll join the everlasting song.

songs.title: All People That On Earth Do Dwell
songs.author: Ken Thomas Louis Bourgeois William Kethe
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: All people that on earth do dwell,
L: Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
L: Him serve with fear His praise forth tell,
L: Come ye before Him and rejoice.

[Bait 2]
L: The Lord, ye know, is God indeed,
L: Without our aid He did us make;
L: We are His flock, He doth us fee
L: And for His sheep He doth us take.

[Bait 3]
L: O, enter then His gates with praise,
L: Approach with joy His courts unto;
L: Praise laud and bless His name always,
L: For it is seemly so to do.

[Bait 4]
L: For why the Lord our God is good,
L: His mercy is forever sure;
L: His truth at all times firmly stood,
L: And shall from age to age endure.

[Bait 5]
L: Praise God from whom
L: All blessings flow.
L: Praise Him
L: All creatures here below.
L: Praise Him above
L: Ye heav'nly host.
L: Praise Father, Son,
L: And Holy Ghost.

songs.title: Alleluia Alleluia
songs.author: Christopher Wordsworth Ludwig van Beethoven
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Hearts to heaven and voices raise;
L: Sing to God a hymn of gladness,
L: Sing to God a hymn of praise.
L: He who on the cross as Savior,
L: For the world's salvation bled;
L: Jesus Christ, the King of Glory,
L: Now is risen from the dead.

[Bait 2]
L: Now the iron bars are broken,
L: Christ from death to life is born,
L: Glorious life, and life immortal,
L: On this resurrection morn;
L: Christ has triumphed, and we conquer
L: By His mighty enterprise;
L: We with Him to life eternal,
L: By His resurrection rise.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.author: John Newton
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Amazing grace how sweet the sound,
L: That saved a wretch like me;
L: I once was lost, but now am found
L: Was blind, but now I see.

[Bait 2]
L: T'was grace that taught my heart to fear,
L: And grace my fears relieved;
L: How precious did that grace appear
L: The hour I first believed.

[Bait 3]
L: Through many dangers, toil and snares,
L: I have already come;
L: 'Tis grace has brought me safe thus far,
L: And grace will lead me home.

[Bait 4]
L: When we've been there ten thousand years
L: Bright shining as the sun,
L: We've no less days to sing God's praise
L: Than when we've first begun.

songs.title: America The Beautiful
songs.author: Katherine Lee Bates Samuel A. Ward
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O beautiful for spacious skies,
L: For amber waves of grain,
L: For purple mountains majesties
L: Above the fruited plain!
L: America! America!
L: God shed His grace on thee,
L: And crown thy good with brotherhood
L: From sea to shining sea!

[Bait 2]
L: O beautiful for pilgrim feet,
L: Whose stern, impassioned stress
L: A thoroughfare for freedom beat
L: Across the wilderness!
L: America! America!
L: God mend thine ev'ry flaw.
L: Confirm thy soul in self control,
L: Thy liberty in law!

[Bait 3]
L: O beautiful for heroes proved
L: In liberating strife,
L: Who more than self their country loved,
L: And mercy more than life!
L: America! America!
L: May God thy gold refine
L: Till all success be nobleness
L: And every gain divine!

[Bait 4]
L: O beautiful for patriot dream
L: That sees beyond the years
L: Thine alabaster cities gleam,
L: Undimmed by human tears!
L: America! America!
L: God shed His grace on thee,
L: And crown thy good with brotherhood
L: From sea to shining sea.

[Bait 5]
L: O beautiful for men of faith
L: Who founded this great land;
L: Proclaimed for us, "In God we trust,"
L: And held to God's strong hand.
L: America! America!
L: God shed His grace on thee
L: Till lives confess His righteousness
L: From sea to shining sea.

songs.title: America
songs.author: Henry Carey Samuel F. Smith
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: My country, 'tis of Thee,
L: Sweet land of liberty,
L: Of Thee I sing:
L: Land where my fathers died,
L: Land of the pilgrims' pride,
L: From every mountain side
L: Let freedom ring!

[Bait 2]
L: My native country, thee,
L: Land of the noble, free,
L: Thy name I love:
L: I love Thy rocks and rills,
L: Thy woods and templed hill;
L: My heart with rapture thrills
L: Like that above.

[Bait 3]
L: Let music swell the breeze,
L: And ring from all the trees
L: Sweet freedom's song:
L: Let mortal tongues awake;
L: Let all that breathe partake;
L: Let rocks their silence break,
L: The sound prolong.

[Bait 4]
L: Our fathers' God, to Thee,
L: Author of liberty,
L: To Thee we sing:
L: Long may our land be bright
L: With freedom's holy light;
L: Protect us by Thy might,
L: Great God, our King!

songs.title: And Can It Be
songs.author: Charles Wesley Thomas Campbell
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Amazing love! How can it be
L: That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

[Bait 1]
L: And can it be that I should gain
L: An interest in the Savior's blood?
L: Died He for me, who caused His pain?
L: For me, who Him to death pursued?

[Bait 2]
L: He left His Father's throne above,
L: So free, so infinite His grace;
L: Emptied Himself of all but love,
L: And bled for Adam's helpless race.
L: 'Tis mercy all, immense and free!
L: For, O my God it found out me!

[Bait 3]
L: No condemnation now I dread;
L: Jesus, and all in Him, is mine!
L: Alive in Him my living Head,
L: And clothed in righteousness divine,
L: Bold I approach the eternal throne,
L: And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

[Bait 4]
L: 'Tis mystery all! The Immortal dies!
L: Who can explore His strange design?
L: In vain the first born seraph tries
L: To sound the depths of love divine!
L: 'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore,
L: Let angel minds inquire no more.

[Bait 5]
L: Long my imprisoned Spirit lay
L: Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
L: Thine eye diffused a quickening ray,
L: I woke, the dungeon flamed with light;
L: My chains fell off, my heart was free;
L: I rose, went forth and followed Thee.

songs.title: Angels From The Realms Of Glory
songs.author: James Montgomery
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Angels from the realms of glory,
L: Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
L: Ye who sang creation's story,
L: Now proclaim Messiah's birth.
L: Come and worship, come and worship;
L: Worship Christ, the new-born King!

[Bait 2]
L: Shepherds in the fields abiding,
L: Watching o'er your flocks by night;
L: God with man is now residing,
L: Yonder shines the infant Light.
L: Come and worship, come and worship;
L: Worship Christ, the new-born King!

[Bait 3]
L: Sages, leave your contemplation's,
L: Brighter visions beam afar;
L: Seek the great Desire of nations,
L: Ye have seen His natal star.
L: Come and worship, come and worship;
L: Worship Christ, the new-born King!

[Bait 4]
L: Saints, before the altar bending,
L: Watching long in hope and fear;
L: Suddenly the Lord, descending,
L: In His temple shall appear.
L: Come and worship, come and worship;
L: Worship Christ, the new-born King!

[Bait 5]
L: All creation, join in praising,
L: God, the Father, Spirit, Son;
L: Evermore your voices raising,
L: To the eternal Three in One.
L: Come and worship, come and worship;
L: Worship Christ, the new-born King!

songs.title: Angels We Have Heard On High
songs.author: Edward Shippen Barnes James Chadwick
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Gloria, in excelsis Deo!
L: Gloria, in excelsis Deo!

[Bait 1]
L: Angels we have heard on high,
L: Sweetly singing o'er the plains;
L: And the mountains in reply,
L: Echoing their joyous strains.

[Bait 2]
L: Shepherds, why this jubilee?
L: Why your joyous strains prolong?
L: Say what may the tidings be;
L: Which inspire your heav'nly song?

[Bait 3]
L: Come to Bethlehem and see,
L: Him whose birth the angels sing;
L: Come adore on bended knee,
L: Christ the Lord, the newborn King.

[Bait 4]
L: See within a manger laid,
L: Jesus, Lord of heav'n and earth;
L: Mary, Joseph, lend your aid,
L: With us sing our Savior's birth.

songs.title: Arise My Soul Arise
songs.author: Charles Wesley Daniel B. Towner
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Arise, my soul, arise,
L: Shake off thy guilty fears;
L: The bleeding sacrifice
L: In my behalf appears;
L: Before the throne my surety stands,
L: My name is written on His hands,
L: My name is written on His hands.

[Bait 2]
L: He ever lives above, for me to intercede;
L: His all redeeming love
L: His precious blood to plead;
L: His blood atoned for all our race,
L: And sprinkles now the throne of grace,
L: And sprinkles now the throne of grace.

[Bait 3]
L: The Father hears Him pray,
L: His dear Anointed One;
L: He cannot turn away
L: The presence of His Son:
L: His Spirit answers to the blood,
L: And tells me I am born of God,
L: And tells me I am born of God.

[Bait 4]
L: My God is reconciled,
L: His pardoning voice I hear;
L: He owns me for His child,
L: I can no longer fear;
L: With confidence I now draw nigh,
L: And Father, Abba Father cry,
L: And Father, Abba Father cry!

songs.title: Asleep In Jesus
songs.author: Margaret MacKay William B. Bradbury
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Asleep in Jesus! blessed sleep,
L: From which none ever wakes to weep!
L: A calm and undisturbed repose,
L: Unbroken by the last of foes.

[Bait 2]
L: Asleep in Jesus! O how sweet,
L: To be for such a slumber meet!
L: With holy confidence to sing,
L: That death hath lost its venomed sting.

[Bait 3]
L: Asleep in Jesus! peaceful rest,
L: Whose waking is supremely blest!
L: No fear, no woe, shall dim that hour
L: That manifests the Savior's pow'r.

[Bait 4]
L: Asleep in Jesus! O for me
L: May such a blissful refuge be!
L: Securely shall my ashes lie,
L: And wait the summons from on high.

songs.title: At Calvary
songs.author: Daniel B. Towner William R. Newell
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Mercy there was great and grace was free;
L: Pardon there was multiplied to me;
L: There my burdened soul found liberty,
L: At Calvary.

[Bait 1]
L: Years I spent in vanity and pride,
L: Caring not my Lord was crucified,
L: Knowing not it was for me He died
L: On Calvary.

[Bait 2]
L: By God's Word at last my sin I learned;
L: Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned,
L: Till my guilty soul imploring turned
L: To Calvary.

[Bait 3]
L: Now I've giv'n to Jesus ev'rything;
L: Now I gladly own Him as my King;
L: Now my raptured soul can only sing
L: Of Calvary.

[Bait 4]
L: O the love that drew salvation's plan!
L: O the grace that brought it down to man!
L: O the mighty gulf that God did span
L: At Calvary!

songs.title: At The Cross
songs.author: Isaac Watts Ralph Hudson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: At the cross, at the cross,
L: Where I first saw the light
L: And the burden of my heart rolled away;
L: It was there by faith, I received my sight
L: And now I am happy all the day!

[Bait 1]
L: Alas and did my Savior bleed,
L: And did my sov'reign die?
L: Would He devote that sacred head,
L: For such a worm as I?

[Bait 2]
L: Was it for crimes that I have done,
L: He groaned upon the tree?
L: Amazing pity grace unknown,
L: And love beyond degree!

[Bait 3]
L: Well might the sun in darkness hide,
L: And shut His glories in;
L: When Christ the mighty Maker died,
L: For man the creature's sin.

[Bait 4]
L: But drops of grief can ne'er repay,
L: The debt of love I owe;
L: Here, Lord, I give myself to Thee,
L: 'Tis all that I can do!

[Bait 5]
L: Thus might I hide my blushing face
L: While Calvary's cross appears,
L: Dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
L: And melt mine eyes to tears.

songs.title: Away In A Manger
songs.author: James Ramsey Murray John Thomas McFarland Martin L
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: Battle Hymn Of The Republic
songs.author: Julia Ward Howe William Steffe
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah!
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah!
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah!
L: His truth is marching on.

[Reff 2]
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah.
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah.
L: Glory, glory, hallelujah.
L: Our God is marching on.

[Bait 1]
L: Mine eyes have seen the glory
L: Of the coming of the Lord;
L: He is trampling out the vintage
L: Where the grapes of wrath are stored;
L: He hath loosed the fateful lightning
L: Of His terrible swift sword;
L: His truth is marching on.

[Bait 2]
L: I have seen Him in the watchfires
L: Of a hundred circling camps;
L: They have builded Him an altar
L: In the evening dews and damps;
L: I can read His righteous sentence
L: By the dim and flaring lamps;
L: His day is marching on.

[Bait 3]
L: He has sounded forth the trumpet
L: That shall never sound retreat;
L: He is sifting out the hearts of men
L: Before His judgment seat;
L: O be swift, my soul, to answer Him!
L: Be jubilant, my feet!
L: Our God is marching on.

[Bait 4]
L: In the beauty of the lilies,
L: Christ was born across the sea,
L: With a glory in His bosom
L: That transfigures you and me;
L: As He died to make men holy,
L: Let us live to make men free,
L: While God is marching on.

[Bait 5]
L: Mine eyes have seen the glory
L: Of the coming of the Lord;
L: It is flowing through the cities
L: And the waste will be restored;
L: By the leading of the Spirit
L: And their trusting in His Word,
L: His army marches on.

[Bait 6]
L: Arise and shine my people,
L: See the glory of the Lord;
L: As the church with signs and wonders
L: Marches on in one accord;
L: His soldiers do not falter
L: As for Him they wield the sword,
L: His army marches on.

[Bait 7]
L: O join this mighty army
L: There's a battle to be won;
L: Let us now put in sickle
L: For the harvest time has come;
L: Countless multitudes are waiting
L: Just to hear of God's own Son,
L: His army marches on.

songs.title: Beautiful Garden Of Prayer
songs.author: Eleanor Allen Schroll James H. Fillmore
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O the beautiful garden, the garden of prayer,
L: O the beautiful garden of prayer.
L: There my Savior awaits, and He opens the gates
L: To the beautiful garden of prayer.

[Bait 1]
L: There's a garden where Jesus is waiting,
L: There's a place that is wondrously fair.
L: For it glows with the light of His presence,
L: 'Tis the beautiful garden of prayer.

[Bait 2]
L: There's a garden where Jesus is waiting,
L: And I go with my burden and care.
L: Just to learn from His lips, words of comfort,
L: In the beautiful garden of prayer.

[Bait 3]
L: There's a garden where Jesus is waiting,
L: And He bids you to come meet Him there,
L: Just to bow and receive a new blessing,
L: In the beautiful garden of prayer.

songs.title: Begin My Tongue Some Heavenly Theme
songs.author: Isaac Watts
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Begin my tongue some heav'nly theme
L: And speak some boundless thing;
L: The mighty works or mightier name,
L: Of our eternal King.

[Bait 2]
L: Tell of His wondrous faithfulness
L: And sound His pow'r abroad;
L: Sing the sweet promise of His grace,
L: The love and truth of God.

[Bait 3]
L: His very word of grace is strong,
L: As that which built the skies;
L: The voice that roles the stars along,
L: Speaks all the promises.

[Bait 4]
L: O might I hear Thy heav'nly tongue,
L: But whisper Thou art mine;
L: Those gentle words shall raise my song,
L: To notes almost divine.

songs.title: Beneath The Cross Of Jesus
songs.author: Elizabeth Cecilia Clephane Fredrick Charles Maker
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Beneath the cross of Jesus
L: I fain would take my stand,
L: The shadow of a mighty Rock
L: Within a weary land.
L: A home within the wilderness,
L: A rest upon the way,
L: From the burning of the noontide heat
L: And the burden of the day.

[Bait 2]
L: Upon the cross of Jesus
L: Mine eyes at times can see
L: The very dying form of One
L: Who suffered there for me;
L: And from my smitten heart with tears
L: Two wonders I confess:
L: The wonders of redeeming love
L: And my unworthiness.

[Bait 3]
L: I take, O cross, thy shadow
L: For my abiding place,
L: I ask no other sunshine
L: Than the sunshine of His face.
L: Content to let the world go by,
L: To know no gain nor loss,
L: My sinful self, my only shame,
L: My glory all the cross.

[Bait 4]
L: O safe and happy shelter,
L: O refuge tried and sweet,
L: O trysting place where heaven's love
L: And heaven's justice meet!
L: As to the holy patriarch
L: That wondrous dream was giv'n,
L: So seems my Savior's cross to me,
L: A ladder up to heav'n.

songs.title: Blessed Assurance
songs.author: Fanny Jane Crosby Phoebe Palmer Knapp
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: This is my story, this is my song,
L: Praising my Savior all the day long.
L: This is my story, this is my song,
L: Praising my Savior all the day long.

[Bait 1]
L: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
L: Oh, what a foretaste of glory divine!
L: Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
L: Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood!

[Bait 2]
L: Perfect submission, perfect delight!
L: Visions of rapture now burst at my sight!
L: Angels descending bring from above
L: Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

[Bait 3]
L: Perfect submission, all is at rest.
L: I in my Savior am happy and blest;
L: Watching and waiting, looking above,
L: Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

songs.title: Blessed Be The Name
songs.author: Ralph E. Hudson William H. Clark
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Blessed be the name,
L: Blessed be the name,
L: Blessed be the name of the Lord;
L: Blessed be the name,
L: Blessed be the name,
L: Blessed be the name of the Lord.

[Bait 1]
L: All praise to Him who reigns above,
L: In majesty supreme
L: Who gave His Son for man to die,
L: That He might man redeem!

[Bait 2]
L: His name above all names shall stand,
L: Exalted more and more,
L: At God the Father's own right hand,
L: Where angel hosts adore.

[Bait 3]
L: Redeemer, Savior, Friend of man,
L: Once ruined by the fall,
L: Thou hast devised salvation's plan,
L: For Thou hast died for all.

[Bait 4]
L: His name shall be the Counselor,
L: The mighty Prince of Peace,
L: Of all earth's kingdoms Conqueror,
L: Whose reign shall never cease.

songs.title: Break Forth O Beauteous Heavenly Light
songs.author: Johann Rist Johann Schop John Troutbeck Joseph Bar
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Break forth O beauteous heavenly light
L: And usher in the morning;
L: O shepherds, shudder not with fright,
L: But hear the angel's warning.
L: This Child, now weak in infancy,
L: Our confidence and joy shall be,
L: The power of Satan breaking;
L: Our peace eternal making.

[Bait 2]
L: He comes a Child, from realms on high,
L: He comes the heav'ns adoring;
L: He comes to earth to live and die,
L: A broken race restoring.
L: Although the King of kings is He,
L: He comes in deep humility;
L: His people to deliver,
L: And reign in us forever.

songs.title: Bringing In The Sheaves
songs.author: George A. Minor Knowles Shaw
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Bringing in the sheaves bringing in the sheaves,
L: We shall come rejoicing bringining in the sheaves.
L: Bringing in the sheaves bringing in the sheaves,
L: We shall come rejoicing bringing in the sheaves.

[Bait 1]
L: Sowing in the morning sowing seeds of kindness,
L: Sowing in the noontide and the dewy eve.
L: Waiting for the harvest and the time of reaping,
L: We shall come rejoicing bringing in the sheaves.

[Bait 2]
L: Sowing in the sunshine sowing in the shadows,
L: Fearing neither clouds nor winter's chilling breeze,
L: By and by the harvest and the labour ended,
L: We shall come rejoicing bringing in the sheaves.

[Bait 3]
L: Go then even weeping sowing for the Master.
L: Though the loss sustained our Spirit often grieves.
L: When our weepings over He will bid us welcome,
L: We shall come rejoicing bringing in the sheaves.

songs.title: Children Of The Heavenly Father
songs.author: Caroline Sandell-Berg Ernest W. Olson Oscar Ahnfel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Children of the heavenly Father,
L: Safely in His bosom gather;
L: Nestling bird nor star in heaven
L: Such a refuge e'er was given.

[Bait 2]
L: God His own doth tend and nourish,
L: In His holy courts they flourish;
L: From all evil things He spares them,
L: In His mighty arms He bears them.

[Bait 3]
L: Neither life nor death shall ever,
L: From the Lord His children sever;
L: Unto them His grace He showeth,
L: And their sorrows all He knoweth.

[Bait 4]
L: Lo, their very hairs He numbers,
L: And no daily care encumbers;
L: Them that share His every blessing,
L: And His help in woes distressing.

[Bait 5]
L: Praise the Lord in joyful numbers,
L: Your protector never slumbers;
L: At the will of your defender,
L: Every foe man must surrender.

[Bait 6]
L: Though He giveth or He taketh,
L: God His children ne'er forsaketh;
L: His the loving purpose solely
L: To preserve them pure and holy.

songs.title: Christ Arose
songs.author: Robert Lowry
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Up from the grave He arose,
L: With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
L: He arose a victor
L: From the dark domain
L: And He lives forever
L: With His saints to reign.
L: He arose! He arose!
L: Hallelujah! Christ arose!

[Bait 1]
L: Low in the grave He lay,
L: Jesus my Savior!
L: Waiting the coming day,
L: Jesus my Lord!

[Bait 2]
L: Vainly they watch His bed,
L: Jesus my Savior!
L: Vainly they seal the dead,
L: Jesus my Lord!

[Bait 3]
L: Death cannot keep his prey,
L: Jesus my Savior!
L: He tore the bars away,
L: Jesus my Lord!

songs.title: Christ The Lord Is Risen Today
songs.author: Charles Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
L: Sons of men and angels say: Alleluia!
L: Raise your joys and triumphs high, Alleluia!
L: Sing, ye heavens and earth reply: Alleluia!

[Bait 2]
L: Lives again our glorious King, Alleluia!
L: Where, O death, is now thy sting? Alleluia!
L: Dying once He all doth save, Alleluia!
L: Where thy victory, O grave? Alleluia!

[Bait 3]
L: Love's redeeming work is done, Alleluia!
L: Fought the fight, the battle won, Alleluia!
L: Death in vain forbids Him rise, Alleluia!
L: Christ hath opened paradise, Alleluia!

[Bait 4]
L: Soar we now where Christ has led, Alleluia!
L: Following our exalted Head, Alleluia!
L: Made like Him, like Him we rise, Alleluia!
L: Ours the cross, the grave, the skies, Alleluia!

[Bait 5]
L: Vain the stone, the watch, the seal,
L: Hallelujah!
L: Christ hath burst the gates of hell,
L: Hallelujah!
L: Death in vain forbids His rise,
L: Hallelujah!
L: Christ hath opened paradise,
L: Hallelujah!

songs.title: Close To Thee
songs.author: Fanny Jane Crosby Silas J. Vail
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Thou my everlasting portion,
L: More than friend or life to me;
L: All along my pilgrim journey,
L: Savior, let me walk with Thee.
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee,
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee;
L: All along my pilgrim journey,
L: Savior, let me walk with Thee.

[Bait 2]
L: Not for ease or worldly pleasure,
L: Nor for fame my prayer shall be,
L: Gladly will I toil and suffer,
L: Only let me walk with Thee.
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee,
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee;
L: Gladly will I toil and suffer,
L: Only let me walk with Thee.

[Bait 3]
L: Lead me through the vale of shadows,
L: Bear me over life's fitful sea;
L: Then the gate of life eternal
L: May I enter Lord with Thee.
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee,
L: Close to Thee, close to Thee;
L: Then the gate of life eternal
L: May I enter Lord with Thee.

songs.title: Come Holy Ghost Our Hearts Inspire
songs.author: Charles Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, Holy Ghost, our hearts inspire;
L: Let us Thine influence prove:
L: Source of the old prophetic fire,
L: Fountain of life and love.

[Bait 2]
L: Come, Holy Ghost for moved by Thee
L: The prophets wrote and spoke.
L: Unlock the truth, Thyself the key;
L: Unseal the Sacred Book.

[Bait 3]
L: God, through Himself, we then shall know
L: If Thou within us shine,
L: And sound with all Thy saints below,
L: The depths of love divine.

songs.title: Come Thou Almighty King
songs.author: Charles Wesley Felice De Giardini
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, Thou Almighty King.
L: Help us Thy name to sing.
L: Help us to praise.
L: Father, all glorious,
L: O'er all victorious.
L: Come and reign over us,
L: Ancient of Days.

[Bait 2]
L: Come, Thou Incarnate Word,
L: Gird on Thy mighty sword,
L: Our prayer attend.
L: Come, and Thy people bless,
L: And give Thy Word success.
L: Spirit of holiness,
L: On us descend.

[Bait 3]
L: Come, Holy Comforter,
L: Thy sacred witness bear
L: In this glad hour.
L: Thou who almighty art,
L: Now rule in every heart;
L: And ne'er from us depart,
L: Spirit of power.

[Bait 4]
L: To the great One in Three
L: Eternal praises be
L: Hence evermore.
L: His sovereign majesty
L: May we in glory see,
L: And to eternity
L: Love and adore.

[Bait 5]
L: O Lord, our God, to Thee
L: The highest praises be,
L: Hence, evermore;
L: Thy sov'reign majesty
L: May we in glory see,
L: And to eternity
L: Love and adore.

songs.title: Come Thou Fount
songs.author: John Wyeth Robert Robinson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, Thou fount of every blessing,
L: Tune my heart to sing Thy grace.
L: Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
L: Call for songs of loudest praise.
L: Teach me some melodious sonnet,
L: Sung by flaming tongues above.
L: Praise the mount! I'm fixed upon it,
L: Mount of God's unchanging love.

[Bait 2]
L: Here I raise my Ebenezer;
L: Hither by Thy help I come.
L: And I hope, by Thy good pleasure,
L: Safely to arrive at home.
L: Jesus sought me when a stranger
L: Wand'ring from the fold of God;
L: He, to rescue me from danger,
L: Interposed His precious blood.

[Bait 3]
L: Oh, to grace how great a debtor
L: Daily I'm constrained to be!
L: Let thy grace, Lord, like a fetter,
L: Bind my wand'ring heart to Thee:
L: Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
L: Prone to leave the God I love.
L: Here's my heart, Lord, take and seal it,
L: Seal it for Thy courts above.

[Bait 4]
L: Hither to Thy love has blest me;
L: Thou hast bro't me to this place;
L: And I know Thy hand will bring me
L: Safely home by Thy good grace.
L: Jesus sought me when a stranger,
L: Wandering from the fold of God;
L: He, to rescue me from danger,
L: Bought me with His precious blood.

songs.title: Come Thou Long Expected Jesus
songs.author: Charles Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, Thou long expected Jesus,
L: Born to set Thy people free.
L: From our fears and sins release us;
L: Let us find our rest in Thee.

[Bait 2]
L: Born Thy people to deliver,
L: Born a Child, and yet a King.
L: Born to reign in us forever,
L: Now Thy gracious kingdom bring.

[Bait 3]
L: By Thine own eternal Spirit
L: Rule in all our hearts alone;
L: By Thine all sufficient merit,
L: Raise us to Thy glorious throne.

songs.title: Come We That Love The Lord
songs.author: Aaron Williams Isaac Watts
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, we that love the Lord,
L: And let our joys be known;
L: Join in a song with sweet accord,
L: And thus surround the throne.

[Bait 2]
L: Let those refuse to sing,
L: Who never knew our God;
L: But children of the heavenly King,
L: May speak their joys abroad.

[Bait 3]
L: The hill of Zion yields
L: A thousand sacred sweets,
L: Before we reach the heavenly fields,
L: Or walk the golden streets.

[Bait 4]
L: Then let our songs abound,
L: And every tear be dry;
L: We're marching thru Emmanuel's ground,
L: To fairer worlds on high.

[Bait 5]
L: The men of grace have found
L: Glory begun below;
L: Celestial fruit on earthly ground
L: From faith and hope may grow.

songs.title: Come Ye Thankful People Come
songs.author: George J. Elvey Henry Alford
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Come, ye thankful people, come;
L: Raise the song of harvest home.
L: All is safely gathered in
L: Ere the winter storms begin.
L: God, our maker, doth provide
L: For our wants to be supplied.
L: Come to God's own temple, come;
L: Raise the song of harvest home.

[Bait 2]
L: All the world is God's own field,
L: Fruit unto His praise to yield;
L: Wheat and tares together sown,
L: Unto joy or sorrow grown;
L: First the blade and then the ear,
L: Then the full corn shall appear.
L: Lord of harvest grant that we
L: Wholesome grain and pure may be.

[Bait 3]
L: For the Lord our God shall come,
L: And shall take His harvest home;
L: From His field shall in that day
L: All offenses purge away;
L: Give His angels charge at last
L: In the fire the tares to cast,
L: But the fruitful ears to store
L: In His garner evermore.

[Bait 4]
L: Even so Lord, quickly come
L: To Thy final harvest home;
L: Gather Thou Thy people in,
L: Free from sorrow, free from sin;
L: There forever purified,
L: In Thy presence to abide.
L: Come with all Thine angels come;
L: Raise the glorious harvest home.

songs.title: Count Your Blessings
songs.author: Edwin O. Excell Rev. Johnson Jr. Oatman
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Count your blessings
L: Name them one by one.
L: Count your blessings
L: See what God hath done.
L: Count your blessings
L: Name them one by one.
L: Count your many blessings
L: See what God hath done.

[Bait 1]
L: When upon life's billows
L: You are tempest tossed,
L: When you are discouraged
L: Thinking all is lost,
L: Count your many blessings
L: Name them one by one,
L: And it will surprise you
L: What the Lord hath done.

[Bait 2]
L: Are you ever burdened
L: With a load of care,
L: Does the cross seem heavy
L: You are called to bear.
L: Count your many blessings
L: Every doubt will fly,
L: And you will be singing
L: As the days go by.

[Bait 3]
L: When you look at others
L: With their lands and gold,
L: Think that Christ has promised
L: You His wealth untold.
L: Count your many blessings
L: Money cannot buy,
L: Your reward in heaven
L: Nor your home on high.

[Bait 4]
L: So amid the conflict
L: Whether great or small,
L: Do not be discouraged
L: God is over all.
L: Count your many blessings
L: Angels will attend,
L: Help and comfort give you
L: To your journey's end.

songs.title: Crown Him With Many Crowns
songs.author: George J. Elvey Godfrey Thring Matthew Bridges
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Crown Him with many crowns,
L: The Lamb upon His throne.
L: Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns
L: All music but its own!
L: Awake, my soul and sing
L: Of Him who died for Thee;
L: And hail Him as thy matchless King
L: Through all eternity.

[Bait 2]
L: Crown Him the Lord of love:
L: Behold His hands and side,
L: Rich wounds, yet visible above,
L: In beauty glorified;
L: No angel in the sky
L: Can fully bear that sight,
L: But downwards bends His wondering eye
L: At mysteries so bright.

[Bait 3]
L: Crown Him the Lord of life,
L: Who triumphed o'er the grave.
L: Who rose victorious to the strife,
L: For those He came to save.
L: His glories now we sing,
L: Who died and rose on high.
L: Who died eternal life to bring,
L: And lives that death may die.

[Bait 4]
L: Crown Him the Lord of peace,
L: Whose pow'r a scepter sways
L: From pole to pole,
L: That wars may cease
L: And all be prayer and praise;
L: His reign shall know no end,
L: And round His pierced feet
L: Fair flowers of paradise extend
L: Their fragrance ever sweet.

[Bait 5]
L: Crown Him the Lord of years,
L: The Potentate of time;
L: Creator of the rolling spheres,
L: Ineffably sublime.
L: All hail, Redeemer, hail!
L: For Thou hast died for me.
L: Thy praise and glory shall not fail
L: Throughout eternity.

[Bait 6]
L: Crown Him the Son of God
L: Before the worlds began,
L: And ye, who tread where He hath trod,
L: Crown Him the Son of man;
L: Who every grief hath known
L: That wrings the human breast,
L: And takes and bears them for His own,
L: That all in Him may rest.

[Bait 7]
L: Crown Him the Lord of heaven:
L: One with the Father known,
L: One with the Spirit
L: Through Him given
L: From yonder glorious throne.
L: All hail, Redeemer, hail!
L: For Thou hast died for me;
L: Thy praise and glory shall not fail
L: Throughout eternity.

songs.title: Day By Day
songs.author: Andrew Skoog Carolina V. Sandell Berg Oscar Ahnfel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Day by day and with each passing moment,
L: Strength I find to meet my trials here;
L: Trusting in my Father's wise bestowment,
L: I've no cause for worry or for fear.
L: He whose heart is kind beyond all measure,
L: Give unto each day what He deems best;
L: Lovingly, its part of pain and pleasure,
L: Mingling toil with peace and rest.

[Bait 2]
L: Ev'ry day the Lord Himself is near me
L: With a special mercy for each hour;
L: All my cares He fain would bear and cheer me,
L: He whose name is Counselor and Pow'r.
L: The protection of His child and treasure,
L: Is a charge that on Himself He laid;
L: "As your days, your strength shall be in measure,"
L: This the pledge to me He made.

[Bait 3]
L: Help me then in ev'ry tribulation,
L: So to trust Your promises, O Lord;
L: That I lose not faith's sweet consolation,
L: Offered me within Your holy Word.
L: Help me, Lord, when toil and trouble meeting,
L: E'er to take, as from a Father's hand,
L: One by one, the days, the moments fleeting,
L: Till I reach the promised land.

songs.title: Day Is Dying In The West
songs.author: Mary A. Lathbury William F. Sherwin
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Holy, holy, holy Lord, God of hosts
L: Heav'n and earth are full of Thee;
L: Heav'n and earth are praising Thee,
L: O Lord, Most High.

[Bait 1]
L: Day is dying in the west
L: Heav'n is touching earth with rest;
L: Wait and worship while the night
L: Sets her ev'ning lamps alight,
L: Thro' all the sky.

[Bait 2]
L: Lord of life, beneath the dome,
L: Of the universe Thy home;
L: Gather us who seek Thy face,
L: To the fold of Thy embrace
L: For Thou art nigh.

[Bait 3]
L: While the deep'ning shadows fall
L: Heart of love enfolding all,
L: Thro' the glory and the grace
L: Of the stars that veil Thy face;
L: Our hearts ascend.

[Bait 4]
L: When forever from our sight,
L: Pass the stars the day;
L: The night Lord of angels,
L: On our eyes let eternal morning rise,
L: And shadows end.

songs.title: Down In My Heart
songs.author: George W. Cooke
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: And I'm so happy, so very happy,
L: I've got the love of Jesus in my heart,
L: And I'm so happy, so very happy,
L: I've got the love of Jesus in my heart.

[Bait 1]
L: I've got the joy, joy, joy, joy,
L: Down in my heart, down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart.
L: I've got the joy, joy, joy, joy,
L: Down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart to stay.

[Bait 2]
L: I have the peace
L: That passeth understanding
L: Down in my heart, down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart.
L: I have the peace
L: That passeth understanding
L: Down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart to stay.

[Bait 3]
L: I have the love of Jesus,
L: Love of Jesus, down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart, down in my heart.
L: I have the love of Jesus,
L: Love of Jesus, down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart to stay.

[Bait 4]
L: I've got the wonderful love,
L: Of my blessed Redeemer,
L: Way down in the depths of my heart,
L: Way down in the depths of my heart.
L: Way down in the depths of my heart.
L: I've got the wonderful love,
L: Of my blessed Redeemer,
L: Way down in the depths of my heart,
L: Way down in the depths of my heart to stay.

[Bait 5]
L: For there is therefore now no condemnation,
L: Down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart, down in my heart,
L: For there is therefore now no condemnation,
L: Down in my heart,
L: Down in my heart today.

songs.title: Doxology
songs.author: Louis Bourgeois Thomas Ken
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: Fairest Lord Jesus
songs.author: H.A. Hoffman von Fallersleben Joseph A. Seiss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Fairest Lord Jesus!
L: Ruler of all nature!
L: O Thou of God and man the Son!
L: Thee will I cherish,
L: Thee will I honor,
L: Thou, my soul's glory,
L: Joy, and crown.

[Bait 2]
L: Fair are the meadows;
L: Fairer still the woodlands,
L: Robed in the blooming
L: Garb of spring.
L: Jesus is fairer,
L: Jesus is purer,
L: Who makes the woeful heart to sing.

[Bait 3]
L: Fair is the sunshine,
L: Fairer still the moonlight,
L: And all the twinkling, starry host.
L: Jesus shines brighter,
L: Jesus shines purer,
L: Than all the angels
L: Heav'n can boast.

[Bait 4]
L: Beautiful Savior!
L: Lord of the nations!
L: Son of God and Son of man!
L: Glory and honor, praise adoration,
L: Now and forevermore be Thine!

songs.title: Faith Of Our Fathers
songs.author: Frederick W. Faber Henri F. Hemy
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Faith of our fathers, living still
L: In spite of dungeon, fire and sword!
L: O how our hearts beat high with joy
L: Whene'er we hear that glorious word!
L: Faith of our fathers! Holy faith!
L: We will be true to Thee till death!

[Bait 2]
L: Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
L: Were still in heart and conscience free.
L: How sweet would be their children's fate
L: If they, like them could die for thee!
L: Faith of our fathers! Holy faith!
L: We will be true to Thee till death!

[Bait 3]
L: Faith of our fathers! God's great power
L: Shall win all nations unto thee;
L: And through the truth that comes from God
L: Mankind shall then be truly free.
L: Faith of our fathers! Holy faith!
L: We will be true to thee till death!

[Bait 4]
L: Faith of our fathers we will love
L: Both friend and foe in all our strife;
L: And preach Thee, too, as love knows how,
L: By kindly words and virtuous life.
L: Faith of our fathers! Holy faith!
L: We will be true to Thee till death!

[Bait 5]
L: Faith of our fathers we will strive
L: To win all nations unto Thee!
L: And thro' the truth that comes from God
L: Mankind shall then be truly free:
L: Faith of our fathers! Holy faith!
L: We will be true to Thee till death!

songs.title: For God So Loved The World
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt J. Lincoln Hall
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: For God so loved the world,
L: That He gave His only begotten Son,
L: That whosoever believeth in Him,
L: Whosoever believeth in Him,
L: Should not perish should not perish,
L: But have everlasting life.

[Bait 1]
L: A story sweet and wondrous,
L: Like heavenly music swells.
L: In chimings clear to all who will hear,
L: Ring out the gospel bells.

[Bait 2]
L: When, grieving brokenhearted,
L: Because of sin and shame,
L: We find a joy earth cannot destroy,
L: Believing on His name.

[Bait 3]
L: This love, beyond all measure,
L: Of earth or sea or sky,
L: Could only show its full overflow,
L: When Jesus came to die.

[Bait 4]
L: Come, brother come to Jesus,
L: His word was meant for you;
L: His grace receive, His promise believe,
L: And sing His praise anew.

songs.title: For Unto Us A Child Is Born
songs.author: George Frederick Handel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: For unto us a child is born,
L: Unto us a Son is given,
L: Unto us a Son is given;
L: And His name shall be called
L: Wonderful, Counselor,
L: The mighty God,
L: The Everlasting Father,
L: The Prince of Peace;
L: The Everlasting Father,
L: The Prince of Peace.

songs.title: From Every Stormy Wind
songs.author: Hugh Stowell Thomas Hastings
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: From every stormy wind that blows,
L: From every swelling tide of woes,
L: There is a calm, a sure retreat:
L: 'Tis found beneath the mercy seat.

[Bait 2]
L: There is a place where Jesus sheds
L: The oil of gladness on our heads,
L: A place than all beside more sweet:
L: It is the Blood-bought mercy seat.

[Bait 3]
L: There is a scene where spirits blend,
L: Where friend holds fellowship with friend.
L: Though sundered far by faith they meet
L: Around the common mercy seat.

[Bait 4]
L: Ah whither could we flee for aid,
L: When tempted desolate dismayed,
L: Or how the hosts of hell defeat,
L: Had suff'ring saints no mercy seat.

[Bait 5]
L: Ah there on eagle wings we soar,
L: And sin an sense molest no more;
L: And heav'n comes down our souls to greet,
L: While glory crowns the mercy seat.

songs.title: Give Me Jesus
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby John R. Sweney
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O the height and depth of mercy!
L: O the length and breadth of love!
L: O the fullness of redemption,
L: Pledge of endless life above!

[Bait 1]
L: Take the world but give me Jesus.
L: All its joys are but a name;
L: But His love abideth ever,
L: Through eternal years the same.

[Bait 2]
L: Take the world but give me Jesus.
L: Sweetest comfort of my soul;
L: With my Savior watching o'er me,
L: I can sing though billows roll.

[Bait 3]
L: Take the world but give me Jesus.
L: Let me view His constant smile;
L: Then throughout my pilgrim journey
L: Light will cheer me all the while.

[Bait 4]
L: Take the world but give me Jesus.
L: In His cross my trust shall be,
L: Till with clearer brighter vision,
L: Face to face my Lord I see.

songs.title: Gloria
