songs.author: Antonio Vivaldi
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Gloria, gloria, gloria,
L: Gloria in excelsis Deo,
L: In excelsis Deo.
L: Gloria, gloria, gloria,
L: Gloria in excelsis Deo.
L: Gloria, gloria
L: In excelsis Deo.
L: Gloria in excelsis,
L: Gloria in excelsis Deo.
L: Gloria in excelsis Deo,
L: In excelsis.
L: gloria in excelsis Deo.

[Reff 2]
L: Glorious, glorious, glorious,
L: Glorious, all glory be to God,
L: Glory in the highest.
L: Glorious, glorious, glorious,
L: Glory be to God on high, glory.
L: Glorious, glorious,
L: Glory in the highest, glory.
L: Glory to God in heaven,
L: Glory to God in heaven, glory.
L: Glory to God in heaven, glory.
L: He is glorious! Glorious,
L: Glory in the highest.

songs.title: Glorious Freedom
songs.author: Alfred Judson Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom,
L: No more in chains of sin I repine!
L: Jesus the glorious emancipator,
L: Now and forever He shall be mine.

[Bait 1]
L: Once I was bound by sin's galling fetters,
L: Chained like a slave
L: I struggled in vain,
L: But I received a glorious freedom,
L: When Jesus broke my fetters in twain.

[Bait 2]
L: Freedom from all the carnal affections,
L: Freedom from envy, hatred and strife.
L: Freedom from vain and worldly ambitions,
L: Freedom from all that saddened my life.

[Bait 3]
L: Freedom from pride and all sinful follies,
L: Freedom from love and glitter of gold.
L: Freedom from evil, temper, and anger,
L: Glorious freedom, rapture untold.

[Bait 4]
L: Freedom from fear with all of its torments,
L: Freedom from care with all of its pain.
L: Freedom in Christ my blessed Redeemer,
L: He who has rent my fetters in twain.

songs.title: Glory To His Name
songs.author: H.B. Simpson J.H. Burke
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Glory to His name,
L: Glory to His name,
L: All may change,
L: But Jesus never,
L: Glory to His name.

songs.title: Go Tell It On The Mountain
songs.author: John W. Jr. Work
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Go tell it on the mountain,
L: Over the hills and everywhere;
L: Go tell it on the mountain,
L: That Jesus Christ is born.

[Bait 1]
L: Down in a lowly manger,
L: The humble Christ was born;
L: And brought us God's salvation,
L: That blessed Christmas morn.

[Bait 2]
L: When I was a seeker,
L: I sought both night and day;
L: I asked the Lord to help me,
L: And He showed me the way.

[Bait 3]
L: He made me a watchman,
L: Upon the city wall;
L: And if I am a Christian,
L: I am the least of all.

[Bait 4]
L: While shepherds kept their watching,
L: O'er silent flocks by night;
L: Behold throughout the heavens,
L: There shone a holy light.

[Bait 5]
L: And lo, when they had seen it,
L: They all bowed down and prayed;
L: They traveled on together
L: To where the Babe was laid.

[Bait 6]
L: The shepherds feared and trembled,
L: When lo above the earth;
L: Rang out the angel chorus,
L: That hailed our Savior's birth.

[Bait 7]
L: When I was a sinner,
L: I prayed both night and day;
L: I asked the Lord to help me,
L: And He showed me the way.

songs.title: God Leads Us Along
songs.author: G.A. Young
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Some thro' the waters,
L: Some thro' the flood,
L: Some thro' the fire,
L: But all thro' the blood;
L: Some thro' great sorrow,
L: But God gives a song,
L: In the night season,
L: And all the day long.

[Bait 1]
L: In shady, green pastures,
L: So rich and so sweet,
L: God leads His dear children along;
L: Where the water's cool flow
L: Bathes the weary one's feet,
L: God leads His dear children along.

[Bait 2]
L: Sometimes on the mount
L: Where the sun shines so bright,
L: God leads His dear children along;
L: Sometimes in the valley,
L: In darkest of night,
L: God leads His dear children along.

[Bait 3]
L: Though sorrows befall us
L: And Satan oppose,
L: God leads His dear children along;
L: Through grace we can conquer,
L: Defeat all our foes,
L: God leads His dear children along.

[Bait 4]
L: Away from the mire
L: And away from the clay,
L: God leads His dear children along;
L: Away up in glory, eternity's day
L: God leads His dear children along.

songs.title: God Of Our Fathers
songs.author: Daniel C. Roberts George Warren
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: God of our fathers, whose Almighty hand
L: Leads forth in beauty all the starry band
L: Of shining worlds in splendor through the skies,
L: Our grateful songs before Thy throne arise.

[Bait 2]
L: Thy love divine hath led us in the past.
L: In this free land by Thee our lot is cast.
L: Be Thou our Ruler, Guardian, Guide, and Stay,
L: Thy word our law, Thy paths our chosen way.

[Bait 3]
L: From war's alarms, from deadly pestilence,
L: Be Thy strong arm our ever sure defense.
L: Thy true religion in our hearts increase;
L: Thy bounteous goodness nourish us in peace.

[Bait 4]
L: Refresh Thy people on their toilsome way.
L: Lead us from night to never ending day.
L: Fill all our lives with love and grace divine;
L: And glory, laud, and praise be ever Thine.

songs.title: God The Omnipotent
songs.author: Alexis F. Lvov Henry F. Chorley John Ellerton
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: God the Omnipotent!
L: King who ordainest thunder Thy clarion,
L: The lightning Thy sword,
L: Show forth Thy pity
L: On high where Thou reignest,
L: Give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

[Bait 2]
L: God the All-merciful!
L: Earth hath forsaken,
L: Meekness and mercy and slighted Thy word,
L: Let not Thy wrath in its terrors awaken,
L: Give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

[Bait 3]
L: God the All-righteous One!
L: Man hath defied Thee,
L: Yet to eternity standeth Thy word,
L: Falsehood and wrong shall not tarry beside Thee,
L: Give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

[Bait 4]
L: So shall Thy people, with thankful devotion,
L: Praise Him who saved them from peril and sword;
L: Singing in chorus from ocean to ocean,
L: Peace to the nations, and praise to the Lord.
L: Amen.

songs.title: God Will Take Care Of You
songs.author: Civilla D. Martin Walter Stillman Martin
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: God will take care of you.
L: Thro' every day, o'er all the way,
L: He will take care of you;
L: God will take care of you.

[Bait 1]
L: Be not dismayed whate'er betide,
L: God will take care of you;
L: Beneath His wings of love abide,
L: God will take care of you.

[Bait 2]
L: Thro' days of toil,
L: When heart doth fail,
L: God will take care of you;
L: When dangers fierce your path assail,
L: God will take care of you.

[Bait 3]
L: All you may need He will provide,
L: God will take care of you;
L: Nothing you ask will be denied,
L: God will take care of you.

[Bait 4]
L: No matter what may be the test,
L: God will take care of you;
L: Lean, weary one, upon His breast,
L: God will take care of you.

songs.title: Good Christian Men Rejoice
songs.author: John Mason Neale
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Good Christian men, rejoice
L: With heart, and soul, and voice;
L: Give ye heed to what we say;
L: Jesus Christ is born today.
L: Ox and ass before Him bow,
L: And He is in the manger now.
L: Christ is born today!
L: Christ is born today!

[Bait 2]
L: Good Christian men, rejoice
L: With heart, and soul, and voice;
L: Now ye hear of endless bliss;
L: Joy! Joy!
L: Jesus Christ was born for this!
L: He hath opened heaven's door
L: And man is blessed forevermore.
L: Christ was born for this!
L: Christ was born for this!

[Bait 3]
L: Good Christian men, rejoice
L: With heart, and soul, and voice;
L: Now ye need not fear the grave,
L: Peace! Peace!
L: Jesus Christ was born to save!
L: Calls you one calls you all,
L: To gain His everlasting hall.
L: Christ was born to save!
L: Christ was born to save!

songs.title: Grace Greater Than Our Sin
songs.author: Daniel Brink Towner Julia H. Johnston
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Grace, grace, God's grace,
L: Grace that will pardon and cleanse within!
L: Grace, grace, God's grace,
L: Grace that is greater than all our sin!

[Bait 1]
L: Marvelous grace of our loving Lord,
L: Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt,
L: Yonder on Calvary's mount outpoured,
L: There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt!

[Bait 2]
L: Sin and despair, like the sea waves cold,
L: Threaten the soul with infinite loss.
L: Grace that is greater, yes, grace untold,
L: Points to the refuge, the mighty Cross.

[Bait 3]
L: Dark is the stain that we cannot hide.
L: What can avail to wash it away?
L: Look! There is flowing a crimson tide;
L: Whiter than snow you may be today.

[Bait 4]
L: Marvelous, infinite, matchless grace,
L: Freely bestowed on all who believe!
L: You that are longing to see His face,
L: Will you this moment His grace receive?

songs.title: Guide Me O Thou Great Jehovah
songs.author: Harry E. Fosdick John Hughes Peter William William
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Guide me, O Thou great Jehovah,
L: Pilgrim through this barren land;
L: I am weak, but Thou art mighty,
L: Hold me with Thy pow'rful hand.
L: Bread of heaven, Bread of heaven,
L: Feed me till I want no more;
L: Feed me till I want no more.

[Bait 2]
L: Open now the crystal fountain,
L: Whence the healing stream doth flow;
L: Let the fire and cloudy pillar
L: Lead me all my journey through.
L: Strong Deliverer, strong Deliverer,
L: Be Thou still my strength and shield;
L: Be Thou still my strength and shield.

[Bait 3]
L: When I tread the verge of Jordan,
L: Bid my anxious fears subside;
L: Bear me thro' the swelling current,
L: Land me safe on Canaan's side.
L: Songs and praises, songs and praises,
L: I will ever give to Thee;
L: I will ever give to Thee.

songs.title: Hallelujah Amen
songs.author: Henrietta E. Blair
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Hallelujah! Amen!
L: Hallelujah! Amen!
L: Hallelujah! Amen!
L: Amen! Amen!

[Bait 1]
L: How oft in holy converse with Christ,
L: My Lord alone,
L: I seem to hear the millions
L: That sing around His throne:

[Bait 2]
L: They passed thro' toils and trials
L: And, tho' the strife was long,
L: They share the victor's conquest,
L: And sing the victor's song:

[Bait 3]
L: My soul takes up the chorus
L: And, pressing on my way,
L: Communing still with Jesus,
L: I sing from day to day:

[Bait 4]
L: Thro' grace I soon shall conquer,
L: And reach my home on high;
L: And thro' eternal ages
L: I'll shout beyond the sky:

songs.title: Hallelujah What A Savior
songs.author: Philip Paul Bliss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Man of Sorrows! What a name
L: For the Son of God who came;
L: Ruined sinners to reclaim,
L: Hallelujah! What a Savior!

[Bait 2]
L: Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
L: In my place condemned He stood;
L: Sealed my pardon with His blood,
L: Hallelujah! What a Savior!

[Bait 3]
L: Guilty vile and helpless we,
L: Spotless Lamb of God was He;
L: Full atonement can it be,
L: Hallelujah! What a Savior!

[Bait 4]
L: Lifted up was He to die,
L: "It is finished!" was His cry;
L: Now in heaven, exalted high,
L: Hallelujah! What a Savior!

[Bait 5]
L: When He comes, our glorious King,
L: All His ransomed home to bring;
L: Then anew this song we'll sing,
L: Hallelujah! What a Savior!

songs.title: Hark The Herald Angels Sing
songs.author: Charles Wesley Felix Mendelssohn
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Hark! the herald angels sing,
L: "Glory to the newborn King;
L: Peace on earth and mercy mild,
L: God and sinners reconciled."
L: Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
L: Join the triumph of the skies;
L: With angelic hosts proclaim,
L: "Christ is born in Bethlehem."
L: Hark! the herald angels sing,
L: "Glory to the newborn King."

[Bait 2]
L: Christ, by highest heav'n adored,
L: Christ, the everlasting Lord;
L: Late in time behold Him come,
L: Offspring of a virgin's womb.
L: Veiled in flesh the Godhead see,
L: Hail, the incarnate Deity!
L: Pleased as man with men to dwell,
L: Jesus our Emmanuel.
L: Hark! the herald angels sing,
L: "Glory to the newborn King."

[Bait 3]
L: Hail the heav'n born Prince of Peace!
L: Hail the Sun of righteousness!
L: Light and life to all He brings,
L: Ris'n with healing in His wings.
L: Mild He lays His glory by,
L: Born that man no more may die;
L: Born to raise the sons of earth,
L: Born to give them second birth.
L: Hark! the herald angels sing,
L: "Glory to the newborn King!"

[Bait 4]
L: Come, Desire of nations, come!
L: Fix in us Thy humble home.
L: Rise, the woman's conqu'ring seed,
L: Bruise in us the serpent's head;
L: Adam's likeness now efface,
L: Stamp Thine image in its place;
L: Second Adam from above,
L: Reinstate us in Thy love.
L: Hark! the herald angels sing,
L: "Glory to the newborn King."

songs.title: He Hideth My Soul
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby William J. Kirkpatrick
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: He hideth my soul
L: In the cleft of the rock
L: That shadows a dry, thirsty land.
L: He hideth my life
L: In the depths of His love.
L: And covers me there with His hand.
L: And covers me there with His hand.

[Bait 1]
L: A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord,
L: A wonderful Savior to me.
L: He hideth my soul
L: In the cleft of the rock,
L: Where rivers of pleasure I see.

[Bait 2]
L: A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord.
L: He taketh my burden away.
L: He holdeth me up
L: And I shall not be moved.
L: He giveth me strength as my day.

[Bait 3]
L: With numberless blessings
L: Each moment He crowns;
L: And filled with His fullness divine,
L: I sing in my rapture, "Oh, glory to God
L: For such a Redeemer as mine!"

[Bait 4]
L: When clothed in His brightness
L: Transported I rise,
L: To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
L: His perfect salvation,
L: His wonderful love I'll shout
L: With the millions on high.

songs.title: He Keeps Me Singing
songs.author: Luther B. Bridgers
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Jesus, Jesus, Jesus,
L: Sweetest name I know,
L: Fills my ev'ry longing,
L: Keeps me singing as I go.

[Bait 1]
L: There's within my heart a melody.
L: Jesus whispers sweet and low:
L: "Fear not, I am with thee; peace, be still,"
L: In all of life's ebb and flow.

[Bait 2]
L: All my life was wrecked by sin and strife;
L: Discord filled my life with pain.
L: Jesus swept across the broken strings,
L: Stirred the slumb'ring chords again.

[Bait 3]
L: Feasting on the riches of His grace,
L: Resting 'neath His shelt'ring wing,
L: Always looking on His smiling face,
L: That is why I shout and sing.

[Bait 4]
L: Tho' sometimes He leads thro' waters deep,
L: Trials fall across my way,
L: Tho' sometimes the path seems rough and steep,
L: See His footprints all the way.

[Bait 5]
L: Soon He's coming back to welcome me
L: Far beyond the starry sky.
L: I shall wing my flight to worlds unknown;
L: I shall reign with Him on high.

songs.title: He's A Wonderful Saviour To Me
songs.author: Blanche Kerr Brock Virgil P. Brock
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: For He's a wonderful Savior to me,
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.
L: I was lost in sin,
L: But Jesus took me in.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.

[Bait 1]
L: I was lost in sin,
L: But Jesus rescued me.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.
L: I was bound by fear,
L: But Jesus set me free.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.

[Bait 2]
L: He's a friend so true,
L: So patient and so kind.
L: He's wonderful Savior to me,
L: Ev'rything I need in Him I always find.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.

[Bait 3]
L: He is always near,
L: To comfort and to cheer.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me,
L: He forgives my sin,
L: He dries my ev'ry tear,
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.

[Bait 4]
L: Dearer grows the love
L: Of Jesus day by day,
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me,
L: Sweeter is His grace,
L: While pressing on my way.
L: He's a wonderful Savior to me.

songs.title: He's Everything To Me
songs.author: Hampton H. Sewell Kate Byron
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: He's ev'rything to me.
L: From sin He sets me free;
L: His peace and love my portion
L: Thro' all eternity!
L: He's ev'rything to me,
L: More than I dreamed could be.
L: O praise His name forever!
L: He's ev'rything to me.

[Bait 1]
L: In sin I once had wandered,
L: All weary, sad and lone,
L: Till Jesus through His mercy
L: Adopted me His own.
L: Ever since I learned to trust Him,
L: His grace doth make me free,
L: And now I feel His pardon,
L: He's everything to me.

[Bait 2]
L: In sin no more I'll wander;
L: He's Pilot, Friend and Guide.
L: He brings me joy and singing.
L: His Spirit doth abide.
L: A blessed, loving Savior,
L: The Lamb of Calvary!
L: He purchased my redemption.
L: He's ev'rything to me.

[Bait 3]
L: No longer will I stray
L: From His tender, loving care;
L: Like Him to be my purpose,
L: My aim, my constant prayer.
L: And when He bids me welcome
L: Thro'out eternity,
L: I'll praise His name forever.
L: He's ev'rything to me.

songs.title: He Took My Sins Away
songs.author: Margaret Jenkins Harris
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: He took my sins away,
L: He took my sins away,
L: And keeps me singing every day!
L: I'm so glad He took my sins away.
L: He took my sins away.

[Bait 1]
L: I came to Jesus, weary, worn and sad.
L: He took my sins away;
L: He took my sins away.
L: And now His love has made
L: My heart so glad.
L: He took my sins away.

[Bait 2]
L: The load of sin was more
L: Than I could bear.
L: He took them all away;
L: He took them all away.
L: And now on Him I roll
L: My every care.
L: He took my sins away.

[Bait 3]
L: No condemnation have I in my heart.
L: He took my sins away;
L: He took my sins away.
L: His perfect peace He did to me impart.
L: He took my sins away.

[Bait 4]
L: If You will come to Jesus Christ today,
L: He'll take Your sins away,
L: He'll take Your sins away,
L: And keep You happy in His love each day.
L: He'll take Your sins away.

songs.title: His Way With Thee
songs.author: Cyrus S. Nusbaum
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: His power can make you
L: What you ought to be.
L: His blood can cleanse your heart
L: And make you free.
L: His love can fill your soul
L: And you will see
L: 'Twas best for Him to have
L: His way with thee.

[Bait 1]
L: Would you live for Jesus,
L: And be always pure and good?
L: Would you walk with Him
L: Within the narrow road?
L: Would you have Him bear your burden,
L: Carry all your load?
L: Let Him have His way with thee.

[Bait 2]
L: Would you have Him make you free,
L: And follow at His call?
L: Would you know the peace
L: That comes by giving all?
L: Would you have Him save you,
L: So that you need never fall?
L: Let Him have His way with thee.

[Bait 3]
L: Would you in His kingdom
L: Find a place of constant rest?
L: Would you prove Him true
L: In providential test?
L: Would you in His service labor
L: Always at your best?
L: Let Him have His way with thee.

songs.title: His Way
songs.author: Gerald S. Henderson Thomas Tallis William Cowper
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: God moves in a mysterious way
L: His glorious wonders to perform;
L: He plants His footsteps in the sea
L: And rides upon the storm.

[Bait 2]
L: Deep in unfathomable mines
L: Of never failing skill
L: He treasures up His bright designs,
L: And works His sovereign will.

[Bait 3]
L: Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take.
L: The clouds ye so much dread
L: Are big with mercy, and shall break,
L: In blessings on your head.

[Bait 4]
L: Judge not the Lord by feeble sense,
L: But trust Him for His grace;
L: Behind a frowning providence
L: He hides a smiling face.

[Bait 5]
L: His purposes will ripen fast,
L: Unfolding every hour:
L: The bud may have a bitter taste
L: But sweet will be the flower.

[Bait 6]
L: Blind unbelief is sure to err,
L: And scan His work in vain:
L: God is His own interpreter,
L: And He will make it plain.

songs.title: His Yoke Is Easy
songs.author: Barney E. Warren Daniel S. Warner
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: His yoke is easy His burden is light,
L: I've found it so I've found it so,
L: His service is my sweetest delight,
L: His blessings ever flow.

[Bait 1]
L: I've found my Lord and He is mine,
L: He won me by His love,
L: I'll serve Him all my years of time,
L: And dwell with Him above.

[Bait 2]
L: No other Lord but Christ I know,
L: I walk with Him alone,
L: His streams of love forever flow,
L: Within my heart His throne.

[Bait 3]
L: He's dearer to my heart than life,
L: He found me lost in sin,
L: He calmed the sea of inward strife,
L: And bid me come to Him.

[Bait 4]
L: My flesh recoiled before the cross,
L: And Satan whispers there,
L: Thy gain will not repay the loss,
L: His yoke is hard to bear.

[Bait 5]
L: I've tried the road of sin and found,
L: Its prospects all deceive,
L: I've proved the Lord and joys abound,
L: More than I could believe.

songs.title: Holy God We Praise Thy Name
songs.author: Clarence A. Walworth Ignaz Franz
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Holy God, we praise Thy name;
L: Lord of all, we bow before Thee.
L: All on earth, Thy scepter claim,
L: All in heaven above adore Thee.
L: Infinite Thy vast domain,
L: Everlasting is Thy reign.

[Bait 2]
L: Hark the glad celestial hymn;
L: Angel choirs above are raising.
L: Cherubim and seraphim,
L: In unceasing chorus praising;
L: Fill the heavens with sweet accord,
L: Holy, holy, holy Lord.

[Bait 3]
L: All apostles join the strain,
L: As Thy sacred name they hallow.
L: Prophets swell the glad refrain
L: And the blessed martyrs follow
L: And from morn to set of sun,
L: Through the church the song goes on.

[Bait 4]
L: Holy Father, holy Son,
L: Holy Spirit, three we name Thee.
L: Though in essence only one,
L: Undivided God we claim Thee;
L: And adoring bend the knee,
L: While we sing our praise to Thee.

songs.title: Holy Holy Holy
songs.author: John B. Dykes Reginald Heber
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Holy, holy, holy,
L: Lord God Almighty!
L: Early in the morning
L: My song shall rise to Thee.
L: Holy, holy, holy!
L: Merciful and mighty!
L: God in three Persons,
L: Blessed Trinity!

[Bait 2]
L: Holy, holy, holy!
L: All the saints adore Thee,
L: Casting down their golden crowns
L: Around the glassy sea;
L: Cherubim and seraphim
L: Falling down before Thee,
L: Which wert, and art,
L: And evermore shall be.

[Bait 3]
L: Holy, holy, holy!
L: Though the darkness hide Thee,
L: Though the eye of sinful man
L: Thy glory may not see.
L: Only Thou art holy;
L: There is none beside Thee
L: Perfect in power,
L: In love, in purity.

[Bait 4]
L: Holy, holy, holy!
L: Lord God Almighty!
L: All Thy works shall praise Thy name
L: In earth, and sky, and sea.
L: Holy, holy, holy!
L: Merciful and mighty!
L: God in three Persons,
L: Blessed Trinity.

songs.title: Hosanna Loud Hosanna
songs.author: Jeannette Threlfall W.H. Monk
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Hosanna, loud hosanna,
L: The little children sang;
L: Through pillared court and temple,
L: The lovely anthem rang.
L: To Jesus, who had blessed them,
L: Close folded to His breast;
L: The children sang their praises,
L: The simplest and the best.

[Bait 2]
L: From Olivet they followed,
L: 'Mid an exultant crowd;
L: The victory palm branch waving,
L: And chanting clear and loud.
L: The Lord of men and angels,
L: Rode on in lowly state;
L: Nor scorned the little children,
L: Should on His bidding wait.

[Bait 3]
L: "Hosanna in the highest!"
L: That ancient song we sing;
L: For Christ is our Redeemer,
L: The Lord of heaven, our King.
L: O may we ever praise Him
L: With heart and life and voice;
L: And in His holy presence
L: Eternally rejoice!

songs.title: How Firm A Foundation
songs.author: George Keith R. Keene
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: How firm a foundation
L: Ye saints of the Lord,
L: Is laid for your faith
L: In His excellent word,
L: What more can He say
L: Than to you He hath said,
L: To you who for refuge
L: To Jesus have fled.

[Bait 2]
L: Fear not I am with Thee
L: O be not dismayed,
L: For I am Thy God
L: And will still give Thee aid,
L: I'll strengthen Thee help Thee
L: And cause Thee to stand,
L: Upheld by my righteous omnipotent hand.

[Bait 3]
L: When through fiery trials
L: Thy pathway shall lie,
L: My grace all sufficient
L: Shall be Thy supply,
L: The flame shall not hurt Thee
L: I only design,
L: Thy dross to consume
L: And Thy gold to refine.

[Bait 4]
L: When through the deep waters
L: I call Thee to go,
L: The rivers of sorrow
L: Shall not overflow,
L: For I will be with Thee
L: I only design,
L: And sanctify to Thee
L: Thy deepest distress.

[Bait 5]
L: The soul that on Jesus
L: Hath leaned for repose,
L: I will not I will not
L: Desert to His foes,
L: That soul though all hell
L: Should endeavor to shake,
L: I'll never no never
L: No never forsake.

songs.title: How Great Our Joy
songs.author: Theodore Baker
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: How great our joy! Great our joy!
L: Joy, joy, joy!
L: Joy, joy, joy!
L: Praise we the Lord in heaven on high!
L: Praise we the Lord in heaven on high!

[Bait 1]
L: While by the sheep we watched at night,
L: Glad tidings brought an angel bright.

[Bait 2]
L: There shall be born so He did say,
L: In Bethlehem a Child today.

[Bait 3]
L: There shall the Child lie in a stall,
L: This Child who shall redeem us all.

[Bait 4]
L: This gift of God we'll cherish well,
L: That every joy our hearts shall fill.

songs.title: How Sweet The Name Of Jesus Sounds
songs.author: Alexander Robert Reinagle John Newton
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds,
L: In a believer's ear;
L: It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds
L: And drives away his fear.

[Bait 2]
L: It makes the wounded Spirit whole
L: And calms the troubled breast;
L: 'Tis manna to the hungry soul
L: And to the weary, rest.

[Bait 3]
L: Dear name! the Rock on which I build,
L: My shield and hiding place;
L: My never failing treasure,
L: Filled with boundless stores of grace.

[Bait 4]
L: Jesus, my Shepherd, Brother, Friend,
L: My Prophet, Priest, and King
L: My Lord, my Life, my Way, my End,
L: Accept the praise I bring.

[Bait 5]
L: Weak is the effort of my heart
L: And cold my warmest thought;
L: But when I see Thee as Thou art,
L: I'll praise Thee as I ought.

[Bait 6]
L: Till then I would Thy love proclaim
L: With ev'ry fleeting breath;
L: And may the music of Thy name
L: Refresh my soul in death.

songs.title: I Am Thine O Lord
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby William H. Doane
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
L: To the cross where Thou hast died.
L: Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord.
L: To Thy precious bleeding side.

[Bait 1]
L: I am Thine O Lord; I have heard Thy voice,
L: And it told Thy love to me.
L: But I long to rise in the arms of faith,
L: And be closer drawn to Thee.

[Bait 2]
L: Consecrate me now to Thy service Lord,
L: By the power of grace divine.
L: Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
L: And my will be lost in Thine.

[Bait 3]
L: Oh the pure delight of a single hour
L: That before Thy throne I spend,
L: When I kneel in prayer and with Thee my God,
L: I commune as friend with friend!

[Bait 4]
L: There are depths of love that I cannot know
L: Till I cross the narrow sea;
L: There are heights of joy that I may not reach
L: Till I rest in peace with Thee.

songs.title: I Do Believe
songs.author: Charles Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I do believe, I now believe
L: That Jesus died for me;

[Bait 1]
L: Father, I stretch my hands to Thee;
L: No other help I know.
L: If Thou withdraw thyself from me,
L: Ah, whither shall I go?

[Bait 2]
L: What did Thine only Son endure
L: Before I drew my breath!
L: What pain, what labor,
L: To secure my soul from endless death!

[Bait 3]
L: Author of faith, to Thee I lift
L: My weary, longing eyes.
L: Oh, let me now receive that gift;
L: My soul, without it, dies.

[Bait 4]
L: Surely Thou canst not let me die;
L: Oh, speak, and I shall live.
L: And here I will unwearied lie
L: Till Thou Thy Spirit give.

[Bait 5]
L: How would my fainting soul rejoice
L: Could I but see Thy face!
L: now let me hear Thy quick'ning voice,
L: And taste Thy pard'ning grace.

songs.title: I Have Settled The Question
songs.author: Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I have settled the question,
L: Hallelujah!
L: I will never turn back
L: From the narrow way.
L: I am going thro' with Jesus,
L: Hallelujah!
L: 'Til I reach the gates
L: Of glory some sweet day.

[Bait 1]
L: I remember when the Lord
L: Spoke to my soul.
L: I could feel the heavy burden
L: From me roll.
L: When He spoke the gracious words,
L: "Wilt Thou be whole?"
L: Then I settled the question forever.

[Bait 2]
L: I no longer walk the ways
L: Of sinfulness,
L: But I daily tread
L: The paths of righteousness.
L: Since the day the Lord
L: Has come to my life to bless.
L: I have settled the question forever.

[Bait 3]
L: I will choose the holy joys
L: That always last.
L: And reject sin's pleasures,
L: That will soon be past.
L: To the treasures of true worth,
L: I'm holding fast.
L: I have settled the question forever.

[Bait 4]
L: Others may deny the Lord
L: And live in sin.
L: But the race that I have entered
L: I must win.
L: Thro' the pearly gates,
L: I mean to enter in.
L: I have settled the question forever.

songs.title: I Heard The Bells On Christmas Day
songs.author: Henry W. Longfellow Jean Baptiste Calkin
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: I heard the bells on Christmas day,
L: Their old familiar carols play;
L: And wild and sweet the words repeat,
L: Of peace on earth, good will to men.

[Bait 2]
L: I thought how as the day had come,
L: The belfries of all Christendom;
L: Had rolled along the unbroken song,
L: Of peace on earth, good will to men.

[Bait 3]
L: And in despair I bowed my head,
L: "There is no peace on earth," I said;
L: "For hate is strong and mocks the song,
L: Of peace on earth, good will to men."

[Bait 4]
L: Then pealed the bells more loud and deep,
L: "God is not dead, nor doth He sleep;
L: The wrong shall fail, the right prevail,
L: With peace on earth, good will to men."

[Bait 5]
L: Till ringing, singing on its way,
L: The world revolved from night to day;
L: A voice, a chime, a chant sublime
L: Of peace on earth, good will to men.

songs.title: I Know Whom I Have Believed
songs.author: James McGranahan Major Daniel W. Whittle
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: But "I know whom I have believed,
L: And am persuaded that He is able
L: To keep that which I've committed,
L: Unto Him against that day."

[Bait 1]
L: I know not why God's wondrous grace
L: To me He hath made known;
L: Nor why, unworthy, Christ in love
L: Redeemed me for His own.

[Bait 2]
L: I know not how this saving faith
L: To me He did impart,
L: Nor how believing in His word
L: Wrought peace within my heart.

[Bait 3]
L: I know not how the Spirit moves,
L: Convincing men of sin,
L: Revealing Jesus through the Word,
L: Creating faith in Him.

[Bait 4]
L: I know not what of good or ill
L: May be reserved for me.
L: Of weary ways or golden days,
L: Before His face I see.

[Bait 5]
L: I know not when my Lord may come,
L: At night or noonday fair,
L: Nor if I'll walk the vale with Him,
L: Or meet Him in the air.

songs.title: I Love To Walk With Jesus
songs.author: Charles F. Weigle
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I will follow where He leadeth;
L: I will pasture where He feedeth.
L: I will follow all the way, Lord.
L: I will follow Jesus ev'ry day.

[Bait 1]
L: Oh, I love to walk with Jesus,
L: Like the publicans of old.
L: When He gathered them about Him
L: And the blessed tidings told:
L: How He came to bring deliv'rance
L: To the captives in distress.
L: Take away our ev'ry burden,
L: Giving perfect peace and rest.

[Bait 2]
L: O I love to walk with Jesus
L: Like the man of long ago
L: Who had tarried by the wayside
L: Near the gates of Jericho.
L: Jesus heard his cry for mercy,
L: Gave him back his sight that day,
L: And immediately he followed Jesus
L: All along the way.

[Bait 3]
L: O I love to walk with Jesus
L: All the way to Calv'ry's brow,
L: Gaze upon that scene of suff'ring
L: While my tears of sorrow flow.
L: There He tells me how He loves me,
L: Takes my ev'ry sin away;
L: So I follow Him so gladly,
L: Lead me anywhere He may.

[Bait 4]
L: O sometime I'll walk with Jesus
L: In the land of endless day,
L: When our journey here is over
L: And we've reached our home to stay.
L: Then I'll walk with Him forever,
L: Sing His praises o'er and o'er,
L: And with all the saints in glory
L: Love and worship and adore.

songs.title: I Sing The Mighty Power Of God
songs.author: Isaac Watts Lowell Mason
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: I sing the mighty power of God,
L: That made the mountains rise;
L: That spread the flowing seas abroad,
L: And built the lofty skies,
L: That spread the flowing seas abroad,
L: And built the lofty skies.

[Bait 2]
L: I sing the goodness of the Lord,
L: That filled the earth with food;
L: He formed the creatures with His word,
L: And then pronounced them good,
L: He formed the creatures with His word,
L: And then pronounced them good.

[Bait 3]
L: There's not a plant or flower below,
L: But makes Thy glories known;
L: And clouds arise, and tempests blow,
L: By order from Thy throne;
L: And clouds arise, and tempests blow,
L: By order from Thy throne.
L: Amen.

songs.title: I Surrender All
songs.author: Judson Van De Venter Winfield S. Weeden
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I surrender all,
L: I surrender all.
L: All to Thee my blessed Savior,
L: I surrender all.

[Bait 1]
L: All to Jesus I surrender,
L: All to Him I freely give;
L: I will ever love and trust Him,
L: In His presence daily live.

[Bait 2]
L: All to Jesus I surrender,
L: Humbly at His feet I bow,
L: Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
L: Take me Jesus take me now.

[Bait 3]
L: All to Jesus I surrender,
L: Make me Savior wholly Thine;
L: Let me feel the Holy Spirit,
L: Truly know that Thou art mine.

[Bait 4]
L: All to Jesus I surrender,
L: Lord I give myself to Thee.
L: Fill me with Thy love and power;
L: Let Thy blessings fall on me.

[Bait 5]
L: All to Jesus I surrender,
L: Now I feel the sacred flame.
L: Oh the joy of full salvation!
L: Glory, glory to His name!

songs.title: I Was There When It Happened
songs.author: Herbert J. Lacey
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I was there when it happened,
L: And I ought to know,
L: His Spirit burning in me,
L: Set my heart aglow,
L: So I praise the Lord today.

[Bait 1]
L: You ask me how I know that Jesus saves me,
L: How I know that all my sins are white as snow.
L: You ask me how I know that He forgave me,
L: Now listen I must tell you how I know.

[Bait 2]
L: You ask me how I know that He redeemed me,
L: And how I received the peace no gold can buy.
L: How from the guilt and pow'r of sin He saved me,
L: Made me an heir to mansions in the sky.

[Bait 3]
L: And now as thru the world I go rejoicing,
L: I am telling what a Savior dwells within.
L: How I plunged into the cleansing crimson fountain,
L: And Jesus washed my soul from ev'ry sin.

songs.title: I Will Praise Him
songs.author: Margaret Jenkins Harris
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
L: Praise the Lamb for sinners slain.
L: Give Him glory all ye people,
L: For His blood can wash away each stain.

[Bait 1]
L: When I saw the cleansing fountain
L: Open wide for all my sin,
L: I obeyed the Spirit's wooing
L: When He said "Wilt thou be clean?"

[Bait 2]
L: Tho' the way seemed straight and narrow,
L: All I claimed was swept away;
L: My ambitions, plans and wishes
L: At my feet in ashes lay.

[Bait 3]
L: Then God's fire upon the altar
L: Of my heart was set aflame.
L: I shall never cease to praise Him.
L: Glory, glory to His name!

[Bait 4]
L: Blessed be the name of Jesus!
L: I'm so glad He took me in.
L: He's forgiven my transgressions;
L: He has cleansed my heart from sin.

[Bait 5]
L: Glory, glory to the Father!
L: Glory, glory to the Son!
L: Glory, glory to the Spirit!
L: Glory to the Three in One!

songs.title: I Will Sing Of My Redeemer
songs.author: James McGranahan Philip Paul Bliss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Sing, oh sing, of my Redeemer.
L: With His blood He purchased me.
L: On the cross He sealed my pardon,
L: Paid the debt and made me free.

[Bait 1]
L: I will sing of my Redeemer,
L: And His wondrous love to me.
L: On the cruel cross He suffered,
L: From the curse to set me free.

[Bait 2]
L: I will tell the wondrous story,
L: How my lost estate to save,
L: In His boundless love and mercy
L: He the ransom freely gave.

[Bait 3]
L: I will praise my dear Redeemer;
L: His triumphant power I'll tell,
L: How the victory He giveth
L: Over sin and death and hell.

[Bait 4]
L: I will sing of my Redeemer
L: And His heavenly love to me;
L: He from death to life hath brought me,
L: Son of God, with Him to be.

songs.title: I Would Be Like Jesus
songs.author: Bentley D. Ackley James Rowe
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Be like Jesus, this my song,
L: In the home and in the throng;
L: Be like Jesus, all day long!
L: I would be like Jesus.

[Bait 1]
L: Earthly pleasures vainly call me;
L: I would be like Jesus;
L: Nothing worldly shall enthrall me;
L: I would be like Jesus.

[Bait 2]
L: He has broken ev'ry fetter,
L: I would be like Jesus;
L: That my soul may serve Him better,
L: I would be like Jesus.

[Bait 3]
L: All the way from earth to glory,
L: I would be like Jesus;
L: Telling o'er and o'er the story,
L: I would be like Jesus.

[Bait 4]
L: That in heaven He may meet me,
L: I would be like Jesus;
L: That His words "Well done," may greet me,
L: I would be like Jesus.

songs.title: Immortal Invisible
songs.author: John Robert Walter Chalmers Smith
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
L: In light inaccessible
L: Hid from our eyes;
L: Most blessed, most glorious,
L: The Ancient of Days;
L: Almighty, victorious,
L: Thy great name we praise.

[Bait 2]
L: Unresting, unhasting
L: And silent as light;
L: Nor wanting, nor wasting,
L: Thou rulest in might.
L: Thy justice, like mountains,
L: High soaring above;
L: Thy clouds, which are fountains
L: Of goodness and love.

[Bait 3]
L: To all, life Thou givest,
L: To both great and small;
L: In all, life Thou livest,
L: The true life of all;
L: We blossom and flourish
L: As leaves on the tree,
L: And wither and perish
L: But naught changeth Thee.

[Bait 4]
L: Great Father of glory,
L: Pure Father of light;
L: Thine angels adore Thee
L: All veiling their sight.
L: All praise we would render,
L: O help us to see
L: 'Tis only the splendor
L: Of light hideth Thee.
L: Amen.

songs.title: In Heavenly Love Abiding
songs.author: Anna L. Waring David Jenkins
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: In heavenly love abiding,
L: No change my heart shall fear;
L: And safe is such confiding,
L: For nothing changes here:
L: The storm may roar without me,
L: My heart may low be laid;
L: But God is round about me,
L: And can I be dismayed?

[Bait 2]
L: Wherever He may guide me,
L: No want shall turn me back;
L: My Shepherd is beside me,
L: And nothing can I lack:
L: His wisdom ever waketh,
L: His sight is never dim;
L: He knows the way He taketh,
L: And I will walk with Him.

[Bait 3]
L: Green pastures are before me,
L: Which yet I have not seen;
L: Bright skies will soon be o'er me,
L: Where darkest clouds have been;
L: My hope I cannot measure,
L: My path to life is free;
L: My Saviour has my treasure,
L: And He will walkt with me.

songs.title: In The Cross Of Christ I Glory
songs.author: Ithamar Conkey John Bowring
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: In the cross of Christ I glory,
L: Tow'ring o'er the wrecks of time;
L: All the light of sacred story
L: Gathers round its head sublime.

[Bait 2]
L: When the woes of life o'ertake me,
L: Hopes deceive and fears annoy;
L: Never shall the cross forsake me,
L: Lo! it glows with peace and joy.

[Bait 3]
L: When the sun of bliss is beaming
L: Light and love upon my way;
L: From the cross the radiance streaming
L: Adds more luster to the day.

[Bait 4]
L: Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
L: By the cross are sanctified;
L: Peace is there that knows no measure,
L: Joys that thro' all time abide.

songs.title: In The Garden
songs.author: C. Austin Miles
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: And He walks with me,
L: And He talks with me,
L: And He tells me I am His own;
L: And the joy we share as we tarry there,
L: None other has ever known.

[Bait 1]
L: I come to the garden alone,
L: While the dew is still on the roses;
L: And the voice I hear, falling on my ear,
L: The Son of God discloses.

[Bait 2]
L: He speaks, and the sound of
L: His voice is so sweet,
L: The birds hush their singing,
L: And the melody that He gave to me,
L: Within my heart is ringing.

[Bait 3]
L: I'd stay in the garden with Him,
L: Though the night around me be falling,
L: But He bids me go;
L: Through the voice of woe,
L: His voice to me is calling.

songs.title: In The Sweet By And By
songs.author: Elsie Leslie
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: I'll have a mansion so bright and fair,
L: Won't it be glorious when I get there,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: When the battle is done,
L: And the vict'ry is won,
L: In the sweet by and by.

[Bait 2]
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: I'll stand at last on the street of pure gold,
L: Wonders and glory of heav'n behold,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: In the sweet by and by,
L: Joy will be so complete when my Savior I meet,
L: In the sweet by and by.

songs.title: Infant Holy Infant Lowly
songs.author: A.E. Rusbridge Edith Margaret Gellibrand Reed
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Infant holy, infant lowly,
L: For His bed a cattle stall;
L: Oxen lowing, little knowing,
L: Christ the babe is Lord of all.
L: Swift are winging, angels singing,
L: Noels ringing, tidings bringing:
L: Christ the Babe is Lord of all.
L: Christ the Babe is Lord of all.

[Bait 2]
L: Flocks were sleeping,
L: Shepherds keeping vigil
L: Till the morning new;
L: Saw the glory, heard the story,
L: Tidings of a gospel true.
L: Thus rejoicing, free from sorrow,
L: Praises voicing, greet the morrow:
L: Christ the Babe was born for you.
L: Christ the Babe was born for you.

[Bait 3]
L: In a manger He is lying,
L: Who will greet Him as He sleeps?
L: Baby Jesus, infant Christ child,
L: Who will greet Him as He sleeps?
L: Angels winging, praises singing,
L: Noels ringing, tidings bringing:
L: Christ the Babe is Lord of all.
L: Christ the Babe is Lord of all.

songs.title: It Came Upon A Midnight Clear
songs.author: Edmund H. Sears Richard S. Willis
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: It came upon the midnight clear,
L: That glorious song of old;
L: From angels bending near the earth
L: To touch their harps of gold.
L: "Peace on the earth good will to men,
L: From heaven's all gracious King!"
L: The world in solemn stillness lay
L: To hear the angels sing.

[Bait 2]
L: Still thro' the cloven skies they come,
L: With peaceful wings unfurled;
L: And still their heavenly music floats,
L: O'er all the weary world.
L: Above its sad and lowly plains,
L: They bend on hovering wing;
L: And ever o'er its Babel sounds
L: The blessed angels sing.

[Bait 3]
L: And ye, beneath life's crushing load,
L: Whose forms are bending low;
L: Who toil along the climbing way
L: With painful steps and slow.
L: Look now! for glad and golden hours,
L: Come swiftly on the wing;
L: O rest beside the weary road,
L: And hear the angels sing.

[Bait 4]
L: For lo, the days are hastening on,
L: By prophet bards foretold;
L: When with the ever circling years,
L: Comes round the age of gold.
L: When peace shall over all the earth,
L: Its ancient splendors fling;
L: And the whole world give back the song
L: Which now the angels sing.

[Bait 5]
L: Yet with the woes of sin and strife
L: The world has suffered long;
L: Beneath the angel strain have rolled,
L: Two thousand years of wrong.
L: And man, at war with man, hears not,
L: The love song which they bring;
L: O hush the noise, ye men of strife,
L: And hear the angels sing.

songs.title: It Is Glory Just To Walk With Him
songs.author: Avis Marguerite Burgeson Christiansen Haldor Lille
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: It is glory, just to walk with Him.
L: It is glory, just to walk with Him.
L: He will guide my steps aright,
L: Thro' the vale and o'er the height.
L: It is glory, just to walk with Him.

[Bait 1]
L: It is glory, just to walk with Him,
L: Whose blood has ransomed me.
L: It is rapture for my soul each day,
L: It is joy divine to feel,
L: To feel Him near.
L: Where'er my path may be,
L: Bless the Lord,
L: It's glory all the way.

[Bait 2]
L: It is glory when the shadows fall,
L: To know that He is near.
L: Oh what joy to simply trust and pray,
L: It is glory to abide in Him.
L: When skies above are clear,
L: Yes, with Him it's glory all the way.

[Bait 3]
L: 'Twill be glory when I walk,
L: With Him on heaven's golden shore.
L: Never from His side again to stray,
L: 'Twill be glory, wondrous glory,
L: With the Savior evermore,
L: Everlasting glory all the way.

songs.title: It Is Well With My Soul
songs.author: Horatio G. Spafford Philip Paul Bliss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: It is well, with my soul,
L: It is well,
L: It is well, with my soul.

[Bait 1]
L: When peace like a river,
L: Attendeth my way,
L: When sorrows,
L: Like sea billows roll;
L: Whatever my lot,
L: Thou hast taught me to say,
L: "It is well,
L: It is well, with my soul."

[Bait 2]
L: Though Satan should buffet,
L: Tho' trials should come,
L: Let this blest assurance control;
L: That Christ has regarded
L: My helpless estate,
L: And hath shed His own blood
L: For my soul.

[Bait 3]
L: My sin, O the bliss
L: Of this glorious tho't,
L: My sin not in part
L: But the whole
L: Is nailed to the cross
L: And I bear it no more.
L: Praise the Lord,
L: Praise the Lord, O my soul!

[Bait 4]
L: O, Lord haste the day
L: When my faith shall be sight,
L: The clouds be rolled back
L: As a scroll;
L: The trump shall resound
L: And the Lord shall descend,
L: "Even so" it is well
L: With my soul.

songs.title: Jesus I Come
songs.author: George C. Stebbins William T. Sleeper
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Out of my bondage, sorrow and night,
L: Jesus, I come; Jesus I come.
L: Into Thy freedom, gladness and light,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.
L: Out of my sickness into Thy health,
L: Out of my want and into Thy wealth.
L: Out of my sin and into thyself,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.

[Bait 2]
L: Out of my shameful failure and loss,
L: Jesus, I come; Jesus, I come.
L: Into the glorious gain of Thy cross,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.
L: Out of earth's sorrows into Thy balm,
L: Out of life's storms and into Thy calm.
L: Out of distress to jubilant psalm,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.

[Bait 3]
L: Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
L: Jesus, I come; Jesus, I come.
L: Into Thy blessed will to abide,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.
L: Out of myself to dwell in Thy love,
L: Out of despair into raptures above,
L: Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.

[Bait 4]
L: Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
L: Jesus, I come; Jesus I come.
L: Into the joy and light of Thy home,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.
L: Out of the depths of ruin untold,
L: Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold.
L: Ever Thy glorious face to behold,
L: Jesus, I come to Thee.

songs.title: Jesus Is Tenderly Calling
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby George C. Stebbins
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Calling today, calling today,
L: Jesus is calling,
L: Is tenderly calling today.

[Bait 1]
L: Jesus is tenderly calling thee home
L: Calling today, calling today.
L: Why from the sunshine
L: Of love wilt thou roam
L: Farther and farther away?

[Bait 2]
L: Jesus is calling the weary to rest
L: Calling today, calling today.
L: Bring Him your burden
L: And you shall be blest;
L: He will not turn you away.

[Bait 3]
L: Jesus is waiting; O come to Him now
L: Waiting today waiting today.
L: Come with your sins; at His feet lowly bow,
L: Come and no longer delay.

[Bait 4]
L: Jesus is pleading; O list to His voice
L: Hear Him today, hear Him today.
L: They who believe on His name shall rejoice.
L: Quickly arise and away.

songs.title: Jesus Is The Sweetest Name I Know
songs.author: Lela Long
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Jesus is the sweetest name I know,
L: And He's just the same as His lovely name,
L: And that's the reason why I love Him so;
L: Oh, Jesus is the sweetest name I know.

[Bait 1]
L: There have been names that I have loved to hear,
L: But never has there been a name so dear
L: To this heart of mine as the name divine,
L: The precious, precious name of Jesus.

[Bait 2]
L: There is no name in earth or heav'n above,
L: That we should give such honor and such love,
L: As the blessed name; let us all acclaim;
L: That wondrous, glorious name of Jesus.

[Bait 3]
L: And some day I shall see Him face to face,
L: To thank and praise Him for His wondrous grace,
L: Which He gave to me when He made me free;
L: The blessed Son of God called Jesus.

songs.title: Jesus Lover Of My Soul
songs.author: Charles Wesley John B. Dykes
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Jesus, lover of my soul,
L: Let me to Thy bosom fly,
L: While the billows near me roll,
L: While the tempest still is high;
L: Hide me, O my Saviour, hide!
L: Till the storm of life is past;
L: Safe into the haven guide,
L: O receive my soul at last!

[Bait 2]
L: Other refuge have I none,
L: Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
L: Leave, O leave me not alone!
L: Still support and comfort me;
L: All my trust on Thee is stayed,
L: All my help from Thee I bring;
L: Cover my defenseless head
L: With the shadow of Thy wing.

[Bait 3]
L: Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
L: More than all in Thee I find;
L: Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
L: Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
L: Just and holy is Thy name,
L: I am all unrighteousness;
L: Vile and full of sin I am,
L: Thou art full of truth and grace.

[Bait 4]
L: Plenteous grace with Thee is found
L: Grace to pardon all my sin;
L: Let the healing streams abound,
L: Make and keep me pure within;
L: Thou of life the Fountain art,
L: Freely let me take of Thee;
L: Spring Thou up within my heart,
L: Rise to all eternity.

songs.title: Jesus Loves Even Me
songs.author: Philip Paul Bliss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
L: Jesus loves me,
L: Jesus loves me.
L: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
L: Jesus loves even me.

[Bait 1]
L: I am so glad that our Father in heaven
L: Tells of His love in the book He has giv'n.
L: Wonderful things in the Bible I see.
L: This is the dearest that Jesus loves me.

[Bait 2]
L: Tho' I forget Him and wander away,
L: Still He doth love me wherever I stray.
L: Back to His dear loving arms would I flee
L: When I remember that Jesus loves me.

[Bait 3]
L: Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
L: When in His beauty I see the great King,
L: This shall my song in eternity be.
L: Oh what a wonder that Jesus love me.

songs.title: Jesus Loves The Little Children
songs.author: George F. Root
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Jesus loves the little children,
L: All the children of the world.
L: Red and yellow, black and white,
L: They are precious in His sight--
L: Jesus loves the little children of the world.

[Bait 2]
L: Jesus died for all the children,
L: All the children of the world.
L: Red and yellow, black and white,
L: All are precious in His sight--
L: Jesus died for all the children of the world.

songs.title: Jesus Paid It All
songs.author: Elvina M. Hall John T. Grape
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
L: Sin had left a crimson stain,
L: He washed it white as snow.

[Bait 1]
L: I hear the Savior say,
L: "Thy strength indeed is small;
L: Child of weakness watch and pray,
L: Find in Me thine all in all."

[Bait 2]
L: Lord, now indeed I find,
L: Thy power and Thine alone;
L: Can change the leper's spots
L: And melt the heart of stone.

[Bait 3]
L: For nothing good have I,
L: Whereby Thy grace to claim;
L: I'll wash my garments white,
L: In the blood of Calvary's Lamb.

[Bait 4]
L: And when before the throne,
L: I stand in Him complete;
L: "Jesus died my soul to save,"
L: My lips shall still repeat.

songs.title: Jesus The Very Thought Of Thee
songs.author: Bernard Of Clairvaux Edward Caswall John B. Dykes
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Jesus, the very thought of Thee,
L: With sweetness fills my breast;
L: But sweeter far Thy face to see,
L: And in Thy presence rest.

[Bait 2]
L: No voice can sing, no heart can frame,
L: Nor can the memory find
L: A sweeter sound than Thy blest name;
L: O Savior of mankind!

[Bait 3]
L: O Hope of every contrite heart,
L: O Joy of all the meek;
L: To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
L: How good to those who seek!

[Bait 4]
L: But what to those who find?
L: Ah, this no tongue or pen can show;
L: The love of Jesus, what it is
L: None but His loved ones know.

[Bait 5]
L: Jesu, our only joy be Thou,
L: As Thou our prize wilt be;
L: Jesus, be Thou our Glory now,
L: And thru eternity.
L: Amen.

songs.title: Jingle Bells
songs.author: James Pierpont
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Jingle bells, jingle bells,
L: Jingle all the way,
L: Oh what fun it is to ride,
L: In a one horse open sleigh.
L: Jingle bells, jingle bells,
L: Jingle all the way,
L: Oh what fun it is to ride,
L: In a one horse open sleigh.

[Bait 1]
L: Dashing through the snow,
L: In a one horse open sleigh,
L: O'er the fields we go,
L: Laughing all the way,
L: Bells on bobtail ring,
L: Making spirits bright.
L: What fun it is to ride and sing,
L: A sleighing song tonight.

[Reff 2]
L: Ring the bells, ring the bells
L: Ring them out today.
L: Echoing through all the world
L: Listen what they say
L: Ring the bells, ring the bells
L: Ring them all the way.
L: Spread the message far and wide
L: That Christ is born today.

songs.title: Join All The Glorious Names
songs.author: Isaac Watts John Darwall
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Join all the glorious names,
L: Of wisdom love and power;
L: That ever mortals knew,
L: That angels ever bore.
L: All are too mean to speak His worth,
L: Too mean to set my Savior forth.

[Bait 2]
L: Great prophet of my God,
L: My tongue would bless Thy name;
L: By Thee the joyful news,
L: Of our salvation came;
L: The joyful news of sins forgiven,
L: Of hell subdued and peace with heaven.

[Bait 3]
L: Jesus, my great High Priest,
L: Offered His blood and died;
L: My guilty conscience seeks
L: No sacrifice beside;
L: His powerful blood did once atone,
L: And now it pleads before the throne.

[Bait 4]
L: My Savior and my Lord,
L: My Conqueror and my King;
L: Thy scepter and Thy sword,
L: Thy reigning grace I sing;
L: Thine is the power behold I sit,
L: In willing bonds beneath Thy feet.

[Bait 5]
L: Now let my soul arise
L: And tread the tempter down;
L: My Captain leads me forth,
L: To conquest and a crown;
L: A feeble saint shall win the day,
L: Though death and hell obstruct the way.

[Bait 6]
L: Should all the hosts of death
L: And powers of hell unknown
L: Put their most dreadful forms
L: Of rage and malice on,
L: I shall be safe for Christ displays,
L: Superior power and guardian grace.

songs.title: Joy To The World
songs.author: George Frederick Handel Isaac Watts
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Joy to the world! the Lord is come;
L: Let earth receive her King.
L: Let every heart prepare Him room,
L: And heav'n and nature sing,
L: And heav'n and nature sing,
L: And heav'n and heav'n and nature sing.

[Bait 2]
L: Joy to the earth! the Savior reigns;
L: Let men their songs employ.
L: While fields and floods,
L: Rocks, hills and plains,
L: Repeat the sounding joy,
L: Repeat the sounding joy,
L: Repeat, repeat the sounding joy.

[Bait 3]
L: No more let sins and sorrows grow,
L: Nor thorns infest the ground.
L: He comes to make His blessings flow,
L: Far as the curse is found,
L: Far as the curse is found,
L: Far as, far as the curse is found.

[Bait 4]
L: He rules the world with truth and grace
L: And makes the nations prove.
L: The glories of His righteousness
L: And wonders of His love,
L: And wonders of His love,
L: And wonders, and wonders of His love.

songs.title: Joy Unspeakable
songs.author: Barney E. Warren
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
L: Full of glory, full of glory.
L: It is joy unspeakable and full of glory.
L: Oh the half has never yet been told!

[Bait 1]
L: I have found His grace in all complete;
L: He supplieth every need.
L: While I sit and learn at Jesus feet,
L: I am free, yes, free indeed.

[Bait 2]
L: I have found the pleasure I once craved;
L: It is joy and peace within.
L: What a wondrous blessing! I am saved
L: From the awful gulf of sin.

[Bait 3]
L: I have found that hope
L: so bright and clear,
L: Living in the realm of grace.
L: Oh the Savior's presence is so near,
L: I can see His smiling face.

[Bait 4]
L: I have found the joy no tongue can tell.
L: How its waves of glory roll!
L: It is like a great o'er flowing well
L: Springing up within my soul.

songs.title: Lead Me Lord
songs.author: Samuel Sebastian Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Lead me, Lord,
L: Lead me in Thy righteousness;
L: Make Thy way plain before my face.
L: For it is Thou, Lord,
L: Thou, Lord, only,
L: That makest me dwell in safety.

songs.title: Lead On O King Eternal
songs.author: Ernest W. Shurtleff Henry Smart
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Lead on, O King Eternal.
L: The day of march has come;
L: Henceforth in fields of conquest
L: Thy tents shall be our home.
L: Thro' days of preparation
L: Thy grace has made us strong;
L: And now, O King eternal,
L: We lift our battle song.

[Bait 2]
L: Lead on, O King Eternal,
L: Till sin's fierce war shall cease,
L: And holiness shall whisper
L: The sweet Amen of peace.
L: For not with swords loud clashing,
L: Nor roll of stirring drums;
L: With deeds of love and mercy,
L: The heav'nly kingdom comes.

[Bait 3]
L: Lead on, O King Eternal,
L: We follow, not with fears;
L: For gladness breaks like morning
L: Where'er Thy face appears.
L: Thy cross is lifted o'er us;
L: We journey in its light.
L: The crown awaits the conquest;
L: Lead on, O God of might.

songs.title: Leaning On The Everlasting Arms
songs.author: Anthony J. Showalter Elisha A. Hoffman
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Leaning, leaning,
L: Safe and secure from all alarms;
L: Leaning, leaning,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms.

[Bait 1]
L: What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms!
L: What a blessedness, what a peace is mine,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms!

[Bait 2]
L: Oh how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms!
L: Oh how bright the path
L: Grows from day to day,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms.

[Bait 3]
L: What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms?
L: I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
L: Leaning on the everlasting arms.

songs.title: Living For Jesus
songs.author: C. Harold Lowden Thomas Obediah Chisholm
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O Jesus, Lord and Savior,
L: I give myself to Thee.
L: For Thou in Thy atonement,
L: Didst give Thyself for me.
L: I own no other master,
L: My heart shall be Thy throne.
L: My life I give henceforth to live,
L: O Christ for Thee alone.

[Bait 1]
L: Living for Jesus, a life that is true.
L: Striving to please Him in all that I do.
L: Yielding allegiance glad hearted and free.
L: This is the pathway of blessing for me.

[Bait 2]
L: Living for Jesus who died in my place,
L: Bearing on Calvary, my sin and disgrace.
L: Such love constrains me, to answer His call,
L: Follow His leading and give Him my all.

[Bait 3]
L: Living for Jesus, wherever I am.
L: Doing each duty in His holy name.
L: Willing to suffer affliction or loss.
L: Deeming each trial, a part of my cross.

[Bait 4]
L: Living for Jesus, through earth's little while,
L: My dearest treasure, the light of His smile.
L: Seeking the lost ones, He died to redeem.
L: Bringing the weary to find rest in Him.

songs.title: Lord's Prayer
songs.author: Lowell Mason
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Our Father who art in Heaven,
L: Hallowed by Thy name.
L: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done,
L: On earth as it is in heaven.

[Bait 2]
L: Give us this day our daily bread;
L: And forgive us our trespasses
L: As we forgive those
L: Who trespass against us.

[Bait 3]
L: And lead us not into temptation,
L: But deliver from evil,
L: For thine is the kingdom,
L: And the power and the glory forever.
L: Amen.

songs.title: Love Divine
songs.author: Gerald E. Bonney
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: Love Lifted Me
songs.author: Howard E. Smith James Rowe
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Love lifted me!
L: Love lifted me!
L: When nothing else could help,
L: Love lifted me.
L: Love lifted me.

[Bait 1]
L: I was sinking deep in sin,
L: Far from the peaceful shore,
L: Very deeply stained within,
L: Sinking to rise no more.
L: But the Master of the sea
L: Heard my despairing cry,
L: From the waters lifted me;
L: Now safe am I.

[Bait 2]
L: All my heart to Him I give;
L: Ever to Him I'll cling,
L: In His blessed presence live,
L: Ever His praises sing.
L: Love so mighty and so true
L: Merits my soul's best songs;
L: Faithful, loving service, too,
L: To Him belongs.

[Bait 3]
L: Souls in danger, look above;
L: Jesus completely saves.
L: He will lift you by His love
L: Out of the angry waves.
L: He's the Master of the sea,
L: Billows His will obey.
L: He your Savior wants to be,
L: Be saved today.

songs.title: Majestic Sweetness Sits Enthroned
songs.author: Samuel Stennett Thomas Hastings
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Majestic sweetness sits enthroned,
L: Upon the Savior's brow;
L: His head with radiant glories crowned,
L: His lips with grace o'erflow,
L: His lips with grace o'erflow.

[Bait 2]
L: No mortal can with Him compare
L: Among the sons of men;
L: Fairer is He than all the fair
L: Who fill the heav'nly train,
L: Who fill the heav'nly train.

[Bait 3]
L: He saw me plunged in deep distress,
L: He flew to my relief;
L: For me He bore the shameful Cross,
L: And carried all my grief,
L: And carried all my grief.

[Bait 4]
L: To Him I owe my life and breath
L: And all the joys I have;
L: He makes me triumph over death,
L: And saves me from the grave,
L: And saves me from the grave.

[Bait 5]
L: Since from His bounty I receive
L: Such proofs of love divine,
L: Had I a thousand hearts to give,
L: Lord they should all be Thine;
L: Lord they should all be Thine.

songs.title: More About Jesus
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt John R. Sweney
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: More, more about Jesus;
L: More, more about Jesus;
L: More of His saving fullness see,
L: More of His love who died for me.

[Bait 1]
L: More about Jesus would I know,
L: More of His grace to others show;
L: More of His saving fullness see,
L: More of His love who died for me.

[Bait 2]
L: More about Jesus let me learn,
L: More of His holy will discern;
L: Spirit of God, my teacher be,
L: Showing the things of Christ to me.

[Bait 3]
L: More about Jesus in His word,
L: Holding communion with my Lord,
L: Hearing His voice in every line,
L: Making each faithful saying mine.

[Bait 4]
L: More about Jesus on His throne,
L: Riches in glory all His own;
L: More of His kingdom's sure increase;
L: More of His coming, Prince of Peace.

songs.title: More Love To Thee
songs.author: Elizabeth Prentiss William H. Doane
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: More love O Christ to Thee;
L: More love to Thee,
L: More love to Thee!

[Bait 1]
L: More love to Thee, O Christ,
L: More love to Thee!
L: Hear Thou the prayer,
L: I make on bended knee.
L: This is my earnest plea:

[Bait 2]
L: Once earthly joy I craved,
L: Sought peace and rest.
L: Now Thee alone I seek;
L: Give what is best.
L: This all my prayer shall be:

[Bait 3]
L: Then shall my latest breath
L: Whisper Thy praise.
L: This be the parting cry
L: My heart shall raise;
L: This still my prayer shall be:

[Bait 4]
L: Let sorrow do its work,
L: Send grief and pain;
L: Sweet are Thy messengers,
L: Sweet their refrain,
L: When they can sing with me:

songs.title: My Burdens Rolled Away
songs.author: Minnie A. Steele
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Rolled away, rolled away,
L: I am happy since my burdens rolled away.
L: Rolled away, rolled away,
L: I am happy since my burdens rolled away.

[Bait 1]
L: I Remember when my burdens rolled away;
L: I had carried them for years, night and day.
L: When I sought the blessed Lord
L: And I took Him at His word,
L: Then at once all my burdens rolled away.

[Bait 2]
L: I remember when my burdens rolled away,
L: That I feared would never leave night or day,
L: Jesus showed to me the loss,
L: So I left them at the Cross;
L: I was glad when my burdens rolled away.

[Bait 3]
L: I remember when my burdens rolled away,
L: That had hindered me for years,
L: Night and day.
L: As I sought the throne of grace,
L: Just a glimpse of Jesus' face,
L: And I knew that my burdens
L: Could not stay.

[Bait 4]
L: I am singing
L: Since my burdens rolled away;
L: There's a song within my heart
L: Night and day.
L: I am living for my King,
L: And with joy I shout and sing,
L: Hallelujah!
L: All my burdens rolled away!

songs.title: My Faith Looks Up To Thee
songs.author: Lowell Mason Ray Palmer
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: My faith looks up to Thee,
L: Thou Lamb of Calvary,
L: Savior divine!
L: Now hear me while I pray;
L: Take all my guilt away.
L: Oh let me from this day
L: Be wholly Thine!

[Bait 2]
L: May Thy rich grace impart
L: Strength to my fainting heart,
L: My zeal inspire.
L: As Thou hast died for me,
L: Oh may my love to Thee
L: Pure, warm and changeless be,
L: A living fire.

[Bait 3]
L: While life's dark maze I tread,
L: And griefs around me spread
L: Be Thou my Guide.
L: Bid darkness turn to day;
L: Wipe sorrow's tears away;
L: Nor let me ever stray
L: From Thee aside!

[Bait 4]
L: When ends life's transient dream,
L: When death's cold sullen stream
L: Shall o'er me roll,
L: Blest Savior, then in love,
L: Fear and distrust remove.
L: Oh bear me safe above,
L: A ransomed soul.

songs.title: My Jesus I Love Thee
songs.author: Adoniram J. Gordon William R. Featherston
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: My Jesus I love Thee;
L: I know Thou art mine.
L: For Thee all the follies
L: Of sin I resign.
L: My gracious Redeemer,
L: My Savior art Thou.
L: If ever I loved Thee,
L: My Jesus, 'tis now.

[Bait 2]
L: I love Thee,
L: Because Thou hast first loved me,
L: And purchased my pardon
L: On Calvary's tree.
L: I love Thee
L: For wearing the thorns
L: On Thy brow,
L: If ever I loved Thee,
L: My Jesus, 'tis now.

[Bait 3]
L: I'll love Thee in life,
L: I will love Thee in death,
L: And praise Thee
L: As long as Thou lendest me breath;
L: And say when the death dew
L: Lies cold on my brow,
L: "If ever I loved Thee,
L: My Jesus 'tis now."

[Bait 4]
L: In mansions of glory
L: And endless delight,
L: I'll ever adore Thee
L: In heaven so bright.
L: I'll sing with the glittering crown
L: On my brow,
L: "If ever I loved Thee,
L: My Jesus, 'tis now."

songs.title: My Soul Be On Thy Guard
songs.author: George Heath Lowell Mason
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: My soul be on thy guard;
L: Ten thousand foes arise;
L: The hosts of sin are pressing hard
L: To draw you from the skies.

[Bait 2]
L: Oh, watch and fight and pray;
L: The battle ne'er give o'er.
L: Renew it boldly ev'ry day,
L: And help divine implore.

[Bait 3]
L: Ne'er think the vict'ry won,
L: Nor lay thine armor down;
L: The work of faith will not be done
L: Till thou obtain the crown.

[Bait 4]
L: Fight on, my soul, till death
L: Shall bring thee to thy God;
L: He'll take thee, at thy parting breath,
L: To His divine abode.

songs.title: Nearer My God To Thee
songs.author: Lowell Mason Sarah Flower Adams
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Nearer, my God, to Thee;
L: Nearer, my God, to Thee,
L: Nearer to Thee!

[Bait 1]
L: Nearer, my God, to Thee,
L: Nearer to Thee,
L: E'en though it be a cross
L: That raiseth me!
L: Still all my song shall be,

[Bait 2]
L: Though like the wanderer,
L: The sun gone down,
L: Darkness be over me,
L: My rest a stone;
L: Yet in my dreams I'd be,

[Bait 3]
L: There let the way appear,
L: Steps unto heaven;
L: All that Thou sendest me,
L: In mercy given;
L: Angels to beckon me,

[Bait 4]
L: Then, with my waking thoughts
L: Bright with Thy praise,
L: Out of my stony griefs
L: Bethel I'll raise,
L: So by my woes to be,

[Bait 5]
L: Or if, on joyful wing
L: Cleaving the sky,
L: Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
L: Upward I fly,
L: Still all my song shall be,

songs.title: Nearer Still Nearer
songs.author: Lelia N. Morris
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Nearer, still nearer
L: Close to Thy heart,
L: Draw me, my Savior
L: So precious Thou art!
L: Fold me oh fold me
L: To Thy breast,
L: Shelter me safe
L: In that "Haven of Rest";
L: Shelter me safe
L: In that "Haven of Rest."

[Bait 2]
L: Nearer, still nearer
L: Nothing I bring,
L: Naught as an offering
L: To Jesus, my King;
L: Only my sinful,
L: Now contrite heart.
L: Grant me the cleansing
L: Thy blood doth impart,
L: Grant me the cleansing
L: Thy blood doth impart.

[Bait 3]
L: Nearer, still nearer
L: While life shall last,
L: Till safe in glory
L: My anchor is cast;
L: Through endless ages ever to be,
L: Nearer, my Savior
L: Still nearer to Thee,
L: Nearer my Savior
L: Still nearer to Thee.

[Bait 4]
L: Nearer, still nearer
L: Lord to be Thine!
L: Sin with its follies
L: I gladly resign,
L: All of its pleasures,
L: Pomp and its pride.
L: Give me but Jesus
L: My Lord crucified;
L: Give me but Jesus
L: My Lord crucified.

songs.title: Nothing But The Blood
songs.author: Robert Lowry
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Oh! precious is the flow,
L: That makes me white as snow;
L: No other fount I know;
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

[Bait 1]
L: What can wash away my sin?
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
L: What can make me whole again?
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

[Bait 2]
L: For my pardon, this I see;
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
L: For my cleansing, this my plea;
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

[Bait 3]
L: Nothing can for sin atone,
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
L: Naught of good that I have done,
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

[Bait 4]
L: This is all my hope and peace,
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
L: This is all my righteousness,
L: Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

songs.title: Now Thank We All Our God
songs.author: Ahasverus Fritsch Catherine Winkworth Johann Sebas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Now thank we all our God,
L: With heart, and hands, and voices,
L: Who wondrous things hath done,
L: In whom His world rejoices;
L: Who from our mother's arms
L: Hath blessed us on our way
L: With countless gifts of love,
L: And still is ours today.

[Bait 2]
L: O may this bounteous God
L: Thro' all our life be near us,
L: With ever joyful hearts
L: And blessed peace to cheer us;
L: And keep us in His grace,
L: And guide us when perplexed,
L: And free us from all ills,
L: In this world and the next.

[Bait 3]
L: All praise and thanks to God
L: The Father now be given, the Son,
L: And Him who reigns with them
L: In highest heaven,
L: The one eternal God,
L: Whom earth and heav'n adore;
L: For thus it was, is now,
L: And shall be evermore.

songs.title: O Christmas Tree
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 2]
L: O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
L: You stand in verdant beauty.
L: O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
L: You stand in verdant beauty.
L: Your boughs are green in summer's glow,
L: And do not fade in winter's snow.
L: O Christmas tree O Christmas tree,
L: You stand in verdant beauty.

[Bait 3]
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Thy leaves are so unchanging,
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Thy leaves are so unchanging;
L: Not only green when summer's here,
L: But also when 'tis cold and drear.
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Thy leaves are so unchanging!

[Bait 4]
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Thy candles shine so brightly,
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Thy candles shine so brightly!

[Bait 5]
L: O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
L: You bear a wondrous message!
L: O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
L: You bear a wondrous message!
L: You do proclaim the Savior's birth,
L: Good will to men and peace on earth.
L: O Christmas Tree, O Christmas Tree,
L: You bear a wondrous message!

[Bait 6]
L: O Christmas Tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Of all the trees most lovely;
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Of all the trees most lovely;
L: Each year you bring to me delight
L: Gleaming in the Christmas night.
L: O christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Of all the trees most lovely.

[Bait 7]
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Your leaves will teach me also,
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Your leaves will teach me also
L: That hope and love and faithfulness
L: Are precious things I can possess.
L: O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree,
L: Your leaves will teach me also.

songs.title: O Come All Ye Faithful
songs.author: C. Frederick Oakley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O come all ye faithful,
L: Joyful and triumphant,
L: O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
L: Come and behold Him,
L: Born the King of angels:

[Reff 1]
L: O come, let us adore Him,
L: O come, let us adore Him,
L: O come, let us adore Him,
L: Christ the Lord.

[Bait 2]
L: God of God,
L: Light of light,
L: Lo! He abhors not the virgin's womb;
L: Very God,
L: Begotton not created:

[Bait 3]
L: Sing, choirs of angels,
L: Sing in exultation,
L: Sing all ye citizens of heaven above:
L: Glory to God
L: In the highest:

[Bait 4]
L: Yea, Lord, we greet Thee,
L: Born this happy morning,
L: Jesu, to Thee be glory given;
L: Word of the Father,
L: Now in flesh appearing:

songs.title: O Come O Come Emmanuel
songs.author: Henry S. Coffin John M. Neale Thomas Helmore
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel,
L: Shall come to thee, O Israel!

[Bait 1]
L: O come, O come Emmanuel
L: And ransom captive Israel,
L: That mourns in lonely exile here
L: Until the Son of God appear.

[Bait 2]
L: O come, thou Wisdom from on high,
L: And order all things far and nigh;
L: To us the path of knowledge show
L: And cause us in her ways to go.

[Bait 3]
L: O come, O come, great Lord of might,
L: Who to Thy tribes on Sinai's height
L: In ancient times once gave the law
L: In cloud and majesty and awe.

[Bait 4]
L: O come, thou Root of Jesse's tree,
L: An ensign of Thy people be;
L: Before Thee rulers silent fall;
L: All peoples on Thy mercy call.

[Bait 5]
L: O come, thou Key of David, come,
L: And open wide our heavenly home.
L: The captives from their prison free,
L: And conquer death's deep misery.

[Bait 6]
L: O come, thou Dayspring, come and cheer
L: Our spirits by Thy justice here;
L: Disperse the gloomy clouds of night,
L: And death's dark shadows put to flight.

[Bait 7]
L: O come, Desire of nations bind
L: All peoples in one heart and mind.
L: From dust Thou brought us forth to life;
L: Deliver us from earthly strife.

songs.title: O Could I Speak The Matchless Worth
songs.author: Samuel Medley Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O could I speak the matchless worth,
L: O could I sound the glories forth,
L: Which in my Savior shine?
L: I'd sing His glorious righteousness
L: And magnify the wondrous grace
L: Which made salvation mine;
L: Which made salvation mine.

[Bait 2]
L: I'd sing the precious blood He spilt,
L: My ransom from the dreadful guilt
L: Of sin, and wrath divine;
L: I'd sing His glorious righteousness,
L: In which all perfect, heavenly dress,
L: My soul shall ever shine;
L: My soul shall ever shine.

[Bait 3]
L: I'd sing the characters He bears
L: And all the forms of love He wears,
L: Exalted on His throne;
L: In loftiest songs of sweetest praise,
L: I would to everlasting days,
L: Make all His glories known;
L: Make all His glories known.

[Bait 4]
L: Soon the delightful day will come,
L: When my dear Lord will bring me home
L: And I shall see His face;
L: Then with my Savior brother friend,
L: A blest eternity I'll spend,
L: Triumphant in His grace;
L: Triumphant in His grace.
L: Amen.

songs.title: O For A Faith That Will Not Shrink
songs.author: Carl G. Glaser William H. Bathurst
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O for a faith that will not shrink,
L: Tho' pressed by ev'ry foe,
L: That will not tremble on the brink
L: Of any earthly woe!

[Bait 2]
L: That will not murmur nor complain,
L: Beneath the chastening rod
L: But in the hour of grief or pain,
L: Will lean upon its God.

[Bait 3]
L: A faith that shines more bright and clear
L: When tempests rage without;
L: That when in danger knows no fear,
L: In darkness feels no doubt.

[Bait 4]
L: That bears, unmoved, the world's dread frown,
L: Nor heeds its scornful smile;
L: That seas of trouble cannot drown,
L: Nor Satan's arts beguile.

[Bait 5]
L: Lord give us such a faith as this;
L: And then whate'er may come,
L: We'll taste e'en here the hollowed bliss,
L: Of an eternal home.

songs.title: O For A Heart To Praise My God
songs.author: Charles Wesley Thomas Haweis
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O for a heart to praise my God,
L: A heart from sin set free,
L: A heart that always feels thy blood
L: So freely shed for me.

[Bait 2]
L: A heart resigned, submissive, meek,
L: My great Redeemer's throne,
L: Where only Christ is heard to speak,
L: Where Jesus reigns alone.

[Bait 3]
L: A humble, lowly, contrite heart,
L: Believing, true, and clean,
L: Which neither life nor death can part
L: From Christ who dwells within.

[Bait 4]
L: A heart in every thought renewed
L: And full of love divine,
L: Perfect and right and pure and good,
L: A copy, Lord, of thine.

[Bait 5]
L: Thy nature, gracious Lord, impart;
L: Come quickly from above;
L: Write thy new name upon my heart,
L: Thy new, best name of Love.

songs.title: O For A Thousand Tongues To Sing
songs.author: Carl G. Glaser Charles Wesley
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O for a thousand tongues to sing
L: My great Redeemer's praise,
