L: The glories of my God and King,
L: The triumphs of His grace!

[Bait 2]
L: My gracious Master and my God,
L: Assist me to proclaim,
L: To spread through all the earth abroad,
L: The honors of Thy name.

[Bait 3]
L: Jesus! The name that charms our fears,
L: That bids our sorrows cease;
L: 'Tis music in the sinner's ears;
L: 'Tis life, and health, and peace.

[Bait 4]
L: He breaks the power of canceled sin;
L: He sets the prisoner free.
L: His blood can make the foulest clean;
L: His blood availed for me.

[Bait 5]
L: Hear Him, ye deaf, His praise, ye dumb,
L: Your loosened tongues employ.
L: Ye blind, behold your Savior come,
L: And leap ye lame for joy.

[Bait 6]
L: Glory to God and praise and love
L: Be ever, ever giv'n
L: By saints below and saints above
L: The church in earth and heav'n.

songs.title: O God Our Help In Ages Past
songs.author: Isaac Watts William Croft
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O God, our Help in ages past,
L: Our Hope for years to come,
L: Our Shelter from the stormy blast,
L: And our eternal Home!

[Bait 2]
L: Under the shadow of Thy throne
L: Still may we dwell secure;
L: Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
L: And our defense is sure.

[Bait 3]
L: Before the hills in order stood,
L: Or earth received her frame,
L: From everlasting Thou art God,
L: To endless years the same.

[Bait 4]
L: O God, our Help in ages past,
L: Our Hope for years to come,
L: Be Thou my Guide while life shall last,
L: And our eternal Home.

[Bait 5]
L: A thousand ages in Thy sight,
L: Are like and evening gone;
L: Short as the watch that ends the night,
L: Before the rising sun.

[Bait 6]
L: Time like an ever rolling stream,
L: Bears all its sons away;
L: They fly, forgotten, as a dream
L: Die at the op'ning day.

songs.title: O Happy Day
songs.author: Edward F. Rimbault Philip Doddridge
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Happy day, happy day,
L: When Jesus washed my sins away!
L: He taught me how to watch and pray,
L: And live rejoicing every day.

[Bait 1]
L: O happy day that fixed my choice
L: On Thee, my Savior and my God!
L: Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
L: And tell its raptures all abroad.

[Bait 2]
L: Tis done, the great transaction's done;
L: I am my Lord's and He is mine.
L: He drew me and I followed on,
L: Charmed to confess the voice divine.

[Bait 3]
L: Now rest, my long divided heart;
L: Fixed on this blissful center; rest;
L: Nor ever from my Lord depart,
L: With Him of every good possessed.

[Bait 4]
L: O happy bond that seals my vows
L: To Him who merits all my love!
L: Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
L: While to that sacred shrine I move.

[Bait 5]
L: High heaven, that heard the solemn vow,
L: That vow renewed shall daily hear,
L: Till in life's latest hour I bow
L: And bless in death a bond so dear.

songs.title: O Holy Night
songs.author: Adolphe Adam Chappeau de Roquemaure John S. Dwight
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Fall on your knees!
L: Oh hear the angel voices!
L: Oh night divine!
L: Oh night when Christ was born,
L: Oh night divine!
L: Oh night, oh night divine!

[Bait 1]
L: O holy night!
L: The stars are brightly shining;
L: It is the night
L: Of the dear Savior's birth.
L: Long lay the world
L: In sin and error pining;
L: Till He appeared
L: And the soul felt its worth.
L: A thrill of hope,
L: The weary world rejoices;
L: For yonder breaks,
L: A new and glorious morn.
L: Fall on your knees,

[Bait 2]
L: Led by the light
L: Of faith serenely beaming,
L: With glowing hearts
L: By His cradle we stand.
L: So led by light
L: Of a star sweetly gleaming,
L: Here came the wise men
L: From orient land.
L: The King of kings
L: Lay thus in lowly manger,
L: In all our trials
L: Born to be our Friend;
L: He knows our need
L: To our weakness is no stranger.
L: Behold your King
L: Before Him lowly bend;
L: Behold your King
L: Before Him lowly bend!

[Bait 3]
L: Truly He taught us
L: To love one another,
L: His law is love
L: And His gospel is peace;
L: Chains shall He break
L: For the slave is our brother,
L: And in His name
L: All oppression shall cease.
L: Sweet hymns of joy
L: In grateful chorus raise we,
L: Let all within us
L: Praise His holy name.
L: Christ is the Lord
L: O praise His name forever.
L: His power and glory evermore proclaim;
L: His power and glory evermore proclaim.

songs.title: O How I Love Jesus
songs.author: Frederick Whitfield
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O, how I love Jesus,
L: O, how I love Jesus,
L: O, how I love Jesus;
L: Because He first loved me.

[Reff 2]
L: To me He is so wonderful,
L: To me He is so wonderful,
L: To me He is so wonderful;
L: Because He first loved me.

[Reff 3]
L: O, how I love God's Word,
L: O, how I love God's Word,
L: O, how I love God's Word;
L: It tells of His love for me.

[Bait 1]
L: There is a name I love to hear,
L: I love to sing its worth;
L: It sounds like music in my ear,
L: The sweetest name on earth.

[Bait 2]
L: It tells me of a Savior's love,
L: Who died to set me free;
L: It tells me of His precious blood,
L: The sinner's perfect plea.

[Bait 3]
L: It tells me what my Father hath,
L: In store for ev'ry day;
L: And tho' I tread a darksome path,
L: Yields sunshine all the way.

[Bait 4]
L: It tells of One whose loving heart,
L: Can feel my deepest woe;
L: Who in each sorrow bears a part,
L: That none can bear below.

songs.title: O Little Town Of Bethlehem
songs.author: Lewis H. Redner Phillips Brooks
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O little town of Bethlehem,
L: How still we see thee lie;
L: Above thy deep and dreamless sleep,
L: The silent stars go by.
L: Yet in thy dark streets shineth
L: The everlasting Light;
L: The hopes and fears of all the years,
L: Are met in thee tonight.

[Bait 2]
L: For Christ is born of Mary
L: And gathered all above;
L: While mortals sleep the angels keep
L: Their watch of wondering love.
L: O, morning stars together
L: Proclaim the holy birth;
L: And praises sing to God the King
L: And peace to men on earth.

[Bait 3]
L: How silently, how silently,
L: The wondrous gift is giv'n;
L: So God imparts to human hearts,
L: The blessings of His heaven.
L: No ear may hear His coming,
L: But in this world of sin;
L: Where meek souls will
L: Receive Him still,
L: The dear Christ enters in.

[Bait 4]
L: O, holy child of Bethlehem,
L: Descend to us we pray;
L: Cast out our sin and enter in,
L: Be born in us today.
L: We hear the Christmas angels,
L: The great glad tidings tell;
L: O, come to us abide with us,
L: Our Lord, Emmanuel.

songs.title: O Love That Will Not Let Me Go
songs.author: Albert Lister Peace George Matheson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O love that will not let me go,
L: I rest my weary soul in Thee.
L: I give Thee back the life I owe,
L: That in Thine ocean depths its flow,
L: May richer fuller be.

[Bait 2]
L: O light that foll'west all my way,
L: I yield my flick'ring torch to Thee.
L: My heart restores its borrowed ray,
L: That in Thy sunshine's blaze it's day,
L: May brighter fairer be.

[Bait 3]
L: O joy that seekest me through pain,
L: I cannot close my heart to Thee.
L: I trace the rainbow through the rain,
L: And feel the promise is not vain,
L: That morn shall tearless be.

[Bait 4]
L: O cross that lifted up my head,
L: I dare not ask to fly from Thee.
L: I lay in dust life's glory dead,
L: And from the ground there blossoms red,
L: Life that shall endless be.

songs.title: O Thou In Whose Presence
songs.author: Freeman Lewis Joseph Swain
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O Thou in whose presence
L: My soul takes delight,
L: On Whom in affliction I call
L: My Comfort by day
L: And my Song in the night,
L: My Hope, my Salvation, my All!

[Bait 2]
L: Where dost Thou, dear Shepherd,
L: Resort with Thy sheep.
L: To feed them in pastures of love?
L: Say, why in the valley,
L: Of death should I weep,
L: Or alone in this wilderness rove?

[Bait 3]
L: O, why should I wander,
L: An alien from Thee,
L: Or cry in the desert
L: For bread?
L: Thy foes will rejoice,
L: When my sorrows they see,
L: And smile at the tears,
L: I have shed.

[Bait 4]
L: Ye daughters of Zion declare,
L: Have you seen the star,
L: That on Israel shone.
L: Say if in your tents,
L: My beloved has been,
L: And where with His flocks
L: He is gone.

[Bait 5]
L: He looks! And ten thousands
L: Of angels rejoice,
L: And myriads wait for His word.
L: He speaks! And eternity,
L: Filled with His voice,
L: Re-echoes the praise of the Lord.

[Bait 6]
L: Dear Shepherd! I hear,
L: And will follow Thy call;
L: I know the sweet sound of Thy voice.
L: Restore and defend me,
L: For Thou art my all,
L: And in Thee I will ever rejoice.

songs.title: O Worship The King
songs.author: Johann Michael Haydn Robert Grant William Gardiner
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: O worship the King,
L: All glorious above,
L: And gratefully sing
L: His power and His love:
L: Our Shield and Defender,
L: The Ancient of Days,
L: Pavilioned in splendor,
L: And girded with praise.

[Bait 2]
L: O tell of His might,
L: And sing of His grace,
L: Whose robe is the light,
L: Whose canopy space.
L: His chariots of wrath,
L: The deep thunderclouds form,
L: And dark is His path
L: On the wings of the storm.

[Bait 3]
L: Thy bountiful care,
L: What tongue can recite?
L: It breathes in the air;
L: It shines in the light.
L: It streams from the hills;
L: It descends to the plain,
L: And sweetly distills
L: In the dew and the rain.

[Bait 4]
L: Frail children of dust,
L: And feeble as frail,
L: In Thee do we trust,
L: Nor find Thee to fail.
L: Thy mercies how tender!
L: How firm to the end!
L: Our Maker, Defender,
L: Redeemer, and Friend!

songs.title: Of The Father's Love Begotten
songs.author: Henry Williams Baker John Mason Neale Marcus Aurel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Of the Father's love begotten,
L: Ere the world began to be;
L: He is Alpha and Omega,
L: He the source, the ending He.
L: Of the things that are that have been
L: And that future years shall see;
L: Evermore and evermore!

[Bait 2]
L: O, ye heights of heaven adore Him,
L: Angel hosts; His praises sing;
L: Pow'rs, dominions, bow before Him
L: And extol our God and King;
L: Let no tongue on earth be silent,
L: Ev'ry voice in concert ring;
L: Evermore and evermore!

[Bait 3]
L: Christ, to Thee with God the Father,
L: And, O Holy Ghost, to Thee;
L: Hymn and chant and high thanksgiving
L: And unwearied praises be:
L: Honor, glory, and dominion and eternal victory;
L: Evermore and evermore!
L: Amen.

[Bait 4]
L: O that birth forever blessed
L: When the Virgin, full of grace,
L: By the Holy Ghost conceiving,
L: Bare the Savior of our race;
L: And the Babe, the world's Redeemer
L: First revealed His sacred face,
L: Evermore and evermore!

songs.title: Once In Royal David's City
songs.author: Cecil Frances Humphreys Alexander Henry John Gaunt
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Once in royal David's city,
L: Stood a lowly cattle shed;
L: Where a mother laid her baby,
L: In a manger for His bed.
L: Mary was that mother mild,
L: Jesus Christ, her little Child.

[Bait 2]
L: He came down to earth from heaven,
L: Who is God and Lord of all;
L: And His shelter was a stable,
L: And His cradle was a stall.
L: With the poor and meek and lowly,
L: Lived on earth, our Savior holy.

[Bait 3]
L: Jesus is our childhood's pattern,
L: Day by day like us He grew;
L: He was little, weak and helpless,
L: Tears and smiles like us He knew.
L: And He feels for all our sadness,
L: And He shares in all our gladness.

[Bait 4]
L: And our eyes at last shall see Him,
L: Through His own redeeming love,
L: For that Child so dear and gentle,
L: Is our Lord in heaven above;
L: And He leads His children on,
L: To the place where He has gone.

[Bait 5]
L: Not in that poor lowly stable,
L: With the oxen standing by;
L: We shall see Him but in heaven,
L: Set at God's right hand on high.
L: There His children gather round,
L: Bright like stars with glory crowned.

[Bait 6]
L: And through all
L: His wondrous childhood
L: He would honor and obey,
L: Love and watch the lowly maiden
L: In whose gentle arms He lay;
L: Christian children,
L: All must be mild, obedient,
L: Good as He.

songs.title: Open My Eyes That I May See
songs.author: Clara H. Scott
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Open my eyes that I may see
L: Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
L: Place in my hands the wonderful key
L: That shall unclasp and set me free.
L: Silently now I wait for Thee,
L: Ready my God Thy will to see.
L: Open my eyes. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

[Bait 2]
L: Open my ears that I may hear
L: Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
L: And while the wave-notes fall on my ear,
L: Everything false will disappear.
L: Silently now I wait for Thee,
L: Ready my God Thy will to see.
L: Open my ears, Illumine me, Spirit divine!

[Bait 3]
L: Open my mouth and let me bear
L: Gladly the warm truth everywhere.
L: Open my heart and let me prepare
L: Love with Thy children thus to share.
L: Silently now I wait for Thee,
L: Ready my God Thy will to see.
L: Open my heart. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

[Bait 4]
L: Open my mind that I may read
L: More of Thy love in word and deed.
L: What shall I fear while yet Thou dost lead?
L: Only for light from Thee I plead.
L: Silently now I wait for Thee,
L: Ready, my God, Thy will to see.
L: Open my mind. Illumine me, Spirit divine!

songs.title: Our Day Of Joy Is Here Again
songs.author: Andrew L. Skoog
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Glory to our God, we sing,
L: Glory to our Lord and King;
L: Peace, goodwill with all abide,
L: This holy Christmas tide.

[Bait 1]
L: Our day of joy is here again,
L: With love and peace and song;
L: Come, let us join the angelic strain
L: With voices clear and strong.

[Bait 2]
L: When darkness lay upon the earth,
L: A glorious light did shine;
L: God sent a Gift of priceless worth
L: And showed His love divine.

[Bait 3]
L: Now to the manger let us go
L: To worship and adore;
L: The tender Babe upon the straw,
L: Our Savior evermore.

[Bait 4]
L: How wonderful that God's own Son
L: Should so Himself abase!
L: He thrust the mighty from their throne,
L: And gave the lowly grace.

songs.title: Our Great Savior
songs.author: J. Wilbur Chapman Rowland H. Prichard
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Hallelujah what a Savior.
L: Hallelujah what a Friend.
L: Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
L: He is with me to the end.

[Bait 1]
L: Jesus! What a friend for sinners!
L: Jesus lover of my soul!
L: Friends may fail me, foes assail me;
L: He, my Savior, makes me whole.

[Bait 2]
L: Jesus! What a strength in weakness!
L: Let me hide myself in Him;
L: Tempted tried and sometimes failing,
L: He, my strength my victory wins.

[Bait 3]
L: Jesus! What a help in sorrow!
L: While the billows o'er me roll,
L: Even when my heart is breaking,
L: He, my Comfort helps my soul.

[Bait 4]
L: Jesus! What a guide and keeper!
L: While the tempest still is high,
L: Storms about me, night o'ertakes me,
L: He, my pilot hears my cry.

[Bait 5]
L: Jesus! I do now receive Him;
L: More than all in Him I find.
L: He hath granted me forgiveness;
L: I am His and He is mine.

songs.title: Pass Me Not
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby William H. Doane
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Savior, Savior, hear my humble cry.
L: While on others Thou art calling,
L: Do not pass me by.

[Bait 1]
L: Pass me not, O gentle Savior;
L: Hear my humble cry.
L: While on others Thou art calling,
L: Do not pass me by.

[Bait 2]
L: Let me at Thy throne of mercy
L: Find a sweet relief;
L: Kneeling there in deep contrition,
L: Help my unbelief.

[Bait 3]
L: Trusting only in Thy merit,
L: Would I seek Thy face.
L: Heal my wounded, broken spirit.
L: Save me by Thy grace.

[Bait 4]
L: Thou, the Spring of all my comfort,
L: More than life to me,
L: Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
L: Whom in heaven but Thee?

songs.title: Praise Him Praise Him
songs.author: Chester G. Allen Fanny Jane Crosby
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Praise Him! Praise Him!
L: Tell of His excellent greatness,
L: Praise Him! Praise Him!
L: Ever in joyful song.

[Bait 1]
L: Praise Him! Praise Him!
L: Jesus our blessed Redeemer!
L: Sing, O earth,
L: His wonderful love proclaim,
L: Hail Him! Hail Him!
L: Highest archangels in glory,
L: Strength and honor
L: Give to His holy name.
L: Like a shepherd
L: Jesus will guard His children,
L: In His arms He carries them
L: All day long.

[Bait 2]
L: Praise Him! Praise Him!
L: Jesus our blessed Redeemer!
L: For our sins He suffered
L: And bled and died,
L: He, our Rock,
L: Our hope of eternal salvation,
L: Hail Him! Hail Him!
L: Jesus the Crucified.
L: Sound His praises,
L: Jesus who bore our sorrows,
L: Love unbounded,
L: Wonderful, deep and strong.

[Bait 3]
L: Praise Him! Praise Him!
L: Jesus our blessed Redeemer.
L: Heavenly portals,
L: Loud with hosannas ring,
L: Jesus, Savior,
L: Reigneth forever and ever,
L: Crown Him! Crown Him!
L: Prophet and Priest and King.
L: Christ is coming
L: Over the world victorious;
L: Power and glory
L: Unto the Lord belong.

songs.title: Praise My Soul The King Of Heaven
songs.author: Henry F. Lyte John Goss
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Praise my soul, the King of heaven;
L: To His feet thy tribute bring;
L: Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
L: Evermore His praises sing:
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Praise the everlasting King!

[Bait 2]
L: Praise Him for His grace and favor
L: To our fathers in distress.
L: Praise Him, still the same forever.
L: Slow to chide and swift to bless:
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Glorious in His faithfulness!

[Bait 3]
L: Father-like He tends and spares us.
L: Well our feeble frame He knows;
L: In His hands He gently bears us,
L: Rescues us from all our foes:
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Widely yet His mercy flows!

[Bait 4]
L: Angels in the height, adore Him,
L: Ye behold Him face to face;
L: Sun and moon, bow down before Him,
L: Dwellers all in time and space:
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: Praise with us the God of grace!

[Bait 5]
L: Frail as summer's flow'r we flourish;
L: Blows the wind and it is gone;
L: But, while mortals rise and perish,
L: God endures unchanging on:
L: Praise Him, praise Him,
L: Praise Him, praise Him,
L: Praise with us the God of grace.

songs.title: Praise The Lord Ye Heavens Adore Him
songs.author: Edward Osler Rowland H. Prichard
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: Praise The Savior
songs.author: Thomas Kelly
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Praise the Savior, ye who know Him!
L: Who can tell how much we owe Him?
L: Gladly let us render to Him
L: All we are and have.

[Bait 2]
L: Jesus is the name that charms us,
L: He for conflict fits and arms us;
L: Nothing moves and nothing harms us
L: While we trust in Him.

[Bait 3]
L: Trust in Him, ye saints, forever;
L: He is faithful, changing never.
L: Neither force nor guile can sever
L: Those He loves from Him.

[Bait 4]
L: Keep us, Lord,
L: O keep us cleaving to Thyself
L: And still believing;
L: 'Til the hour of our receiving,
L: Promised joys with Thee.

[Bait 5]
L: Then we shall be where we would be,
L: Then we shall be what we should be;
L: Things that are not now, nor could be,
L: Soon shall be our own.

songs.title: Praise To The Lord The Almighty
songs.author: Catherine Winkworth Joachim Neander
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty,
L: The King of creation!
L: O my soul, praise Him,
L: For He is thy health and salvation!
L: All ye who hear,
L: Now to His temple draw near;
L: Join me in glad adoration!

[Bait 2]
L: Praise to the Lord,
L: Who o'er all things
L: So wondrously reigneth,
L: Shelters thee under His wings,
L: Yes, so gently sustaineth!
L: Hast Thou not seen
L: How all thy longings have been
L: Granted in what He ordaineth?

[Bait 3]
L: Praise to the Lord!
L: O let all that is in me adore Him!
L: All that hath life and breath,
L: Come now with praises before Him.
L: Let the amen sound from His people again:
L: Gladly for aye we adore Him.

[Bait 4]
L: Praise to the Lord,
L: Who doth prosper
L: Thy work and defend thee;
L: Surely His goodness and mercy
L: Here daily attend thee.
L: Ponder anew what the Almighty can do,
L: If with His love He befriend thee.

songs.title: Rejoice The Lord Is King
songs.author: Charles Wesley George Frederick Handel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
L: Rejoice; again I say, rejoice.

[Reff 2]
L: We soon shall hear the archangel's voice;
L: The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!

[Bait 1]
L: Rejoice, the Lord is King!
L: Your Lord and King adore;
L: Mortals, give thanks and sing,
L: And triumph evermore.

[Bait 2]
L: Jesus the Savior reigns,
L: The God of truth and love;
L: When He had purged our stains,
L: He took His seat above.

[Bait 3]
L: His kingdom cannot fail;
L: He rules o'er earth and heaven;
L: The keys of earth and hell
L: Are to our Jesus given.

[Bait 4]
L: Rejoice in glorious hope!
L: Jesus the Judge shall come
L: And take His servants up
L: To their eternal home.

songs.title: Revive Us Again
songs.author: John J. Husband William P. MacKay
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Hallelujah! Thine the glory!
L: Hallelujah! Amen!
L: Hallelujah! Thine the glory!
L: Revive us again.

[Bait 1]
L: We praise Thee, O God,
L: For the Son of Thy love;
L: For Jesus, who died
L: And is now gone above.

[Bait 2]
L: We praise Thee, O God,
L: For Thy Spirit of light,
L: Who has shown us our Savior
L: And scattered our night.

[Bait 3]
L: All glory and praise
L: To the Lamb that was slain,
L: Who has borne all our sins
L: And hath cleansed every stain.

[Bait 4]
L: Revive us again;
L: Fill each heart with Thy love;
L: May each soul be rekindled
L: With fire from above.

songs.title: Ring The Bells Of Heaven
songs.author: George F. Root William O. Cushing
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Glory! Glory! How the angels sing!
L: Glory! Glory! How the loud harps ring!
L: 'Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
L: Pealing forth the anthem of the free.

[Bait 1]
L: Ring the bells of heaven!
L: There is joy today,
L: For a soul returning from the wild!
L: See the Father meets Him out upon the way,
L: Welcoming His weary wand'ring child.

[Bait 2]
L: Ring the bells of heaven!
L: There is joy today,
L: For the wand'rer now is reconciled.
L: Yes a soul is rescued from His sinful way,
L: And is born anew a ransomed child.

[Bait 3]
L: Ring the bells of heaven!
L: Spread the feast today!
L: Angels swell the glad triumphant strain!
L: Tell the joyful tidings;
L: Bear it far away!
L: For a precious soul is born again.

songs.title: Rock Of Ages
songs.author: Augustus M. Toplady Thomas Hastings
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
L: Let me hide myself in Thee.
L: Let the water and the blood,
L: From Thy wounded side which flowed,
L: Be of sin the double cure,
L: Save from wrath and make me pure.

[Bait 2]
L: Nothing in my hand I bring,
L: Simply to Thy cross I cling;
L: Naked come to Thee for dress,
L: Helpless look to Thee for grace;
L: Foul I to the fountain fly,
L: Wash me Savior or I die.

[Bait 3]
L: Not the labor of my hands,
L: Can fulfill Thy law's demands;
L: Could my zeal no respite know,
L: Could my tears forever flow,
L: All for sin could not atone;
L: Thou must save and Thou alone.

[Bait 4]
L: While I draw this fleeting breath,
L: When my eyes shall close in death,
L: When I rise to worlds unknown,
L: And behold Thee on Thy throne,
L: Rock of Ages cleft for me,
L: Let me hide myself in Thee.

[Bait 5]
L: Could my tears forever flow?
L: Could my zeal no languor know?
L: These for sin could not atone;
L: Thou must save, and Thou alone.
L: In my hand no price I bring;
L: Simply to thy cross I cling.

songs.title: Satisfied
songs.author: Clara Teare Williams Ralph E. Hudson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Hallelujah! I have found Him
L: Whom my soul so long has craved!
L: Jesus satisfies my longings;
L: Thro' His blood I now am saved.

[Bait 1]
L: All my lifelong I had panted,
L: For a draught from some cool spring
L: That I hoped would quench the burning
L: Of the thirst I felt within.

[Bait 2]
L: Feeding on the husks around me
L: Till my strength was almost gone,
L: Longed my soul for something better,
L: Only still to hunger on.

[Bait 3]
L: Poor I was and sought for riches,
L: Something that would satisfy;
L: But the dust I gathered round me
L: Only mocked my soul's sad cry.

[Bait 4]
L: Well of water, ever springing,
L: Bread of life, so rich and free,
L: Untold wealth that never faileth,
L: My Redeemer is to me.

songs.title: Saved
songs.author: Oswald J. Smith Roger M. Hickman
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Saved! I'm saved thro' Christ,
L: My all in all.
L: Saved! I'm saved,
L: Whatever may befall.
L: He died upon the cross for me,
L: He bore the awful penalty.
L: And now I'm saved eternally,
L: I'm saved! Saved! Saved!

[Bait 1]
L: Saved! Saved! Saved!
L: My sins are all forgiv'n,
L: Christ is mine!
L: I'm on my way to heaven,
L: Once a guilty sinner, lost, undone,
L: Now a child of God,
L: Saved thro' His Son.

[Bait 2]
L: Saved! Saved! Saved!
L: By grace and grace alone.
L: Oh, what wondrous love
L: To me was shown,
L: In my stead
L: Christ Jesus bled and died.
L: Bore my sins,
L: For me was crucified.

[Bait 3]
L: Saved! Saved! Saved!
L: Oh joy beyond compare!
L: Christ my life,
L: And I His constant care,
L: Yielding all and trusting Him alone,
L: Living now each moment as His own.

songs.title: Savior Like A Shepherd Lead Us
songs.author: D. Thrupp
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Savior, like a shepherd lead us;
L: Much we need Your tender care.
L: In Your pleasant pastures feed us,
L: For our use Your folds prepare.
L: Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
L: You have bought us: Yours we are.

[Bait 2]
L: We are Yours; in love befriend us,
L: Be the guardian of our way;
L: Keep Your flock, from sin defend us,
L: Seek us when we go astray.
L: Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
L: Hear Your children when we pray.

[Bait 3]
L: You have promised to receive us,
L: Poor and sinful though we be;
L: You have mercy to relieve us,
L: Grace to cleanse, and power to free.
L: Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
L: Early let us turn to You.

[Bait 4]
L: Early let us seek Your favor,
L: Early let us do Your will;
L: Blessed Lord and only Savior,
L: With Your love our spirits fill.
L: Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
L: You have loved us; love us still.

songs.title: Silent Night Holy Night
songs.author: Franz Gruber John Freeman Young Joseph Mohr
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Silent night, holy night,
L: All is calm, all is bright.
L: Round yon virgin mother and child;
L: Holy infant, so tender and mild,
L: Sleep in heavenly peace;
L: Sleep in heavenly peace.

[Bait 2]
L: Silent night, holy night,
L: Shepherds quake at the sight.
L: Glories stream from heaven afar,
L: Heavenly hosts sing "Alleluia.
L: Christ the Savior is born;
L: Christ the Savior is born."

[Bait 3]
L: Silent night, holy night,
L: Son of God, love's pure light.
L: Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
L: With the dawn of redeeming grace.
L: Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth;
L: Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.

[Bait 4]
L: Silent night, holy night,
L: Wondrous star, lend thy light.
L: With the angels, let us sing,
L: Alleluia to our King.
L: Christ the Savior is born;
L: Christ the Savior is born.

songs.title: Since Jesus Came Into My Heart
songs.author: Charles H. Gabriel Rufus H. McDaniel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Since Jesus came into my heart,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart,
L: Floods of joy o'er my soul
L: Like the sea billows roll,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

[Bait 1]
L: What a wonderful change
L: In my life has been wrought
L: Since Jesus came into my heart!
L: I have light in my soul,
L: For which long I have sought,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

[Bait 2]
L: I have ceased from my
L: Wandering and going astray
L: Since Jesus came into my heart;
L: And my sins which were many
L: Are all washed away,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

[Bait 3]
L: There's a light in the
L: Valley of death now for me,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart;
L: And the gates of the city
L: Beyond I can see,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

[Bait 4]
L: I shall go there to dwell
L: In that city I know,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart;
L: And I'm happy, so happy,
L: As onward I go,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

[Bait 5]
L: I'm possessed of a hope
L: That is steadfast and sure,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart;
L: And no dark clouds of doubt
L: Now my pathway obscure,
L: Since Jesus came into my heart.

songs.title: Sing Praise To God Who Reigns Above
songs.author: Frances E. Cox Johann J. Schutz
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Sing praise to God who reigns above,
L: The God of all creation;
L: The God of pow'r the God of love,
L: The God of our salvation.
L: With healing balm my soul He fills,
L: And ev'ry faithless murmur still;
L: To God, all praise and glory.

[Bait 2]
L: What God's almighty pow'r hath made,
L: His gracious mercy keepeth;
L: By morning glow or evening shade,
L: His watchful eye ne'er sleepeth.
L: Within the kingdom of His might,
L: Lo, all is just and all is right;
L: To God, all praise and glory.

[Bait 3]
L: The Lord is never far away,
L: But, thru all grief distressing,
L: And everpresent help and stay,
L: Our peace and joy and blessing.
L: As with a mother's tender hand,
L: He leads His own, His chosen band,
L: To God, all praise and glory.

[Bait 4]
L: Thus all my toilsome way along,
L: I sing aloud His praises;
L: That men may hear the grateful song.
L: My voice unwearied raises,
L: Be joyful in the Lord my heart;
L: Both soul and body bear your part,
L: To God all praise and glory.

songs.title: Singing I Go
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt William J. Kirkpatrick
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Singing I go along life's road,
L: Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
L: Singing I go along life's road,
L: For Jesus has lifted my load.

[Bait 1]
L: The trusting heart to Jesus clings,
L: Nor any ill forebodes,
L: But at the cross of Calvary sings,
L: "Praise God for lifted loads!"

[Bait 2]
L: The passing days bring many cares.
L: "Fear not," I hear Him say;
L: And when my fears are turned to prayers,
L: The burdens slip away.

[Bait 3]
L: He tells me of my Father's love,
L: And never slumbering eye;
L: My everlasting King above
L: Will all my needs supply.

[Bait 4]
L: When to the throne of grace I flee,
L: I find the promise true;
L: The mighty arms upholding me
L: Will bear my burdens too.

songs.title: Softly And Tenderly
songs.author: Will L. Thompson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Come home, come home.
L: Ye who are weary, come home.
L: Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
L: Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

[Bait 1]
L: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
L: Calling for you and for me.
L: See, on the portals,
L: He's waiting and watching,
L: Watching for you and for me.

[Bait 2]
L: Why should we tarry
L: When Jesus is pleading,
L: Pleading for you and for me?
L: Why should we linger
L: And heed not His mercies,
L: Mercies for you and for me?

[Bait 3]
L: Time is now fleeting;
L: The moments are passing,
L: Passing from you and from me.
L: Shadows are gathering;
L: Death's night is coming,
L: Coming for you and for me.

[Bait 4]
L: Oh for the wonderful
L: Love He has promised,
L: Promised for you and for me!
L: Though we have sinned,
L: He has mercy and pardon,
L: Pardon for you and for me.

songs.title: Stand Up And Bless The Lord
songs.author: Charles Lockhart James Montgomery
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Stand up and bless the Lord your God
L: Ye people of God's choice;
L: Stand up and bless the Lord your God
L: With heart and soul and voice.

[Bait 2]
L: Though high above all praise,
L: Above all blessing high,
L: Who would not fear His holy name,
L: And laud and magnify?

[Bait 3]
L: O for the living flame
L: From God's own altar brought,
L: To touch our lips, our minds inspire,
L: And wing to heaven our thought!

[Bait 4]
L: God is our strength and song,
L: Now is salvation ours;
L: Then be God's love in Christ proclaimed
L: With all our ransomed powers.

[Bait 5]
L: Stand up and bless the Lord;
L: The Lord your God adore;
L: Stand up and bless God's glorious name,
L: Henceforth forevermore.

songs.title: Star Spangled Banner
songs.author: Francis Scott Key John Stafford Smith
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Oh, say, can you see,
L: By the dawn's early light,
L: What so proudly we hailed
L: At the twilight's last gleaming?
L: Whose broad stripes and bright stars,
L: Thro' the perilous fight,
L: O'er the ramparts we watched,
L: Were so gallantly streaming?
L: And the rocket's red glare,
L: The bombs bursting in air,
L: Gave proof thro' the night,
L: That our flag was still there.
L: Oh, say, does that star-spangled
L: Banner yet wave
L: O'er the land of the free,
L: And the home of the brave?

[Bait 2]
L: Oh, thus be it ever,
L: When freemen shall stand
L: Between their loved homes,
L: And the war's desolation;
L: Blest with vict'ry and peace,
L: May the heav'n rescued land
L: Praise the Pow'r that hath made.
L: And preserved us a nation!
L: Then conquer we must,
L: When our cause it is just;
L: And this be our motto:
L: "In God is our trust!"
L: And the star-spangled banner
L: In triumph shall wave
L: O'er the land of the free,
L: And the home of the brave.

[Bait 3]
L: On the shore, dimly seen
L: Thro' the mists of the deep,
L: Where the foe's haughty host
L: In dread silence reposes,
L: What is that which the breeze,
L: O'er the towering steep,
L: As it fitfully blows,
L: Half conceals, half discloses?
L: Now it catches the gleam
L: Of the morning's first beam,
L: In full glory reflected,
L: Now shines on the stream:
L: 'Tis the star-spangled banner;
L: Oh, long may it wave
L: O'er the land of the free,
L: And the home of the brave.

[Bait 4]
L: And where is that band,
L: Who so vauntingly swore
L: That the havoc of war
L: And the battle's confusion,
L: A home and a country
L: Should leave us no more?
L: Their blood has washed out
L: Their foul footsteps' pollution;
L: No refuge could save
L: The hireling and slave
L: From the terror of flight
L: Or the gloom of the grave.
L: And the star-spangled banner
L: In triumph shall wave
L: O'er the land of the free,
L: And the home of the brave.

songs.title: Sunlight Sunlight
songs.author: Judson Van DeVenter Winfield S. Weeden
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Sunlight, sunlight in my soul today!
L: Sunlight, sunlight all along the way!
L: Since the Savior found me,
L: Took away my sin,
L: I have had the sunlight of His love within.

[Bait 1]
L: I wandered in the shades of night
L: Till Jesus came to me,
L: And with the sunlight of His love
L: Bid all my darkness flee.

[Bait 2]
L: Tho clouds may gather in the sky,
L: And billows round me roll,
L: However dark the world may be,
L: I've sunlight in my soul,

[Bait 3]
L: While walking in the light of God,
L: I sweet communion find;
L: I press with holy vigor on,
L: And leave the world behind.

[Bait 4]
L: I cross the wide extended fields,
L: I journey o'er the plain,
L: And in the sunlight of His love
L: I reap the golden grain.

[Bait 5]
L: Soon I shall see Him as He is,
L: The light that came to me;
L: Behold the brightness of His face
L: Thro'out eternity.

songs.title: Sunshine In My Soul
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt John R. Sweney
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O there's sunshine, blessed sunshine,
L: When the peaceful happy moments roll.
L: When Jesus shows His smiling face,
L: There is sunshine in my soul.

[Bait 1]
L: There is sunshine in my soul today,
L: More glorious and bright
L: Than glows in any earthly sky,
L: For Jesus is my light.

[Bait 2]
L: There is music in my soul today,
L: A carol to my King;
L: And Jesus, listening can hear
L: The songs I cannot sing.

[Bait 3]
L: There is springtime in my soul today,
L: For when the Lord is near
L: The dove of peace sings in my heart,
L: The flow'rs of grace appear.

[Bait 4]
L: There is gladness in my soul today,
L: And hope and praise and love,
L: For blessings which He gives me now,
L: For joys "laid up" above.

songs.title: Sweet Hour Of Prayer
songs.author: William B. Bradbury William W. Walford
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: That calls me from a world of care
L: And bids me at my Father's throne
L: Make all my wants and wishes known.
L: In seasons of distress and grief
L: My soul has often found relief,
L: And oft escaped the tempter's snare,
L: By Thy return sweet hour of prayer.

[Bait 2]
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: Sweet hour of prayer.
L: The joys I feel, the bliss I share.
L: Of those whose anxious spirits burn
L: With strong desires for Thy return.
L: With such I hasten to the place
L: Where God, my Savior, shows His face.
L: And gladly take my station there,
L: And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer.

[Bait 3]
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: Thy wings shall my petition bear
L: To Him whose truth and faithfulness
L: Engage the waiting soul to bless;
L: And since He bids me seek His face,
L: Believe His word, and trust His grace,
L: I'll cast on Him my ev'ry care.
L: And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer.

[Bait 4]
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: Sweet hour of prayer,
L: May I Thy consolation share,
L: 'Til from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
L: I view my home and take my flight.
L: This robe of flesh
L: I'll drop and rise
L: To seize the everlasting prize,
L: And shout while passing through the air,
L: Farewell, farewell sweet hour of prayer.

songs.title: Take My Life And Let It Be
songs.author: Frances R. Havergal
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Take my life, and let it be
L: Consecrated, Lord, to Thee;
L: Take my moments and my days,
L: Let them flow with ceaseless praise.

[Bait 2]
L: Take my hands, and let them move
L: At the impulse of Thy love;
L: Take my feet, and let them be
L: Swift and beautiful for Thee.

[Bait 3]
L: Take my voice, and let me sing
L: Always, only, for my King;
L: Take my lips, and let them be
L: Filled with messages from Thee.

[Bait 4]
L: Take my silver and my gold,
L: Not a mite would I withhold;
L: Take my intellect, and use
L: Every power as Thou shalt choose.

[Bait 5]
L: Take my will, and make it Thine;
L: It shall be no longer mine;
L: Take my heart, it is Thine own;
L: It shall be Thy royal throne.

[Bait 6]
L: Take my love; my Lord, I pour
L: At Thy feet its treasure store:
L: Take myself, and I will be
L: Ever, only, all for Thee.

songs.title: Take The Name Of Jesus With You
songs.author: Lydia Baxter William Howard Doane
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Precious name, O how sweet!
L: Hope of earth and joy of heaven.
L: Precious name, O how sweet!
L: Hope of earth and joy of heaven.

[Bait 1]
L: Take the name of Jesus with you.
L: Child of sorrow and of woe.
L: It will joy and comfort give you;
L: Take it then where'er you go.

[Bait 2]
L: Take the name of Jesus ever,
L: As a shield from every snare.
L: If temptations round you gather,
L: Breathe that holy name in prayer.

[Bait 3]
L: O the precious name of Jesus!
L: How it thrills our souls with joy.
L: When His loving arms receive us
L: And His songs our tongues employ!

[Bait 4]
L: At the name of Jesus bowing,
L: Falling prostrate at His feet.
L: King of kings in heaven we'll crown Him,
L: When our journey is complete.

songs.title: Take Time To Be Holy
songs.author: George C. Stebbins William D. Longstaff
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: Take time to be holy.
L: Speak oft with thy Lord;
L: Abide in Him always,
L: And feed on His Word.
L: Make friends with God's children;
L: Help those who are weak,
L: Forgetting in nothing
L: His blessing to seek.

[Bait 2]
L: Take time to be holy.
L: The world rushes on;
L: Spend much time in secret
L: With Jesus alone.
L: By looking to Jesus,
L: Like Him thou shalt be;
L: Thy friends in thy conduct
L: His likeness shall see.

[Bait 3]
L: Take time to be holy.
L: Let Him be thy Guide;
L: And run not before Him,
L: Whatever betide.
L: In joy or in sorrow,
L: Still follow thy Lord,
L: And, looking to Jesus,
L: Still trust in His word.

[Bait 4]
L: Take time to be holy,
L: Be calm in thy soul;
L: Each thought and each motive
L: Beneath His control;
L: Thus led by His Spirit
L: To fountains of love,
L: Thou soon shalt be fitted
L: For service above.

songs.title: Tell It To Jesus
songs.author: Edmund S. Lorenz Jeremiah E. Rankin
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Tell it to Jesus,
L: Tell it to Jesus.
L: He is a Friend that's well known.
L: You have no other
L: Such a friend or brother.
L: Tell it to Jesus alone.

[Bait 1]
L: Are you weary,
L: Are you heavy hearted?
L: Tell it to Jesus,
L: Tell it to Jesus.
L: Are you grieving
L: Over joys departed?
L: Tell it to Jesus alone.

[Bait 2]
L: Do the tears flow down
L: Your cheeks unbidden?
L: Tell it to Jesus,
L: Tell it to Jesus.
L: Have you sins that
L: To men's eyes are hidden?
L: Tell it to Jesus alone.

[Bait 3]
L: Do you fear the
L: Gathering clouds of sorrow?
L: Tell it to Jesus,
L: Tell it to Jesus.
L: Are you anxious
L: What shall be tomorrow?
L: Tell it to Jesus alone.

[Bait 4]
L: Are you troubled
L: At the thought of dying?
L: Tell it to Jesus,
L: Tell it to Jesus.
L: For Christ's coming kingdom
L: Are you sighing?
L: Tell it to Jesus alone.

songs.title: Tell Me The Story Of Jesus
songs.author: J.H. Tenney Rev. E.A. Hoffman
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: ... all the rich treasures of wisdom, unto my soul impart.
L: Tell me the beautiful story, the wonderful, wonderful
L: Story; tell me the beautiful story of Jesus and His love.
L: Tell me the story of Jesus, tell of His wondrous love; tell
L: Of His mercy to sinners, tell of the home above.

songs.title: Tell The Blessed Story
songs.author: Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Tell the blessed story, of the cross of Jesus.
L: Tell the blessed story, of the hallowed cross.
L: Until every nation, learns of full salvation.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.

[Bait 1]
L: Church of God awaken, heed the Lord's command.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.
L: Fields are white for harvesting, on ev'ry hand.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.

[Bait 2]
L: Has He not commissioned you, the news to bear.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.
L: Go ye into all the world, and ev'rywhere
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.

[Bait 3]
L: Stand no longer idle, while the moments fly.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.
L: Multitudes in heathen darkness live and die.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.

[Bait 4]
L: Publish unto all the world redeeming grace.
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.
L: Until in the home of rest you find your place,
L: Tell the blessed story of the cross.

songs.title: That Beautiful Name
songs.author: Jean Perry Mabel Johnston Camp
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: That beautiful name! That beautiful name
L: From sin has power to free us!
L: That beautiful name! That wonderful name!
L: That matchless name is Jesus.

[Bait 1]
L: I know of a name, a beautiful name
L: That angels brought down to earth.
L: They whispered it low,
L: One night long ago
L: To a maiden of lowly birth.

[Bait 2]
L: I know of a name, a beautiful name
L: That unto a babe was given.
L: The stars glittered bright
L: Throughout that glad nigh,
L: And angels praised God in heaven.

[Bait 3]
L: The One of that name, my Savior became
L: My Savior of Calvary.
L: My sins nailed Him there,
L: My burdens He bare.

[Bait 4]
L: I love that blest name
L: Made higher than all in heaven.
L: 'Twas whispered, I know,
L: In my heart long ago.
L: To Jesus my life I've given.

songs.title: The Advent Of Our God
songs.author: Aaron Williams Charles Coffin John Chandler
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: The advent of our God,
L: With eager hearts we greet;
L: And we must praise Him in this hour,
L: With hymns and anthems sweet.

[Bait 2]
L: All glory to the Son,
L: Who comes to set us free;
L: With Father, Spirit ever One,
L: Through all eternity.

[Bait 3]
L: The everlasting Son,
L: Incarnate stoops to be;
L: Himself the servant's form
L: Puts on to set his people free.

[Bait 4]
L: Come, Zion's daughter,
L: Rise to meet your lowly King;
L: Nor let your faithless heart despise
L: The peace He comes to bring.

[Bait 5]
L: As judge, on clouds of light,
L: He soon will come again;
L: And all His scattered saints
L: Unite with Him on high to reign.

[Bait 6]
L: Before the dawning day
L: Let sin be put to flight;
L: No longer let the law hold sway,
L: But walk in freedom's light.

songs.title: The Bible Stands
songs.author: Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: The Bible stands tho' the hills may tumble,
L: It will firmly stand when the earth shall crumble.
L: I will plant my feet on its firm foundation,
L: For the Bible stands, the Bible stands.

[Bait 1]
L: The Bible stands like a rock undaunted,
L: Mid the raging storms of time.
L: Its pages burn with the truth eternal,
L: And they glow with a light sublime.

[Bait 2]
L: The Bible stands like a mountain towering,
L: Far above the works of man.
L: Its truth by none ever was refuted,
L: And destroy it they never can.

[Bait 3]
L: The Bible stands, and it will forever,
L: When the world has passed away.
L: By inspiration it has been given,
L: All its precepts I will obey.

[Bait 4]
L: The Bible stands every test we give it,
L: For its Author is divine.
L: By grace alone I expect to live it,
L: And to prove it and make it mine.

songs.title: The Birthday Of A King
songs.author: William Harold Neidlinger
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Alleluia! O how the angels sang!
L: Alleluia! How it rang!
L: And the sky was bright with a holy light,
L: 'Twas the birthday of a King.

[Bait 1]
L: In the little village of Bethlehem,
L: There lay a Child one day;
L: And the sky was bright with a holy light,
L: O'er the place where Jesus lay.

[Bait 2]
L: 'Twas a humble birthplace,
L: But oh, how much God gave to us that day;
L: From the manger bed what a path has led,
L: What a perfect holy way.
L: Miscellaneous 1
[Ending]
L: O come, let us adore Him;
L: O come, let us adore Him,
L: Christ, the Lord.
L: 'Twas the birthday of a Savior.
L: Alleluia! Alleluia!
L: 'Twas the birthday of a King.

songs.title: The First Noel
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
L: Born is the King of Israel.

[Bait 1]
L: The first Noel,
L: The angel did say,
L: Was to certain poor shepherds,
L: In fields as they lay;
L: In fields where they
L: Lay keeping their sheep,
L: On a cold winter's night
L: That was so deep.

[Bait 2]
L: They looked up and saw a star
L: Shining in the east,
L: Beyond them far,
L: And to the earth
L: It gave great light,
L: And so it continued
L: Both day and night.

[Bait 3]
L: And by the light
L: Of that same star,
L: Three wise men came
L: From country far;
L: To seek for a King
L: Was their intent,
L: And to follow the star,
L: Wherever it went.

[Bait 4]
L: This star drew nigh
L: To the northwest,
L: O'er Bethlehem
L: It took its rest,
L: And there it did
L: Both stop and stay,
L: Right over the place
L: Where Jesus lay.

[Bait 5]
L: Then entered in
L: Those wise men three,
L: Full rev'rently
L: Upon their knee,
L: And offered there
L: In His presence,
L: Their gold, and myrrh,
L: And frankincense.

[Bait 6]
L: Then let us all
L: With one accord,
L: Sing praises to
L: Our heavenly Lord,
L: That hath made heav'n
L: And earth of naught,
L: And with His blood
L: Mankind hath bought.

songs.title: The God Of Abraham Praise
songs.author: Daniel Ben Judah Thomas Olivers
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: The God of Abraham praise,
L: Who reigns enthroned above;
L: Ancient of everlasting days,
L: And God of love.
L: Jehovah, great I Am,
L: By earth and heaven confessed;
L: I bow and bless the sacred name,
L: Forevermore blest.

[Bait 2]
L: The God of Abraham praise,
L: At whose supreme command;
L: From earth I rise,
L: And seek the joys
L: At His right hand.
L: I all on earth forsake,
L: Its wisdom, fame, and power;
L: And Him my only portion make,
L: My shield and tower.

[Bait 3]
L: He by Himself hath sworn,
L: I on His oath depend;
L: I shall on eagles wings upborne,
L: To heaven ascend.
L: I shall behold His face,
L: I shall His power adore;
L: And sing the wonders
L: Of His grace forevermore.

[Bait 4]
L: The whole triumphant host,
L: Give thanks to God on high;
L: "Hail, Father, Son and Holy Ghost!"
L: They ever cry.
L: Hail, Abraham's God and mine!
L: I join the heavenly lays,
L: All might and majesty are Thine;
L: And endless praise.
L: Amen.

songs.title: The Gospel Train
songs.author: C. Austin Miles
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Oh I'm trav'ling on the hallelujah line,
L: On the good old gospel train.
L: I am on the right track,
L: And never will go back
L: To the station of sin again.
L: I am trav'ling on the hallelujah line,
L: On the good old gospel train.
L: I need no fare, I'm riding on a pass,
L: 'Tis the blood for sinners slain.

songs.title: The Great Physician
songs.author: John H. Stockton William Hunter
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Sweetest note in seraph song,
L: Sweetest name on mortal tongue,
L: Sweetest carol ever sung,
L: Jesus, blessed Jesus.

[Bait 1]
L: The great Physician now is near,
L: The sympathizing Jesus.
L: He speaks the drooping heart to cheer.
L: O hear the voice of Jesus!

[Bait 2]
L: Your many sins are all forgiven,
L: O hear the voice of Jesus!
L: Go on your way,
L: In peace to heaven,
L: And wear a crown with Jesus.

[Bait 3]
L: All glory to the dying Lamb,
L: I now believe in Jesus.
L: I love the blessed Savior's name;
L: I love the name of Jesus.

[Bait 4]
L: And when to that bright world above
L: We rise to be with Jesus,
L: We'll sing around the throne of love
L: His name, the name of Jesus.

[Bait 5]
L: His name dispels my guilt and fear,
L: No other name but Jesus;
L: O how my soul delights to hear
L: The precious name of Jesus.

songs.title: The King Of Love
songs.author: Henry Williams Baker John Bacchus Dykes
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: The King of love my Shepherd is,
L: Whose goodness faileth never;
L: I nothing lack if I am His,
L: And He is mine forever.

[Bait 2]
L: Where streams of living water flow
L: My ransomed soul He leadeth;
L: And where the verdant pastures grow,
L: With food celestial feedeth.

[Bait 3]
L: Perverse and foolish oft I strayed
L: But yet in love He sought me.
L: And on His shoulder gently laid,
L: And home rejoicing brought me.

[Bait 4]
L: In death's dark vale I fear no ill
L: With Thee, dear Lord beside me;
L: Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
L: Thy cross before to guide me.

[Bait 5]
L: And so through all the length of days,
L: Thy goodness faileth never.
L: Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise,
L: Within Thy house forever.

songs.title: The Lord's My Shepherd
songs.author: Francis Rous Jessie Seymour Irvine William Mure Wi
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: The Lord's my Shepherd I'll not want,
L: He makes me down to lie in pastures green;
L: He leadeth me the quiet waters by.

[Bait 2]
L: My soul He doth restore again,
L: And me to walk doth make;
L: Within the paths of righteousness,
L: E'en for His own name's sake.

[Bait 3]
L: Yea, tho' I walk in death's dark vale,
L: Yet will I fear no ill for Thou art with me
L: And Thy rod and staff me comfort still.

[Bait 4]
L: My table Thou hast furnished
L: In presence of my foes;
L: My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
L: And my cup overflows.

[Bait 5]
L: Goodness and mercy all my life
L: Shall surely follow me,
L: And in God's house forevermore
L: My dwelling place shall be.
L: Amen.

songs.title: The Love Of God
songs.author: Frederick M. Lehman
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O love of God, how rich and pure!
L: How measureless and strong!
L: It shall forevermore endure,
L: The saints' and angels' song.

[Bait 1]
L: The love of God is greater far,
L: Than tongue or pen can ever tell,
L: It goes beyond the highest star
L: And reaches to the lowest hell;
L: The guilty pair, bowed down with care,
L: God gave His Son to win;
L: His erring child He reconciled
L: And pardoned from his sin.

[Bait 2]
L: When years of time shall pass away
L: And earthly thrones and kingdoms fall,
L: When men, who here refuse to pray,
L: On rocks and hills and mountains call;
L: God's love so sure shall still endure,
L: All measureless and strong;
L: Redeeming grace to Adam's race
L: The saints' and angels' song.

[Bait 3]
L: Could we with ink the ocean fill
L: And were the skies of parchment made,
L: Were ev'ry stalk on earth a quill
L: And ev'ry man a scribe by trade.
L: To write the love of God above
L: Would drain the ocean dry;
L: Nor could the scroll contain the whole
L: Tho stretched from sky to sky.

songs.title: The Name Of Jesus
songs.author: Edmund S. Lorenz W.C. Martin
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: "Jesus," O how sweet the name!
L: "Jesus," every day the same!
L: "Jesus," let all saints proclaim
L: Its worthy praise forever!

[Bait 1]
L: The name of Jesus is so sweet,
L: I love its music to repeat.
L: It makes my joys full and complete,
L: The precious name of Jesus!

[Bait 2]
L: I love the name of Him whose heart,
L: Knows all my griefs and bears a part,
L: Who bids all anxious fears depart,
L: I love the name of Jesus.

[Bait 3]
L: That name I fondly love to hear;
L: It never fails my heart to cheer;
L: It's music dries the falling tear.
L: Exalt the name of Jesus!

[Bait 4]
L: No word of man can ever tell
L: How sweet the name I love so well.
L: O let its praises ever swell!
L: O praise the name of Jesus!

songs.title: The Old Rugged Cross
songs.author: George Bennard
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: So I'll cherish the old rugged cross,
L: Till my trophies at last I lay down;
L: I will cling to the old rugged cross,
L: And exchange it some day for a crown.

[Bait 1]
L: On a hill far away
L: Stood an old rugged cross;
L: The emblem of suffering and shame.
L: And I love that old cross
L: Where the dearest and best,
L: For a world of lost sinners was slain.

[Bait 2]
L: Oh, that old rugged cross,
L: So despised by the world,
L: Has a wondrous attraction for me;
L: For the dear Lamb of God,
L: Left His glory above,
L: To bear it to dark Calvary.

[Bait 3]
L: In the old rugged cross,
L: Stained with blood so divine,
L: A wondrous beauty I see;
L: For 'twas on that old cross,
L: Jesus suffered and died,
L: To pardon and sanctify me.

[Bait 4]
L: To the old rugged cross
L: I will ever be true,
L: It's shame and reproach gladly bear;
L: Then He'll call me some day
L: To my home far away,
L: Where His glory forever I'll share.

songs.title: The Solid Rock
songs.author: Edward Mote William B. Bradbury
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
L: All other ground is sinking sand.
L: All other ground is sinking sand.

[Bait 1]
L: My hope is built on nothing less
L: Than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
L: I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
L: But wholly lean on Jesus' name.

[Bait 2]
L: When darkness seems to hide His face,
L: I rest on His unchanging grace.
L: In every high and stormy gale,
L: My anchor holds within the veil.

[Bait 3]
L: His oath, His covenant, His blood,
L: Support me in the whelming flood.
L: When all around my soul gives way,
L: He then is all my Hope and Stay.

[Bait 4]
L: When He shall come with trumpet sound,
L: O may I then in Him be found!
L: Dressed in His righteousness alone,
L: Faultless to stand before the throne!

songs.title: The Spacious Firmament
songs.author: Franz Joseph Haydn Joseph Addison
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: The spacious firmament on high,
L: With all the blue ethereal sky
L: And spangled heav'ns a shining frame;
L: Their great original proclaim.
L: Th'unwearied sun from day to day,
L: Does His Creator's pow'r display
L: And publishes to every land,
L: The work of an Almighty hand.

[Bait 2]
L: Soon as the evening shades prevail,
L: The moon takes up the wondrous tale
L: And nightly to the listening earth,
L: Repeats the story of her birth;
L: While all the stars that round her burn
L: And all the planets in their turn
L: Confirm the tidings as they roll,
L: And spread the truth from pole to pole.

[Bait 3]
L: What though in solemn silence all,
L: Move round the dark terrestrial ball?
L: What though no real voice nor sound,
L: Amid their radiant orbs be found;
L: In reason's ear they all rejoice
L: And utter forth a glorious voice;
L: Forever singing as they shine,
L: The hand that made us is divine.

songs.title: The Unveiled Christ
songs.author: N.B. Herrell
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O, behold the Man of sorrows!
L: O, behold Him in plain view!
L: Lo! He is the mighty conqu'ror
L: Since He rent the veil in two.
L: Lo! He is the mighty conqu'ror
L: Since He rent the veil in two.

[Bait 1]
L: Once our blessed Christ of beauty
L: Was veiled off from human view;
L: But thro' suff'ring, death, and sorrow
L: He has rent the veil in two.

[Bait 2]
L: Yes, He is with God, the Father,
L: Interceding there for you;
L: For He is the mighty conqu'ror
L: Since He rent the veil in two.

[Bait 3]
L: Holy angels bow before Him,
L: Men of earth give praises due;
L: For He is the well beloved,
L: Since He rent the veil in two.

[Bait 4]
L: Thro'out time and endless ages,
L: Heights and depths of love so true,
L: He alone can be the giver,
L: Since He rent the veil in two.

songs.title: There Is A Fountain
songs.author: Lowell Mason William Cowper
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: There is a fountain filled with blood
L: Drawn from Immanuel's veins;
L: And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
L: Lose all their guilty stains:
L: Lose all their guilty stains,
L: Lose all their guilty stains;
L: And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
L: Lose all their guilty stains.

[Bait 2]
L: The dying thief rejoiced to see
L: That fountain in his day;
L: And there may I, though vile as he,
L: Wash all my sins away:
L: Wash all my sins away,
L: Wash all my sins away;
L: And there may I, though vile as he,
L: Wash all my sins away.

[Bait 3]
L: Dear dying Lamb, Thy precious blood
L: Shall never lose its power
L: Till all the ransomed church of God
L: Are saved, to sin no more:
L: Are saved, to sin no more,
L: Are saved, to sin no more;
L: Till all the ransomed church of God
L: Are saved, to sin no more.

[Bait 4]
L: For since by faith I saw the stream
L: Thy flowing wounds supply,
L: Redeeming love has been my theme,
L: And shall be till I die:
L: And shall be till I die,
L: And shall be till I die;
L: Redeeming love has been my theme
L: And shall be till I die.

[Bait 5]
L: When this poor lisping, stamm'ring tongue
L: Lies silent in the grave,
L: Then in a nobler, sweeter song
L: I'll sing Thy pow'r to save:
L: Then in a nobler sweeter song
L: I'll sing Thy pow'r to save;
L: I'll sing Thy pow'r to save,
L: I'll sing Thy pow'r to save;
L: Then in a nobler sweeter song
L: I'll sing Thy pow'r to save.

[Bait 6]
L: E'er since by faith I saw the stream
L: Thy flowing wounds supply,
L: Redeeming love has been my theme,
L: And shall be till I die:
L: And shall be till I die,
L: And shall be till I die;
L: Redeeming love has been my theme,
L: And shall be till I die.

songs.title: There Is No Name So Sweet On Earth
songs.author: George W. Bethune William B. Bradbury
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: We love to sing of Christ our King
L: And hail Him blessed Jesus;
L: For there's no word ear ever heard,
L: So dear, so sweet as Jesus.

[Bait 1]
L: There is no name so sweet on earth,
L: No name so sweet in heaven;
L: The name before His wondrous birth,
L: To Christ the Savior given.

[Bait 2]
L: And when He hung upon the tree,
L: They wrote this name above Him;
L: That all might see the reason we,
L: For evermore must love Him.

[Bait 3]
L: So now upon His Father's throne,
L: Almighty to release us;
L: From sin and pain He ever reigns,
L: The Prince and Savior Jesus.

[Bait 4]
L: O Jesus, by that matchless name,
L: Thy grace shall fail us never;
L: Today as yesterday the same,
L: Thou art the same forever.

songs.title: There's A Wideness In God's Mercy
songs.author: Frederick W. Faber Lizzie S. Tourjee
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: There's a wideness in God's mercy
L: Like the wideness of the sea;
L: There's a kindness in His justice,
L: Which is more than liberty.

[Bait 2]
L: There is welcome for the sinner,
L: And more graces for the good.
L: There is mercy with the Savior;
L: There is healing in His blood.

[Bait 3]
L: For the love of God is broader
L: Than the measure of man's mind;
L: And the heart of the Eternal
L: Is most wonderfully kind.

[Bait 4]
L: If our love were but more simple,
L: We should take Him at His word;
L: And our lives would be all sunshine
L: In the sweetness of our Lord.

[Bait 5]
L: There is plentiful redemption
L: In the blood that has been shed;
L: There is joy for all the members
L: In the sorrows of the Head.

songs.title: This Is My Father's World
songs.author: Franklin Lawrence Sheppard Maltbie Davenport Babco
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: Thou Didst Leave Thy Throne
songs.author: Emily E.S. Elliott Timothy Richard Matthews
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O come to my heart, Lord Jesus.
L: There is room in my heart for Thee.

[Reff 2]
L: My heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
L: When Thou comest and callest for me.

[Bait 1]
L: Thou didst leave Thy throne
L: And Thy kingly crown,
L: When Thou camest to earth for me.
L: But in Bethlehem's home
L: Was there found no room
L: For Thy holy nativity.

[Bait 2]
L: Heaven's arches rang,
L: When the angels sang,
L: Proclaiming Thy royal decree;
L: But of lowly birth,
L: Didst Thou come to earth
L: And in great humility.

[Bait 3]
L: The foxes found rest
L: And the birds their nest,
L: In the shade of the forest tree;
L: But Thy couch was the sod,
L: O Thou Son of God,
L: In the deserts of Galilee.

[Bait 4]
L: Thou camest, O Lord,
L: With the living word,
L: That should set Thy people free;
L: But with mocking scorn
L: And with crown of thorn,
L: They bore Thee to Calvary.

[Bait 5]
L: When the heaven's shall ring
L: And the angels sing,
L: At Thy coming to victory;
L: Let Thy voice call me home,
L: Saying, "Yet there is room,
L: There is room at My side for thee."

songs.title: Tis Marvelous And Wonderful
songs.author: Lelia N. Morris
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Wonderful, wonderful,
L: Marvelous and wonderful
L: What He has done for my soul!
L: The half has never been told
L: Oh, it is wonderful.
L: It is marvelous and wonderful
L: What Jesus has done for this soul of mine!
L: The half has never been told.

[Bait 1]
L: The Savior has come in His mighty power,
L: And spoken peace to my soul.
L: And all of my life from that very hour,
L: I've yielded to His control.
L: I've yielded to His control.

[Bait 2]
L: 'Twas only a foretaste of joys divine
L: In Canaan waiting for me;
L: Where sweetest honey and milk and wine
L: Were dripping from ev'ry tree
L: Were dripping from ev'ry tree.

[Bait 3]
L: From glory to glory He leads me on
L: From grace to grace ev'ry day;
L: And brighter and brighter the glory dawns
L: While pressing my homeward way
L: While pressing my homeward way.

[Bait 4]
L: If fellowship here with my Lord can be
L: So inexpressibly sweet
L: Oh, what will it be when His face we see
L: When 'round the white throne we meet.
L: When 'round the white throne we meet.

songs.title: Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus
songs.author: Louisa Stead William J. Kirkpatrick
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Jesus, Jesus how I trust Him!
L: How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
L: Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
L: O for grace to trust Him more!

[Bait 1]
L: 'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
L: Just to take Him at His word;
L: Just to rest upon His promise;
L: Just to know "Thus saith the Lord."

[Bait 2]
L: O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
L: Just to trust His cleansing blood;
L: Just in simple faith to plunge me,
L: Neath the healing, cleansing flood!

[Bait 3]
L: Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
L: Just from sin and self to cease;
L: Just from Jesus simply taking
L: Life and rest and joy and peace.

[Bait 4]
L: I'm so glad I learned to trust Thee,
L: Precious Jesus, Savior friend;
L: And I know that Thou art with me,
L: Wilt be with me to the end.

songs.title: To God Be The Glory
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
L: Let the earth hear His voice!
L: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
L: Let the people rejoice!
L: O come to the Father
L: Through Jesus the Son;
L: And give Him the glory,
L: Great things He hath done!

[Bait 1]
L: To God be the glory!
L: Great things He hath done!
L: So lov'd He the world
L: That He gave us His Son,
L: Who yielded His life
L: An atonement for sin,
L: And open'd the lifegate
L: That all may go in.

[Bait 2]
L: O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood!
L: To every believer the promise of God;
L: The vilest offender who truly believes,
L: That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

[Bait 3]
L: Great things He hath taught us,
L: Great things He hath done,
L: And great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son:
L: But purer and higher and greater will be
L: Our wonder, our worship, when Jesus we see!

songs.title: Twas A Glad Day
songs.author: Albert Simpson Reitz
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: 'Twas a glad day when Jesus found me.
L: When His strong arms were thrown around me,
L: When my sins He buried in the deepest sea,
L: And my soul He filled with joy and victory.
L: 'Twas a glad day, O hallelujah.
L: 'Twas a glad day He claimed His own.
L: I will shout a glad hosanna in glory,
L: When I see Him upon His throne.

[Bait 1]
L: I was lost in sin when Jesus found me.
L: But He rescued me, all glory to His name.
L: And the cords of worldly pleasure bound me,
L: 'Til He saved me from sin and shame.

[Bait 2]
L: Oh, the bells of heaven now are ringing,
L: For I hear their tones within my ransomed soul.
L: And my heart is filled with joyful singing,
L: Since the Savior hath made me whole.

[Bait 3]
L: Oh, the joy when we shall meet in glory,
L: In the mansions of my Father's home above.
L: And through endless ages tell the story,
L: Of the Savior's redeeming love.

songs.title: We Praise Thee O God Our Redeemer
songs.author: A. Valerius Julia Bulkley Cady Cory
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: We praise Thee, O God,
L: Our Redeemer, Creator
L: In grateful devotion
L: Our tribute we bring;
L: We lay it before Thee,
L: We kneel and adore Thee,
L: We bless Thy holy name,
L: Glad praises we sing.

[Bait 2]
L: We worship Thee,
L: God of our fathers,
L: We bless Thee
L: Thru life's storm and tempest,
L: Our guide has Thou been;
L: When perils o'er take us,
L: Escape Thou wilt make us,
L: And with Thy help, O Lord,
L: Our battles we win.

[Bait 3]
L: With voices united
L: Our praises we offer
L: To Thee, great Jehovah,
L: Glad anthems we raise;
L: Thy strong arm will guide us,
L: Our God is beside us,
L: To Thee, our great Redeemer,
L: Forever be praise!

songs.title: We Three Kings Of Orient Are
songs.author: John H. Jr. Hopkins
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: O star of wonder, star of night,
L: Star with royal beauty bright;
L: Westward leading, still proceeding,
L: Guide us to Thy perfect light.

[Bait 1]
L: We three kings of Orient are,
L: Bearing gifts we traverse afar;
L: Field and fountain moor and mountain,
L: Following yonder star.

[Bait 2]
L: Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
L: Gold I bring to crown Him again;
L: King forever, ceasing never,
L: Over us all to reign.

[Bait 3]
L: Frankincense to offer have I,
L: Incense owns a Deity nigh;
L: Prayer and praising, all men raising,
L: Worship Him, God on high.

[Bait 4]
L: Myrrh is mine, its bitter perfume,
L: Breathes a life of gathering gloom;
L: Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
L: Sealed in the stone cold tomb.

[Bait 5]
L: Glorious now behold Him arise,
L: King and God and sacrifice;
L: Alleluia, alleluia!
L: Earth to heav'n replies.

songs.title: What A Friend We Have In Jesus
songs.author: Charles C. Converse Joseph M. Scriven
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: What a Friend we have in Jesus,
L: All our sins and griefs to bear!
L: What a privilege to carry,
L: Everything to God in prayer!
L: Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
L: Oh, what needless pain we bear.
L: All because we do not carry
L: Everything to God in prayer!

[Bait 2]
L: Have we trials and temptations?
L: Is there trouble anywhere?
L: We should never be discouraged;
L: Take it to the Lord in prayer.
L: Can we find a friend so faithful,
L: Who will all our sorrows share?
L: Jesus knows our every weakness;
L: Take it to the Lord in prayer.

[Bait 3]
L: Are we weak and heavy laden,
L: Cumbered with a load of care?
L: Precious Savior, still our refuge!
L: Take it to the Lord in prayer.
L: Do Thy friends despise forsake Thee?
L: Take it to the Lord in prayer.
L: In His arms He'll take and shield Thee;
L: Thou wilt find a solace there.

songs.title: What A Wonderful Savior
songs.author: Elisha A. Hoffman
songs.copyright: Public Domain

songs.title: What Child Is This
songs.author: Pietro A. Yon William C. Dix
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: This, this is Christ the King,
L: Whom shepherds guard and angels sing.
L: Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
L: The Babe, the Son of Mary.

[Bait 1]
L: What child is this who,
L: Laid to rest,
L: On Mary's lap is sleeping?
L: Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
L: While shepherds watch are keeping.

[Bait 2]
L: Why lies He in such mean estate
L: Where ox and ass are feeding?
L: Good Christian, fear;
L: For sinners here
L: The silent Word is pleading.

[Bait 3]
L: So bring Him incense, gold and myrrh;
L: Come peasant, king to own Him.
L: The King of kings salvation brings;
L: Let loving hearts enthrone Him.

songs.title: What God Hath Promised
songs.author: Annie Flint William M. Runyan
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: But God hath promised strength for the day,
L: Rest for the labor, light for the way,
L: Grace for the trials, help from above,
L: Unfailing sympathy, undying love.

[Bait 1]
L: God hath not promised skies always blue,
L: Flower strewn pathways all our lives through.
L: God hath not promised sun without rain,
L: Joy without sorrow, peace without pain.

[Bait 2]
L: God hath not promised we shall not know
L: Toil and temptation, trouble and woe.
L: He hath not told us we shall not bear
L: Many a burden many a care.

[Bait 3]
L: God hath not promised smooth roads and wide,
L: Swift, easy, travel needing no guide,
L: Never a mountain, rocky and steep,
L: Never a river, turbid and deep.

songs.title: What Wondrous Love Is This
songs.author: S. Mead William Walker
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: What wondrous love is this,
L: O my soul, O my soul!
L: What wondrous love is this, O my soul!
L: What wondrous love is this
L: That caused the Lord of bliss
L: To bear the dreadful curse
L: For my soul, for my soul,
L: To bear the dreadful curse for my soul!

[Bait 2]
L: When I was sinking down,
L: Sinking down, sinking down,
L: When I was sinking down, sinking down;
L: When I was sinking down
L: Beneath God's righteous frown,
L: Christ laid aside His crown
L: For my soul, for my soul,
L: Christ laid aside
L: His crown for my soul!

[Bait 3]
L: To God and to the Lamb,
L: I will sing, I will sing,
L: To God and to the Lamb, I will sing!
L: To God and to the Lamb
L: Who is the "Great I Am"
L: While millions join the theme
L: I will sing, I will sing,
L: While millions join the theme
L: I will sing!

[Bait 4]
L: And when from death I'm free,
L: I'll sing on, I'll sing on,
L: And when from death I'm free, I'll sing on!
L: And when from death I'm free,
L: I'll sing and joyful be
L: And through eternity
L: I'll sing on, I'll sing on
L: And thro' eternity, I'll sing on!

songs.title: When I Survey The Wondrous Cross
songs.author: Isaac Watts Lowell Mason
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: When I survey the wondrous cross
L: On which the Prince of glory died,
L: My richest gain I count but loss,
L: And pour contempt on all my pride.

[Bait 2]
L: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
L: Save in the death of Christ, my God;
L: All the vain things that charm me most,
L: I sacrifice them to His blood.

[Bait 3]
L: See, from His head, His hands, His feet,
L: Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
L: Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
L: Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

[Bait 4]
L: Were the whole realm of nature mine,
L: That were a present far too small;
L: Love so amazing, so divine,
L: Demands my soul, my life, my all.

songs.title: When Morning Gilds The Skies
songs.author: Edward Caswall Joseph Barnby
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: When morning gilds the skies,
L: My heart awaking cries;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: Alike at work and prayer,
L: To Jesus I repair;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 2]
L: Does sadness fill my mind?
L: A solace here I find;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: Or fades my earthly bliss?
L: My comfort still is this;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 3]
L: The night becomes as day,
L: When from the heart we say,
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: The pow'rs of darkness fear
L: When this sweet chant they hear;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 4]
L: Ye nations of mankind,
L: In this your concord find;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: Let all the earth around
L: Ring joyous with the sound;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 5]
L: Sing, suns and stars of space,
L: Sing, ye that see His face;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: God's whole creation o'er,
L: For aye and evermore;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 6]
L: Be this, while life is mine,
L: My canticle divine;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: Be this the eternal song
L: Thro' all the ages long;
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

[Bait 7]
L: Whene'er the sweet church bell
L: Peals over hill and dell
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!
L: O hark to what it sings,
L: As joyously it rings,
L: May Jesus Christ be praised!

songs.title: When We All Get To Heaven
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt Emily D. Wilson
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: When we all get to heaven,
L: What a day of rejoicing that will be!
L: When we all see Jesus,
L: We'll sing and shout the victory.

[Bait 1]
L: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
L: Sing His mercy and His grace;
L: In the mansions bright and blessed,
L: He'll prepare for us a place.

[Bait 2]
L: While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
L: Clouds will overspread the sky;
L: But when traveling days are over,
L: Not a shadow, not a sigh.

[Bait 3]
L: Let us then be true and faithful,
L: Trusting, serving every day;
L: Just one glimpse of Him in glory
L: Will the toils of life repay.

[Bait 4]
L: Onward to the prize before us!
L: Soon His beauty we'll behold;
L: Soon the pearly gates will open,
L: We shall tread the streets of gold.

songs.title: While Shepherds Watched Their Flocks
songs.author: Nahum Tate T. Este
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Bait 1]
L: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
L: All seated on the ground,
L: The angel of the Lord came down,
L: And glory shone around.

[Bait 2]
L: "Be not afraid," the angel said,
L: For fear had seized their mind;
L: "Glad tidings of great joy I bring
L: To you and all mankind.

[Bait 3]
L: "To you, in David's town town this day
L: Is born of David's line
L: A Savior, who is Christ the Lord;
L: And this shall be the sign:

[Bait 4]
L: "The heavenly Babe you there shall find
L: To human view displayed,
L: In simple clothing, tightly wrapped,
L: And in a manger laid."

[Bait 5]
L: Thus spoke the seraph, and at once
L: Appeared a shining throng
L: Of angels praising God, who thus
L: Addressed their joyful song:

[Bait 6]
L: "All glory be to God on high
L: And on the earth be peace;
L: Good will hence forth from heaven to men
L: Begin and never cease."

songs.title: Wonderful Grace Of Jesus
songs.author: Haldor Lillenas
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Wonderful, the matchless grace of Jesus.
L: Deeper than the mighty rolling sea.
L: Higher than the mountains
L: Sparkling like a fountain,
L: All sufficient grace for even me.
L: Broader than the scope
L: Of my transgressions.
L: Greater far than all my sin and shame.
L: O, magnify the precious name of Jesus!
L: Praise His name!

[Bait 1]
L: Wonderful grace of Jesus,
L: Greater than all my sin.
L: How shall my tongue describe it?
L: Where shall its praise begin?
L: Taking away my burden,
L: Setting my Spirit free.
L: For wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.

[Bait 2]
L: Wonderful grace of Jesus,
L: Reaching to all the lost.
L: By it I have been pardoned,
L: Saved to the uttermost.
L: Chains have been torn asunder,
L: Giving me liberty.
L: For the wonderful grace
L: Of Jesus reaches me.

[Bait 3]
L: Wonderful grace of Jesus,
L: Reaching the most defiled.
L: By its transforming power
L: Making Him God's dear child.
L: Purchasing peace and heaven
L: For all eternity.
L: And the wonderful grace
L: Of Jesus reaches me.

songs.title: Wonderful Peace
songs.author: W. George Cooper Warren D. Cornell
songs.copyright: Public Domain
songs.content:
[Reff 1]
L: Peace, Peace, wonderful peace,
L: Coming down from the Father above.
L: Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
L: In fathomless billows of love.

[Bait 1]
L: Far away in the depths
L: Of my spirit tonight
L: Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
L: In celestial-like strains
L: It unceasingly falls
L: O'er my soul like an infinite calm.

[Bait 2]
L: What a treasure I have
L: In this wonderful peace,
L: Buried deep in the heart of my soul,
L: So secure that no power can mine it away
L: While the years of eternity roll.

[Bait 3]
L: I am resting tonight
L: In this wonderful peace,
L: Resting sweetly in Jesus' control.
L: For I'm kept from all danger
L: By night and by day,
L: And His glory is flooding my soul.

[Bait 4]
L: And me-thinks when I rise
L: To that city of peace,
L: Where the Author of peace I shall see,
L: That one strain of the song
L: Which the ransomed will sing
L: In that heavenly kingdom shall be:

[Bait 5]
L: Ah soul, are you here
L: Without comfort or rest,
L: Marching down the rough pathway of time?
L: Make Jesus your friend
L: Ere the shadows grow dark.
L: Oh accept this sweet peace so sublime.

songs.title: Wonderful Saviour
songs.author: J. M. Harris
